item.title: C. 333 & 666 Float Boundary Probe. PYTHON
item.description:
#!/usr/bin/env python3 # -*- coding: utf-8 -*- # FILE: rp9_333_666_float_boundary_probe.py # VERSION: 1.0.0 # PURPOSE: Create a self-contained verification package for the 1/3 <-> 2/3 float boundary pulse. # RULE: No external input paths are required. The script writes output next to itself. from __future__ import annotations import json import math import platform import sys from datetime import datetime, timezone from decimal import Decimal, getcontext from fractions import Fraction from pathlib import Path from typing import Any getcontext().prec = 100 SCRIPT_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve() SCRIPT_STEM = SCRIPT_PATH.stem OUTPUT_DIR = SCRIPT_PATH.with_name(SCRIPT_STEM) JSON_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / (SCRIPT_STEM + "_run_trace.json") MD_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / (SCRIPT_STEM + "_SLUTRAPPORT.md") LOG_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / (SCRIPT_STEM + "_execution.log") ITERATIONS = 40 EXPECTED_RESTS = (Fraction(1, 3), Fraction(2, 3)) EXPECTED_RATIO = Decimal(8) def utc_now_iso() -> str: return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds") def ensure_output_dir() -> None: OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) def write_log(lines: list[str]) -> None: LOG_PATH.write_text("
".join(lines) + "
", encoding="utf-8") def dec_from_fraction(value: Fraction) -> Decimal: return Decimal(value.numerator) / Decimal(value.denominator) def decimal_from_float_exact(value: float) -> Decimal: return Decimal.from_float(value) def residual_order(value: Fraction) -> tuple[int | None, Decimal, Decimal, Decimal]: exact_decimal = dec_from_fraction(value) float_value = float(value) float_decimal = decimal_from_float_exact(float_value) residual = float_decimal - exact_decimal if residual == 0: return None, residual, exact_decimal, float_decimal order = residual.copy_abs().log10().to_integral_value(rounding="ROUND_FLOOR") return int(order), residual, exact_decimal, float_decimal def fraction_to_data(value: Fraction) -> dict[str, Any]: return { "fraction": str(value), "numerator": value.numerator, "denominator": value.denominator, "decimal_100_prec": str(dec_from_fraction(value)), } def build_rows() -> list[dict[str, Any]]: rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = [] for n in range(ITERATIONS): q = Fraction(3, 4) / (2 ** n) value = Fraction(8, 1) / q whole = value.numerator // value.denominator rest = value - whole order, residual, exact_decimal, float_decimal = residual_order(rest) expected_rest = Fraction(2, 3) if n % 2 == 0 else Fraction(1, 3) ok = rest == expected_rest and rest in EXPECTED_RESTS rows.append({ "n": n, "q": fraction_to_data(q), "value_8_div_q": fraction_to_data(value), "whole": whole, "rest": fraction_to_data(rest), "expected_rest": str(expected_rest), "float_rest": repr(float(rest)), "exact_decimal": str(exact_decimal), "float_decimal_exact": str(float_decimal), "residual": str(residual), "residual_abs": str(abs(residual)), "residual_order_10": order, "pass": ok, }) return rows def build_machine_boundary() -> dict[str, Any]: ulp_1 = Decimal.from_float(math.ulp(1.0)) two_minus_52 = Decimal(2) ** Decimal(-52) two_minus_49 = Decimal(2) ** Decimal(-49) ratio = two_minus_49 / two_minus_52 return { "ulp_1_0_exact_decimal": str(ulp_1), "two_power_minus_52": str(two_minus_52), "two_power_minus_49": str(two_minus_49), "ratio_2_minus_49_div_2_minus_52": str(ratio), "ratio_expected": str(EXPECTED_RATIO), "ratio_pass": ratio == EXPECTED_RATIO, } def build_trace(rows: list[dict[str, Any]], machine_boundary: dict[str, Any], started_at: str, finished_at: str) -> dict[str, Any]: pass_count = sum(1 for row in rows if row["pass"]) fail_count = len(rows) - pass_count all_rows_pass = fail_count == 0 all_orders_valid = all(row["residual_order_10"] is not None for row in rows) all_residuals_nonzero = all(Decimal(row["residual"]) != 0 for row in rows) final_pass = all_rows_pass and machine_boundary["ratio_pass"] and all_orders_valid and all_residuals_nonzero return { "metadata": { "script": SCRIPT_PATH.name, "script_stem": SCRIPT_STEM, "output_directory": str(OUTPUT_DIR), "started_at_utc": started_at, "finished_at_utc": finished_at, "python_version": sys.version, "platform": platform.platform(), }, "function": "Float-boundary probe for the recurring 1/3 <-> 2/3 rest pulse produced from q_n = (3/4) / 2^n and 8 / q_n.", "syfte_och_mening": "Att gora restpulsen maskinlasbar, granskningsbar och reproducerbar genom exakt rationell aritmetik samt explicit float-residualkontroll.", "vad_den_testar": [ "Att varje iteration ger rest 1/3 eller 2/3.", "Att vaxlingen foljer forvantad puls: 2/3 vid jamna n och 1/3 vid udda n.", "Att float-representationen av 1/3 och 2/3 ger sparbar residual mot exakt Fraction/Decimal-referens.", "Att maskinens grans mellan 2^-49 och 2^-52 ger kvoten 8.", ], "varfor": "Testet visar om den observerade 0.333... <-> 0.666...-pulsen bevaras nar exakt rationell struktur jamfors mot float-representationens maskinlager.", "input_model": { "base_relation": "3/4", "operation_q_n": "q_n = (3/4) / 2^n", "control_operation": "8 / q_n", "iterations": ITERATIONS, "expected_pulse": "1/3 <-> 2/3", }, "verification_summary": { "pass_count": pass_count, "fail_count": fail_count, "all_rows_pass": all_rows_pass, "all_residuals_nonzero": all_residuals_nonzero, "all_residual_orders_present": all_orders_valid, "machine_ratio_pass": machine_boundary["ratio_pass"], "final_status": "PASS" if final_pass else "FAIL", }, "machine_boundary": machine_boundary, "rows": rows, } def write_json(trace: dict[str, Any]) -> None: JSON_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8") def make_markdown(trace: dict[str, Any]) -> str: summary = trace["verification_summary"] boundary = trace["machine_boundary"] lines: list[str] = [] lines.append("---") lines.append("# RP9 333 666 FLOAT BOUNDARY PROBE") lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("") lines.append("## Funktion") lines.append("") lines.append(str(trace["function"])) lines.append("") lines.append("## Syfte och mening") lines.append("") lines.append(str(trace["syfte_och_mening"])) lines.append("") lines.append("## Vad den testar") lines.append("") for item in trace["vad_den_testar"]: lines.append("- " + str(item)) lines.append("") lines.append("## Varfor") lines.append("") lines.append(str(trace["varfor"])) lines.append("") lines.append("## Testmodell") lines.append("") lines.append("| Parameter | Varde |") lines.append("|---|---|") for key, value in trace["input_model"].items(): lines.append("| " + str(key) + " | " + str(value) + " |") lines.append("") lines.append("## Verifiering") lines.append("") lines.append("| Kontroll | Resultat |") lines.append("|---|---|") lines.append("| Passerade iterationer | " + str(summary["pass_count"]) + " |") lines.append("| Fallna iterationer | " + str(summary["fail_count"]) + " |") lines.append("| Alla rader PASS | " + str(summary["all_rows_pass"]) + " |") lines.append("| Residualer icke-noll | " + str(summary["all_residuals_nonzero"]) + " |") lines.append("| Residualordning finns | " + str(summary["all_residual_orders_present"]) + " |") lines.append("| Maskinkvot PASS | " + str(summary["machine_ratio_pass"]) + " |") lines.append("| SLUTSTATUS | " + str(summary["final_status"]) + " |") lines.append("") lines.append("## Maskingrans") lines.append("") lines.append("| Kontroll | Varde |") lines.append("|---|---|") lines.append("| ulp(1.0) | " + boundary["ulp_1_0_exact_decimal"] + " |") lines.append("| 2^-52 | " + boundary["two_power_minus_52"] + " |") lines.append("| 2^-49 | " + boundary["two_power_minus_49"] + " |") lines.append("| Kvot | " + boundary["ratio_2_minus_49_div_2_minus_52"] + " |") lines.append("| Forvantad kvot | " + boundary["ratio_expected"] + " |") lines.append("") lines.append("## Iterationsdata") lines.append("") lines.append("| n | q | 8/q | heltal | rest | float(rest) | residual | order | status |") lines.append("|---:|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---:|---|") for row in trace["rows"]: status = "PASS" if row["pass"] else "FAIL" lines.append( "| " + str(row["n"]) + " | " + row["q"]["fraction"] + " | " + row["value_8_div_q"]["fraction"] + " | " + str(row["whole"]) + " | " + row["rest"]["fraction"] + " | " + row["float_rest"] + " | " + row["residual"] + " | " + str(row["residual_order_10"]) + " | " + status + " |" ) lines.append("") lines.append("## Slutrapport") lines.append("") lines.append("Koden har korts och verifierats. Slutstatus: " + str(summary["final_status"]) + ".") lines.append("") lines.append("## Skapade filer") lines.append("") lines.append("- " + JSON_PATH.name) lines.append("- " + MD_PATH.name) lines.append("- " + LOG_PATH.name) lines.append("") lines.append("---") return "
".join(lines) + "
" def write_markdown(trace: dict[str, Any]) -> None: MD_PATH.write_text(make_markdown(trace), encoding="utf-8") def print_console_summary(trace: dict[str, Any]) -> None: summary = trace["verification_summary"] print("KONTROLL: FLOAT-REPRESENTATION AV RESTPULSEN") print("Funktion: 1/3 <-> 2/3 residualkontroll mot float-lager") print("Syfte och mening: granskningsbar JSON och Markdown-slutrapport") print("Vad den testar: restpuls, residual, residualordning, maskinkvot 8") print("Varfor: verifierar att relationell restpuls bevaras genom float-representation") print("Status:", summary["final_status"]) print("Output-mapp:", OUTPUT_DIR) print() for row in trace["rows"]: status = "PASS" if row["pass"] else "FAIL" print("n={:02d} | rest={} | float={} | residual={} | order={} | {}".format( row["n"], row["rest"]["fraction"], row["float_rest"], row["residual"], row["residual_order_10"], status, )) print() print("ulp(1.0)=", trace["machine_boundary"]["ulp_1_0_exact_decimal"]) print("2^-52=", trace["machine_boundary"]["two_power_minus_52"]) print("2^-49=", trace["machine_boundary"]["two_power_minus_49"]) print("ratio=", trace["machine_boundary"]["ratio_2_minus_49_div_2_minus_52"]) print("JSON:", JSON_PATH) print("Markdown:", MD_PATH) def main() -> int: started_at = utc_now_iso() log_lines: list[str] = [] log_lines.append("START " + started_at) log_lines.append("SCRIPT " + str(SCRIPT_PATH)) try: ensure_output_dir() rows = build_rows() machine_boundary = build_machine_boundary() finished_at = utc_now_iso() trace = build_trace(rows, machine_boundary, started_at, finished_at) write_json(trace) write_markdown(trace) print_console_summary(trace) exit_code = 0 if trace["verification_summary"]["final_status"] == "PASS" else 1 log_lines.append("FINISH " + finished_at) log_lines.append("EXIT_CODE " + str(exit_code)) write_log(log_lines) return exit_code except Exception as exc: finished_at = utc_now_iso() log_lines.append("ERROR " + repr(exc)) log_lines.append("FINISH " + finished_at) log_lines.append("EXIT_CODE 2") ensure_output_dir() write_log(log_lines) print("ERROR:", repr(exc)) return 2 if __name__ == "__main__": raise SystemExit(main()) ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.

item.title: C. Quotient Lock 1 Over 8 Test. PYTHON
item.description: #!/usr/bin/env python3 # -*- coding: utf-8 -*- from fractions import Fraction from pathlib import Path from datetime import datetime, timezone import json import platform import sys CODE_NAME = Path(__file__).stem OUTPUT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / CODE_NAME JSON_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / f"{CODE_NAME}.json" REPORT_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / f"{CODE_NAME}_SLUTRAPPORT.md" LOG_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / f"{CODE_NAME}.log" def now(): return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() def log(msg): with LOG_PATH.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(f"[{now()}] {msg}\n") def frac(v): return {"fraction": str(v)} def main(): OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) rows = [] for n in range(101): R_n = Fraction(1, 8 ** n) R_next = Fraction(1, 8 ** (n + 1)) down_ratio = R_next / R_n up_ratio = R_n / R_next ok = down_ratio == Fraction(1,8) and up_ratio == Fraction(8,1) rows.append({ "n": n, "R_n": frac(R_n), "R_next": frac(R_next), "down_ratio": frac(down_ratio), "up_ratio": frac(up_ratio), "status": "PASS" if ok else "FAIL" }) all_ok = all(r["status"] == "PASS" for r in rows) R15 = Fraction(2) ** -49 R16 = Fraction(2) ** -52 residual_check = { "R16_over_R15": str(R16 / R15), "R15_over_R16": str(R15 / R16), "R16_over_R15_is_1_over_8": (R16 / R15) == Fraction(1,8), "R15_over_R16_is_8": (R15 / R16) == Fraction(8,1) } final_status = "PASS" if all_ok and residual_check["R15_over_R16_is_8"] else "FAIL" payload = { "function": "Kvotlåsningstest", "purpose": "Verifiera invariansen mellan 1/8 och 8 genom skalsteg.", "what_is_tested": "R(n+1)/R(n)=1/8 och R(n)/R(n+1)=8 över 101 nivåer.", "why": "Kontrollera att kvoten förblir exakt låst.", "verification": { "all_iterations_pass": all_ok, "residual_check": residual_check, "final_status": final_status }, "results": rows } JSON_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8") md = [ "---", "# RP9 QUOTIENT LOCK TEST", "", "## Funktion", payload["function"], "", "## Syfte och mening", payload["purpose"], "", "## Vad den testar", payload["what_is_tested"], "", "## Varför", payload["why"], "", "## Verifiering", f"- Alla iterationer PASS: {all_ok}", f"- R16/R15 = {residual_check['R16_over_R15']}", f"- R15/R16 = {residual_check['R15_over_R16']}", f"- Slutstatus: {final_status}" ] REPORT_PATH.write_text("\n".join(md), encoding="utf-8") log("JSON skapad") log("Markdown skapad") log("SLUTSTATUS=" + final_status) print("SLUTSTATUS:", final_status) if __name__ == "__main__": main() ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.

item.title: C. Reverse Test. PYTHON
item.description: #!/usr/bin/env python3 # -*- coding: utf-8 -*- from fractions import Fraction from pathlib import Path from datetime import datetime, timezone import json import platform import sys CODE_NAME = Path(__file__).stem OUTPUT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / CODE_NAME JSON_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / f"{CODE_NAME}.json" REPORT_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / f"{CODE_NAME}_SLUTRAPPORT.md" LOG_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / f"{CODE_NAME}.log" def now(): return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() def log(msg): with LOG_PATH.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(f"[{now()}] {msg}\n") def frac(v): return {"fraction": str(v), "numerator": v.numerator, "denominator": v.denominator} def main(): OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) pattern = [Fraction(2,3), Fraction(1,3)] * 10 candidates = [] tested = 0 for q_num in range(1, 65): for q_den in range(1, 65): tested += 1 q = Fraction(q_num, q_den) ok = True for n in range(8): value = Fraction(8,1) / (q / (2 ** n)) whole = value.numerator // value.denominator rest = value - whole if rest != pattern[n]: ok = False break if ok: candidates.append(q) unique_candidates = sorted(set(candidates)) payload = { "metadata": { "generated_utc": now(), "python": sys.version, "platform": platform.platform() }, "function": "Omvänt test", "purpose": "Söker vilka q-värden som reproducerar den observerade restpulsen.", "what_is_tested": "Bakåthärledning från pulssekvens till kandidatvärden.", "why": "Verifiera om pulsen kan återleda till samma relation.", "tested_candidates": tested, "candidate_count": len(unique_candidates), "candidates": [str(x) for x in unique_candidates], "final_status": "PASS" if len(unique_candidates) > 0 else "FAIL" } JSON_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8") md = [] md.append("---") md.append("# RP9 REVERSE TEST") md.append("") md.append("## Funktion") md.append(payload["function"]) md.append("") md.append("## Syfte och mening") md.append(payload["purpose"]) md.append("") md.append("## Vad den testar") md.append(payload["what_is_tested"]) md.append("") md.append("## Varför") md.append(payload["why"]) md.append("") md.append(f"Antal testade kandidater: {tested}") md.append(f"Antal träffar: {len(unique_candidates)}") md.append("") md.append("## Kandidater") md.append("") for c in unique_candidates: md.append(f"- {c}") md.append("") md.append(f"## SLUTSTATUS: {payload['final_status']}") REPORT_PATH.write_text("\n".join(md), encoding="utf-8") log("JSON skapad") log("Markdown skapad") log("Kandidater hittade: " + str(len(unique_candidates))) print("SLUTSTATUS:", payload["final_status"]) print("KANDIDATER:", len(unique_candidates)) if __name__ == "__main__": main() ⚖️ — License & CopyrightLicensed under RP9-LA-2026Copyright © 2026 Anton WallinSee LICENSE for full terms.

item.title: C. Perturbation Test. PYTHON
item.description:
#!/usr/bin/env python3 # -*- coding: utf-8 -*- # RP9 Perturbation Test # Version: 2.0 # Purpose: Self-reporting, traceable, reviewable verification script. from fractions import Fraction from pathlib import Path from datetime import datetime, timezone import json import platform import sys import traceback CODE_NAME = Path(__file__).stem OUTPUT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / CODE_NAME JSON_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / (CODE_NAME + '.json') REPORT_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / (CODE_NAME + '_SLUTRAPPORT.md') LOG_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / (CODE_NAME + '.log') def utc_now_iso(): return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() def fraction_to_record(value): return { 'fraction': str(value), 'numerator': value.numerator, 'denominator': value.denominator, 'decimal_preview': format(float(value), '.17g') } def write_log(message): timestamp = utc_now_iso() with LOG_PATH.open('a', encoding='utf-8') as handle: handle.write('[' + timestamp + '] ' + message + '
') def check_fraction(label, value, iterations=40): rows = [] for n in range(iterations): q = value / (2 ** n) inv = Fraction(8, 1) / q whole = inv.numerator // inv.denominator frac = inv - whole ok = frac in (Fraction(1, 3), Fraction(2, 3)) rows.append({ 'iteration': n, 'q': fraction_to_record(q), 'eight_divided_by_q': fraction_to_record(inv), 'whole_part': whole, 'remainder': fraction_to_record(frac), 'expected_remainders': ['1/3', '2/3'], 'status': 'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL' }) all_ok = all(row['status'] == 'PASS' for row in rows) first_fail = next((row for row in rows if row['status'] != 'PASS'), None) return { 'label': label, 'input_value': fraction_to_record(value), 'iterations': iterations, 'status': 'PASS' if all_ok else 'FAIL', 'first_failure': first_fail, 'rows': rows } def build_tests(): return [ ('LOCKED_3_4', Fraction(3, 4)), ('PERTURB_0_749', Fraction(749, 1000)), ('PERTURB_0_751', Fraction(751, 1000)), ('PERTURB_0_740', Fraction(74, 100)), ('PERTURB_0_760', Fraction(76, 100)), ('PERTURB_3_4_MINUS_1E-6', Fraction(749999, 1000000)), ('PERTURB_3_4_PLUS_1E-6', Fraction(750001, 1000000)) ] def run_analysis(): OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) if LOG_PATH.exists(): LOG_PATH.unlink() write_log('START ' + CODE_NAME) print('PERTURBATIONSTEST') print('Funktion: testar om restpulsen 1/3 <-> 2/3 bara kvarstår vid det låsta värdet 3/4.') print('Syfte och mening: separera låst relation från perturbierade representationer.') print('Vad den testar: 8 / ((value) / 2^n), restdel efter heltalsdelen, över 40 iterationer per testvärde.') print('Varför: om perturbationer bryter restpulsen visar testet att 3/4 fungerar som låst referensvärde.') print() results = [] for label, value in build_tests(): result = check_fraction(label, value, 40) results.append(result) print(label + ' | value = ' + str(value) + ' | status = ' + result['status']) if result['first_failure'] is None: last_row = result['rows'][-1] print(' inga brott till n=' + str(last_row['iteration']) + ' | sista rest=' + last_row['remainder']['fraction']) else: fail = result['first_failure'] print(' första brott: n=' + str(fail['iteration']) + ' | q=' + fail['q']['fraction'] + ' | 8/q=' + fail['eight_divided_by_q']['fraction'] + ' | heltal=' + str(fail['whole_part']) + ' | rest=' + fail['remainder']['fraction']) print() locked = next(item for item in results if item['label'] == 'LOCKED_3_4') perturbations = [item for item in results if item['label'] != 'LOCKED_3_4'] locked_pass = locked['status'] == 'PASS' perturbations_break = all(item['status'] == 'FAIL' for item in perturbations) final_status = 'PASS' if locked_pass and perturbations_break else 'FAIL' verification = { 'locked_3_4_must_pass': locked_pass, 'all_perturbations_must_fail': perturbations_break, 'final_status': final_status } payload = { 'metadata': { 'code_name': CODE_NAME, 'generated_at_utc': utc_now_iso(), 'python_version': sys.version, 'platform': platform.platform(), 'output_directory': str(OUTPUT_DIR), 'json_path': str(JSON_PATH), 'markdown_report_path': str(REPORT_PATH), 'log_path': str(LOG_PATH) }, 'function': 'Perturbationstest för RP9/Rx8-restpulsen.', 'purpose_and_meaning': 'Verifierar om 3/4 är ett låst relationsvärde genom att jämföra det med närliggande perturbationer.', 'what_is_tested': 'För varje startvärde beräknas q_n = value / 2^n och 8 / q_n. Restdelen efter heltalsdelen måste vara 1/3 eller 2/3 för att sekvensen ska godkännas.', 'why_it_is_tested': 'Om 3/4 passerar men perturbationer faller visar koden att restpulsen inte är en godtycklig effekt av iterationen.', 'method': { 'iterations_per_value': 40, 'arithmetic': 'Exact rational arithmetic with fractions.Fraction', 'pass_condition_per_row': 'remainder in {1/3, 2/3}', 'final_pass_condition': 'LOCKED_3_4 passes and every perturbation fails' }, 'verification': verification, 'results': results } JSON_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8') write_markdown_report(payload) write_log('JSON written: ' + str(JSON_PATH)) write_log('Markdown report written: ' + str(REPORT_PATH)) write_log('FINAL STATUS ' + final_status) print('SLUTRAPPORT:', final_status) print('JSON:', JSON_PATH) print('MARKDOWN:', REPORT_PATH) print('LOG:', LOG_PATH) return final_status def write_markdown_report(payload): lines = [] lines.append('---') lines.append('# RP9 PERTURBATION TEST') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## Funktion') lines.append('') lines.append(payload['function']) lines.append('') lines.append('## Syfte och mening') lines.append('') lines.append(payload['purpose_and_meaning']) lines.append('') lines.append('## Vad den testar') lines.append('') lines.append(payload['what_is_tested']) lines.append('') lines.append('## Varfor') lines.append('') lines.append(payload['why_it_is_tested']) lines.append('') lines.append('## Testmetod') lines.append('') lines.append('- Iterationer per varde: ' + str(payload['method']['iterations_per_value'])) lines.append('- Aritmetik: ' + payload['method']['arithmetic']) lines.append('- Radkrav: ' + payload['method']['pass_condition_per_row']) lines.append('- Slutkrav: ' + payload['method']['final_pass_condition']) lines.append('') lines.append('## Verifiering') lines.append('') lines.append('| Kontroll | Status |') lines.append('|---|---|') lines.append('| LOCKED_3_4 passerar | ' + str(payload['verification']['locked_3_4_must_pass']) + ' |') lines.append('| Alla perturbationer faller | ' + str(payload['verification']['all_perturbations_must_fail']) + ' |') lines.append('| Slutstatus | ' + payload['verification']['final_status'] + ' |') lines.append('') lines.append('## Resultattabell') lines.append('') lines.append('| Test | Varde | Status | Forsta brott |') lines.append('|---|---:|---|---|') for item in payload['results']: if item['first_failure'] is None: first_failure = 'Inget brott inom ' + str(item['iterations']) + ' iterationer' else: fail = item['first_failure'] first_failure = 'n=' + str(fail['iteration']) + ', rest=' + fail['remainder']['fraction'] lines.append('| ' + item['label'] + ' | ' + item['input_value']['fraction'] + ' | ' + item['status'] + ' | ' + first_failure + ' |') lines.append('') lines.append('## Slutsats') lines.append('') if payload['verification']['final_status'] == 'PASS': lines.append('Testet godkanns: 3/4 bevarar restpulsen 1/3 <-> 2/3, medan samtliga perturbierade varden bryter villkoret.') else: lines.append('Testet underkanns: verifieringsvillkoret uppfylldes inte fullstandigt.') lines.append('') lines.append('## Sparbarhet') lines.append('') lines.append('- JSON: ' + payload['metadata']['json_path']) lines.append('- Logg: ' + payload['metadata']['log_path']) lines.append('- Markdownrapport: ' + payload['metadata']['markdown_report_path']) lines.append('') lines.append('---') REPORT_PATH.write_text('
'.join(lines) + '
', encoding='utf-8') def main(): try: status = run_analysis() if status != 'PASS': raise SystemExit(1) except Exception as exc: OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) write_log('ERROR ' + repr(exc)) write_log(traceback.format_exc()) print('SLUTRAPPORT: FAIL') print('Fel:', exc) raise if __name__ == '__main__': main() ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.

item.title: A. README
item.description: B. Perturbation Test. FINAL REPORT Link — 🔗. C. Perturbation Test. PYTHON Link — 🔗. C. Perturbation Test. PYTHON This code constitutes the fifth verification in the RP9 sequence.After previous tests verified:1. Origin reconstruction 2. Pulse invariance 3. Start independence 4. Base independence this test investigates a new question:What happens if the relation is disturbed? The goal is no longer to show that the pulse exists.The goal is to determine whether the pulse only exists at a specific locked value or whether it arises arbitrarily also at nearby values.The code compares the locked value:3/4 against several intentionally perturbed variants:0.749 0.751 0.740 0.760 3/4 - 0.000001 3/4 + 0.000001 For each value, the following is performed:40 iterations where:q = value / 2^n and then:8 / q The remainder after the integer part is extracted and compared against the requirement:1/3 or 2/3 If the residual pulse occurs for purely numerical reasons, even nearby values ​​should give the same result.If, however, only:3/4 preserves the sequence while perturbations break it, this means that the pulse is linked to a specific relation value and not to the iteration itself.The test therefore serves as the first robustness verification in the entire series.Reference value:3/4 Perturbations:749/1000 751/1000 74/100 76/100 749999/1000000 750001/1000000 Iteration:q = value / 2^n Check:8 / q Pass condition:rest ∈ {1/3, 2/3} End condition:LOCKED_3_4 must pass all perturbations must fail All arithmetic is performed with:fractions.Fraction which eliminates floating point errors from the verification.If the hypothesis is correct:3/4 continue to produce:1/3 ↔ 2/3 throughout the entire sequence.At the same time, each perturbation must break the condition.Expected outcome matrix:The result was:First deviation occurred immediately:n = 0 for all perturbations.Only:3/4 preserved the residual sequence through all 40 iterations.The test passed.The observed pulse:1/3 ↔ 2/3 does not appear as a general consequence of the halving process.Instead, the test shows that:3/4 functions as a locked reference value within the tested model.Even very small deviations:± 0.000001 break the sequence immediately.The result means that the pulse is not only:stable but also:selective because it survives exact reference value but not perturbations.When run, the following is generated:rp9_perturbation_test │ ├── README.md ├── rp9_perturbation_test.py ├── rp9_perturbation_test.json ├── rp9_perturbation_test.log └── rp9_perturbation_test_FINALREPORT.md The JSON file contains all iterations.The log file contains the running track and final status.The markdown file contains the summary review report.The first five tests have now verified:1. Origin reconstruction 2. Pulse invariance 3. Start independence 4. Base independence 5. Perturbation resistance The next step will be:rp9_reverse_test There, perturbations are no longer examined.Instead, the direction is examined.The question changes from:Does the relation survive the impact? to:Does the relation survive if the process is run backwards? This will be the first verification of the reversibility of the sequence. ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.

item.title: C. Base Independence Test. PYTHON
item.description: #!/usr/bin/env python3 # -*- coding: utf-8 -*- from fractions import Fraction from pathlib import Path from datetime import datetime, timezone import json import platform import sys CODE_NAME = Path(__file__).stem OUTPUT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / CODE_NAME JSON_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / f"{CODE_NAME}.json" REPORT_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / f"{CODE_NAME}_SLUTRAPPORT.md" LOG_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / f"{CODE_NAME}.log" def now(): return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() def log(msg): with LOG_PATH.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(f"[{now()}] {msg}\n") def frac(v): return { "fraction": str(v), "numerator": v.numerator, "denominator": v.denominator } def main(): OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) bases = [2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64] results = [] for base_value in bases: rows = [] ok = True for n in range(40): q = Fraction(3, 4) / (2 ** n) value = Fraction(base_value, 1) / q whole = value.numerator // value.denominator rest = value - whole passed = rest in (Fraction(1, 3), Fraction(2, 3)) if not passed: ok = False rows.append({ "iteration": n, "q": frac(q), "value": frac(value), "whole": whole, "rest": frac(rest), "status": "PASS" if passed else "FAIL" }) results.append({ "base": base_value, "status": "PASS" if ok else "FAIL", "rows": rows }) final_pass = all(x["status"] == "PASS" for x in results) payload = { "metadata": { "generated_utc": now(), "python": sys.version, "platform": platform.platform() }, "function": "Basoberoende verifiering", "purpose": "Verifiera om restpulsen bevaras oberoende av vald bas.", "what_is_tested": "Baserna 2,4,8,16,32,64 över 40 iterationer.", "why": "Fastställa om pulsen är basoberoende.", "verification": { "all_bases_pass": final_pass, "final_status": "PASS" if final_pass else "FAIL" }, "results": results } JSON_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8") md = [] md.append("---") md.append("# RP9 BASE INDEPENDENCE TEST") md.append("") md.append("## Funktion") md.append(payload["function"]) md.append("") md.append("## Syfte och mening") md.append(payload["purpose"]) md.append("") md.append("## Vad den testar") md.append(payload["what_is_tested"]) md.append("") md.append("## Varför") md.append(payload["why"]) md.append("") md.append("## Verifiering") md.append("") md.append("| Bas | Status |") md.append("|---|---|") for r in results: md.append(f"| {r['base']} | {r['status']} |") md.append("") md.append(f"**SLUTSTATUS:** {'PASS' if final_pass else 'FAIL'}") md.append("") REPORT_PATH.write_text("\n".join(md), encoding="utf-8") log("JSON skapad") log("Markdown skapad") log(f"SLUTSTATUS={'PASS' if final_pass else 'FAIL'}") print("SLUTSTATUS:", "PASS" if final_pass else "FAIL") if __name__ == "__main__": main() ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.

item.description:
B. Base Independence Test. FINAL REPORT Link — 🔗. B. Base Independence Test. FINAL REPORT C. Base Independence Test. PYTHON Link — 🔗.
C. Base Independence Test. PYTHON This code constitutes the fourth verification in the RP9 sequence.After the previous test has shown that the residual pulse is independent of the starting representation, this test investigates whether the same pulse is also independent of the chosen basis system.The goal is to determine whether the observed structure is tied to a specific basis or whether it is preserved across multiple numerical representation systems.The code tests the following bases:Base 2 Base 4 Base 8 Base 16 Base 32 Base 64 For each base, the following is performed:40 iterations where the relation3/4 is successively halved.At each iteration, the following is calculated:value = base / q where:q = (3/4) / 2^n Then the remainder is checked after the integer part.If the remainder pulse truly represents a relational property, it should not change when the same structure is expressed through different bases.If the pulse:1/3 ↔ 2/3 recurs regardless of the chosen base, it means that the structure is not an artifact of a specific number system.The test is therefore used to determine whether the pulse is:base-independent or: ```text base-dependent Tested bases:2 4 8 16 32 64 Initial value:3/4 Iteration:q = (3/4) / 2^n Check:value = base / q Fit condition:residue ∈ {1/3, 2/3} Iterations:40 per base Total number of verifications:6 bases × 40 iterations = 240 verifications All calculations are done with:fractions.Fraction to eliminate floating point rounding from the verification process.If the hypothesis is correct: Base 2 gives PASS Base 4 gives PASS Base 8 gives PASS Base 16 gives PASS Base 32 gives PASS Base 64 gives PASS and:the residual pulse must continue to alternate between 1/3 and 2/3 without interruption.The result was:Final status:PASS No verified base broke the pulse sequence.All 240 checkpoints passed without deviation.The test passed.The observed pulse:1/3 ↔ 2/3 is not bound to:Base 2 Base 4 Base 8 Base 16 Base 32 Base 64 The result therefore supports that the investigated structure is:base independent within the verified systems.What is preserved is the relation.The base system changes the representation but does not change the observed residual pulse.When executed, the following is generated:rp9_base_independence_test │ ├── README.md ├── rp9_base_independence_test.py ├── rp9_base_independence_test.json ├── rp9_base_independence_test.log └── rp9_base_independence_test_FINALREPORT.md The JSON file contains all verifications.The log file contains the execution history.The Markdown file contains the summarized audit report.The first four tests have now verified:1. Origin reconstruction 2. Binary pulse invariance 3. Start independence 4. Base independence The next step will be:rp9_perturbation_test There it is investigated whether the structure survives controlled perturbations.The question changes from:Is the relation stable? to:How stable is the relation when subjected to perturbations? This will be the first robustness verification in the sequence. ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.

') def check_start(label, start_value, iterations=40): rows = [] for n in range(iterations): q = start_value / (2 ** n) inv = Fraction(8, 1) / q whole = inv.numerator // inv.denominator rest = inv - whole ok = rest in (Fraction(1, 3), Fraction(2, 3)) rows.append({ 'iteration': n, 'q': fraction_to_record(q), 'eight_divided_by_q': fraction_to_record(inv), 'whole_part': whole, 'remainder': fraction_to_record(rest), 'expected_remainders': ['1/3', '2/3'], 'status': 'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL' }) all_ok = all(row['status'] == 'PASS' for row in rows) first_fail = next((row for row in rows if row['status'] != 'PASS'), None) return { 'label': label, 'start_value': fraction_to_record(start_value), 'iterations': iterations, 'status': 'PASS' if all_ok else 'FAIL', 'first_failure': first_fail, 'rows': rows } def build_starts(): return [ ('3/4', Fraction(3, 4)), ('6/8', Fraction(6, 8)), ('12/16', Fraction(12, 16)), ('24/32', Fraction(24, 32)), ('48/64', Fraction(48, 64)), ('96/128', Fraction(96, 128)), ('192/256', Fraction(192, 256)), ('384/512', Fraction(384, 512)), ('768/1024', Fraction(768, 1024)) ] def run_analysis(): OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) if LOG_PATH.exists(): LOG_PATH.unlink() write_log('START ' + CODE_NAME) print('TEST 2 -- STARTOBEROENDE') print('Funktion: testar om restpulsen 1/3 <-> 2/3 kvarstår oberoende av ekvivalent startrepresentation.') print('Syfte och mening: verifiera att 3/4 inte är beroende av hur proportionen skrivs initialt.') print('Vad den testar: q_n = start_value / 2^n och därefter 8 / q_n, över 40 iterationer per startvärde.') print('Varför: om alla ekvivalenta startformer passerar visar testet startoberoende inom samma relationella värde.') print() results = [] for label, value in build_starts(): result = check_start(label, value, 40) results.append(result) print(label + ' | reducerat = ' + str(value) + ' | status = ' + result['status']) if result['first_failure'] is None: last_row = result['rows'][-1] print(' inga brott till n=' + str(last_row['iteration']) + ' | sista rest=' + last_row['remainder']['fraction']) else: fail = result['first_failure'] print(' första brott: n=' + str(fail['iteration']) + ' | q=' + fail['q']['fraction'] + ' | 8/q=' + fail['eight_divided_by_q']['fraction'] + ' | heltal=' + str(fail['whole_part']) + ' | rest=' + fail['remainder']['fraction']) print() all_starts_pass = all(item['status'] == 'PASS' for item in results) all_reduce_to_3_4 = all(item['start_value']['fraction'] == '3/4' for item in results) final_status = 'PASS' if all_starts_pass and all_reduce_to_3_4 else 'FAIL' verification = { 'all_start_values_reduce_to_3_4': all_reduce_to_3_4, 'all_start_values_preserve_remainder_pulse': all_starts_pass, 'final_status': final_status } payload = { 'metadata': { 'code_name': CODE_NAME, 'generated_at_utc': utc_now_iso(), 'python_version': sys.version, 'platform': platform.platform(), 'output_directory': str(OUTPUT_DIR), 'json_path': str(JSON_PATH), 'markdown_report_path': str(REPORT_PATH), 'log_path': str(LOG_PATH) }, 'function': 'Startoberoende-test för RP9/Rx8-restpulsen.', 'purpose_and_meaning': 'Verifierar att ekvivalenta representationer av 3/4 ger samma restpuls och därmed inte är beroende av startupplösning.', 'what_is_tested': 'För varje startvärde beräknas q_n = start_value / 2^n och 8 / q_n. Restdelen efter heltalsdelen måste vara 1/3 eller 2/3.', 'why_it_is_tested': 'Om 3/4, 6/8, 12/16 och övriga ekvivalenta startvärden ger samma resultat visar koden att relationen är startoberoende inom samma reducerade proportion.', 'method': { 'iterations_per_start_value': 40, 'arithmetic': 'Exact rational arithmetic with fractions.Fraction', 'pass_condition_per_row': 'remainder in {1/3, 2/3}', 'final_pass_condition': 'Every start value reduces to 3/4 and every row passes' }, 'verification': verification, 'results': results } JSON_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8') write_markdown_report(payload) write_log('JSON written: ' + str(JSON_PATH)) write_log('Markdown report written: ' + str(REPORT_PATH)) write_log('FINAL STATUS ' + final_status) print('SAMMANFATTNING:', final_status) print('JSON:', JSON_PATH) print('MARKDOWN:', REPORT_PATH) print('LOG:', LOG_PATH) return final_status def write_markdown_report(payload): lines = item.description:
#!/usr/bin/env python3 # -*- coding: utf-8 -*- # RP9 Binary Pulse Invariance Check # Version: 2.0 # Purpose: self-contained audit and verification script. # Rule: no external paths, no manual configuration, no placeholders. from fractions import Fraction from pathlib import Path from datetime import datetime, timezone import json import sys import traceback PROGRAM_NAME = 'rp9_binary_pulse_invariance_check' VERSION = '2.0' ITERATIONS = 100 def utc_now_iso(): return datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() def fraction_to_dict(value): return { 'fraction': str(value), 'numerator': value.numerator, 'denominator': value.denominator, 'decimal': float(value) } def write_text_file(path, lines): path.write_text('
'.join(lines) + '
', encoding='utf-8') def build_output_paths(): script_path = Path(__file__).resolve() output_dir = script_path.parent / script_path.stem output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) return { 'script_path': script_path, 'output_dir': output_dir, 'json_path': output_dir / (script_path.stem + '_run_trace.json'), 'markdown_path': output_dir / (script_path.stem + '_SLUTRAPPORT.md'), 'log_path': output_dir / (script_path.stem + '_execution.log') } def run_binary_pulse_check(iterations): base = Fraction(3, 4) expected_rests = (Fraction(1, 3), Fraction(2, 3)) rows = [] for n in range(iterations): q = base / (2 ** n) inv = Fraction(8, 1) / q whole = inv.numerator // inv.denominator rest = inv - whole expected_rest = Fraction(2, 3) if n % 2 == 0 else Fraction(1, 3) rest_ok = rest in expected_rests alternation_ok = rest == expected_rest row_ok = rest_ok and alternation_ok rows.append({ 'iteration': n, 'q': fraction_to_dict(q), 'control_value_8_div_q': fraction_to_dict(inv), 'whole_part': whole, 'rest': fraction_to_dict(rest), 'expected_rest': fraction_to_dict(expected_rest), 'rest_is_allowed': rest_ok, 'alternation_is_correct': alternation_ok, 'status': 'PASS' if row_ok else 'FAIL' }) all_ok = all(row['status'] == 'PASS' for row in rows) return { 'base_relation': fraction_to_dict(base), 'operation': 'q_n = (3/4) / 2^n', 'control': '8 / q_n', 'expected_pulse': '1/3 <-> 2/3', 'iterations': iterations, 'rows': rows, 'status': 'PASS' if all_ok else 'FAIL' } def build_markdown_report(trace): result = trace['result'] rows = result['rows'] pass_count = sum(1 for row in rows if row['status'] == 'PASS') fail_count = sum(1 for row in rows if row['status'] == 'FAIL') lines = [] lines.append('---') lines.append('# rp9_binary_pulse_invariance_check') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## Funktion') lines.append('') lines.append('Koden kontrollerar om en exakt rationell skalning fran basrelationen 3/4 bevarar den binara-triadiska decimalpulsen 1/3 <-> 2/3 nar kontrollvardet 8 / q_n beraknas.') lines.append('') lines.append('## Syfte och mening') lines.append('') lines.append('Syftet ar att gora testet granskningsbart, reproducerbart och maskinlasbart. Varje iteration sparas i bade Markdown och JSON sa att hela korningen kan foljas utan att tolka konsolutskrift manuellt.') lines.append('') lines.append('## Vad den testar') lines.append('') lines.append('Testet beraknar q_n = (3/4) / 2^n for 100 iterationer. Darefter beraknas 8 / q_n. Restdelen efter heltalsdelen kontrolleras mot 1/3 och 2/3. Dessutom kontrolleras att pulsen alternerar korrekt: jamna iterationer ger 2/3 och udda iterationer ger 1/3.') lines.append('') lines.append('## Varfor') lines.append('') lines.append('Om restdelen alltid ligger i 1/3 eller 2/3 och alternerar korrekt visar testet att relationen inte bryts av binar skalning. Det stodjer den lokala RP9/Rx8-tolkningen att representationen skalar medan relationens reststruktur bevaras.') lines.append('') lines.append('## Metod') lines.append('') lines.append('- Aritmetik: exakt rationell aritmetik med Fraction.') lines.append('- Startrelation: 3/4.') lines.append('- Skalning: division med 2^n.') lines.append('- Kontroll: 8 / q_n.') lines.append('- Godkand rest: 1/3 eller 2/3.') lines.append('- Godkand sekvens: 2/3, 1/3, 2/3, 1/3, ...') lines.append('') lines.append('## SLUTRAPPORT') lines.append('') lines.append('| Kontroll | Resultat |') lines.append('|---|---|') lines.append('| Program | ' + trace['program'] + ' |') lines.append('| Version | ' + trace['version'] + ' |') lines.append('| Starttid UTC | ' + trace['started_utc'] + ' |') lines.append('| Sluttid UTC | ' + trace['finished_utc'] + ' |') lines.append('| Iterationer | ' + str(result['iterations']) + ' |') lines.append('| PASS | ' + str(pass_count) + ' |') lines.append('| FAIL | ' + str(fail_count) + ' |') lines.append('| Slutstatus | ' + result['status'] + ' |') lines.append('') lines.append('## Iterationsdata') lines.append('') lines.append('| n | q_n | 8 / q_n | heltal | rest | forvantad rest | status |') lines.append('|---:|---|---|---:|---|---|---|') for row in rows: lines.append('| ' + str(row['iteration']) + ' | ' + row['q']['fraction'] + ' | ' + row['control_value_8_div_q']['fraction'] + ' | ' + str(row['whole_part']) + ' | ' + row['rest']['fraction'] + ' | ' + row['expected_rest']['fraction'] + ' | ' + row['status'] + ' |') lines.append('') lines.append('## Genererade filer') lines.append('') lines.append('- ' + trace['files']['markdown_report']) lines.append('- ' + trace['files']['json_trace']) lines.append('- ' + trace['files']['execution_log']) lines.append('') lines.append('---') return lines def main(): paths = build_output_paths() started = utc_now_iso() exit_code = 0 log_lines = [] log_lines.append('START ' + started) log_lines.append('PROGRAM ' + PROGRAM_NAME) log_lines.append('VERSION ' + VERSION) log_lines.append('SCRIPT ' + str(paths['script_path'])) log_lines.append('OUTPUT_DIR ' + str(paths['output_dir'])) try: result = run_binary_pulse_check(ITERATIONS) finished = utc_now_iso() trace = { 'program': PROGRAM_NAME, 'version': VERSION, 'started_utc': started, 'finished_utc': finished, 'script_path': str(paths['script_path']), 'output_directory': str(paths['output_dir']), 'function': 'Kontrollerar binar puls-invarians fran 3/4 genom 100 exakta rationella skalningssteg.', 'purpose_and_meaning': 'Gor testet granskningsbart, reproducerbart och maskinlasbart.', 'what_is_tested': 'q_n = (3/4) / 2^n, kontrollen 8 / q_n, samt restpulsen 1/3 <-> 2/3.', 'why_it_is_tested': 'For att verifiera om relationens reststruktur bevaras under binar skalning.', 'result': result, 'files': { 'markdown_report': str(paths['markdown_path']), 'json_trace': str(paths['json_path']), 'execution_log': str(paths['log_path']) } } paths['json_path'].write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False) + '
', encoding='utf-8') write_text_file(paths['markdown_path'], build_markdown_report(trace)) log_lines.append('STATUS ' + result['status']) log_lines.append('JSON ' + str(paths['json_path'])) log_lines.append('MARKDOWN ' + str(paths['markdown_path'])) if result['status'] != 'PASS': exit_code = 1 except Exception as exc: finished = utc_now_iso() exit_code = 2 error_trace = { 'program': PROGRAM_NAME, 'version': VERSION, 'started_utc': started, 'finished_utc': finished, 'status': 'ERROR', 'error_type': type(exc).__name__, 'error_message': str(exc), 'traceback': traceback.format_exc() } paths['json_path'].write_text(json.dumps(error_trace, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False) + '
', encoding='utf-8') log_lines.append('STATUS ERROR') log_lines.append('ERROR_TYPE ' + type(exc).__name__) log_lines.append('ERROR_MESSAGE ' + str(exc)) log_lines.append('EXIT_CODE ' + str(exit_code)) log_lines.append('END ' + utc_now_iso()) write_text_file(paths['log_path'], log_lines) print('INVARIANSKONTROLL: ' + str(ITERATIONS) + ' ITERATIONER') print('Basrelation: 3/4') print('Operation: q_n = (3/4) / 2^n') print('Kontroll: 8 / q_n') print('Forvantad decimalpuls: 1/3 <-> 2/3') print('Utdata-mapp: ' + str(paths['output_dir'])) print('Markdown: ' + str(paths['markdown_path'])) print('JSON: ' + str(paths['json_path'])) print('Logg: ' + str(paths['log_path'])) print('Status: ' + ('PASS' if exit_code == 0 else 'FAIL')) return exit_code if __name__ == '__main__': sys.exit(main()) ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.

#!/usr/bin/env python3 # -*- coding: utf-8 -*- # RP9 R Origin Reconstruction Test # Version: 1.0 # Purpose: Self-reporting, traceable, reviewable verification script. from fractions import Fraction from pathlib import Path from datetime import datetime, timezone import json import platform import sys import traceback CODE_NAME = Path(__file__).stem OUTPUT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / CODE_NAME JSON_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / (CODE_NAME + '.json') REPORT_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / (CODE_NAME + '_SLUTRAPPORT.md') LOG_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / (CODE_NAME + '.log') def utc_now_iso(): return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() def fraction_to_record(value): return { 'fraction': str(value), 'numerator': value.numerator, 'denominator': value.denominator, 'decimal_preview': format(float(value), '.17g') } def write_log(message): timestamp = utc_now_iso() with LOG_PATH.open('a', encoding='utf-8') as handle: handle.write('[' + timestamp + '] ' + message + '
') def build_r_inputs(): return [ ('R_1', Fraction(1, 1)), ('R_2', Fraction(2, 1)), ('R_3', Fraction(3, 1)), ('R_7', Fraction(7, 1)), ('R_13', Fraction(13, 1)), ('R_1000', Fraction(1000, 1)), ('R_1_OVER_7', Fraction(1, 7)), ('R_22_OVER_7', Fraction(22, 7)), ('R_355_OVER_113', Fraction(355, 113)), ('R_1414213562373095_OVER_1000000000000000', Fraction(1414213562373095, 1000000000000000)) ] def reconstruct_from_r(label, r_value, iterations=40): rx8 = r_value * 8 normalized_rx8 = rx8 / r_value representation_value = Fraction(3, 4) relation_left = Fraction(1, 3) relation_right = Fraction(2, 3) rows = [] for n in range(iterations): q = representation_value / (2 ** n) value = normalized_rx8 / q whole = value.numerator // value.denominator rest = value - whole ok = rest in (relation_left, relation_right) expected = relation_right if n % 2 == 0 else relation_left expected_ok = rest == expected rows.append({ 'iteration': n, 'q': fraction_to_record(q), 'normalized_rx8_divided_by_q': fraction_to_record(value), 'whole_part': whole, 'remainder': fraction_to_record(rest), 'expected_remainder': fraction_to_record(expected), 'status': 'PASS' if ok and expected_ok else 'FAIL' }) r_cancels_out = normalized_rx8 == Fraction(8, 1) relation_preserved = all(row['status'] == 'PASS' for row in rows) return { 'label': label, 'R_input': fraction_to_record(r_value), 'Rx8': fraction_to_record(rx8), 'normalized_Rx8': fraction_to_record(normalized_rx8), 'R_cancels_out': r_cancels_out, 'representation_value': fraction_to_record(representation_value), 'relation_pair': [fraction_to_record(relation_left), fraction_to_record(relation_right)], 'iterations': iterations, 'status': 'PASS' if r_cancels_out and relation_preserved else 'FAIL', 'rows': rows } def run_analysis(): OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) if LOG_PATH.exists(): LOG_PATH.unlink() write_log('START ' + CODE_NAME) print('RP9 R ORIGIN RECONSTRUCTION TEST') print('Funktion: testar om R kan rekonstrueras genom Rx8 utan att R behöver fungera som absolut mätvärde.') print('Syfte och mening: verifiera att R normaliseras bort och att samma relationella kedja återstår.') print('Vad den testar: R -> R x 8 -> normaliserad Rx8 = 8 -> 3/4 -> restpuls 1/3 <-> 2/3.') print('Varför: dokumentkedjan säger att R inte mäts direkt, utan rekonstrueras genom Rx8 och representation.') print() results = [] for label, r_value in build_r_inputs(): result = reconstruct_from_r(label, r_value, 40) results.append(result) print(label + ' | R=' + str(r_value) + ' | normalized_Rx8=' + result['normalized_Rx8']['fraction'] + ' | status=' + result['status']) all_r_cancel = all(item['R_cancels_out'] for item in results) all_preserve_pulse = all(item['status'] == 'PASS' for item in results) final_status = 'PASS' if all_r_cancel and all_preserve_pulse else 'FAIL' payload = { 'metadata': { 'code_name': CODE_NAME, 'generated_at_utc': utc_now_iso(), 'python_version': sys.version, 'platform': platform.platform(), 'output_directory': str(OUTPUT_DIR), 'json_path': str(JSON_PATH), 'markdown_report_path': str(REPORT_PATH), 'log_path': str(LOG_PATH) }, 'function': 'R-origin reconstruction test for RP9/Rx8.', 'purpose_and_meaning': 'Tests whether R can be treated as a non-absolute origin reference that cancels out under Rx8 normalization while preserving the 3/4 to 1/3 <-> 2/3 pulse.', 'what_is_tested': 'For each representative R value, the script computes Rx8, normalizes Rx8 by R, verifies normalized Rx8 = 8, then verifies that 8 / ((3/4) / 2^n) produces the alternating 2/3 and 1/3 remainder pulse.', 'why_it_is_tested': 'This closes the gap between the conceptual claim R -> R x 8 -> representation and the existing numeric tests that start directly from 3/4.', 'method': { 'R_values': [item[0] for item in build_r_inputs()], 'iterations_per_R_value': 40, 'arithmetic': 'Exact rational arithmetic with fractions.Fraction', 'normalization_condition': '(R x 8) / R == 8', 'pulse_condition': 'remainder alternates 2/3, 1/3 after 8 / ((3/4) / 2^n)' }, 'verification': { 'all_R_values_cancel_out': all_r_cancel, 'all_R_values_preserve_pulse': all_preserve_pulse, 'final_status': final_status }, 'results': results } JSON_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8') write_markdown_report(payload) write_log('JSON written: ' + str(JSON_PATH)) write_log('Markdown report written: ' + str(REPORT_PATH)) write_log('FINAL STATUS ' + final_status) print() print('SLUTSTATUS:', final_status) print('JSON:', JSON_PATH) print('MARKDOWN:', REPORT_PATH) print('LOG:', LOG_PATH) return final_status def write_markdown_report(payload): lines = [] lines.append('---') lines.append('# RP9 R ORIGIN RECONSTRUCTION TEST') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## Funktion') lines.append('') lines.append(payload['function']) lines.append('') lines.append('## Syfte och mening') lines.append('') lines.append(payload['purpose_and_meaning']) lines.append('') lines.append('## Vad den testar') lines.append('') lines.append(payload['what_is_tested']) lines.append('') lines.append('## Varfor') lines.append('') lines.append(payload['why_it_is_tested']) lines.append('') lines.append('## Testmetod') lines.append('') lines.append('- Iterationer per R-varde: ' + str(payload['method']['iterations_per_R_value'])) lines.append('- Aritmetik: ' + payload['method']['arithmetic']) lines.append('- Normaliseringskrav: ' + payload['method']['normalization_condition']) lines.append('- Pulskrav: ' + payload['method']['pulse_condition']) lines.append('') lines.append('## Verifiering') lines.append('') lines.append('| Kontroll | Status |') lines.append('|---|---|') lines.append('| Alla R-varden normaliseras bort | ' + str(payload['verification']['all_R_values_cancel_out']) + ' |') lines.append('| Alla R-varden bevarar restpulsen | ' + str(payload['verification']['all_R_values_preserve_pulse']) + ' |') lines.append('| Slutstatus | ' + payload['verification']['final_status'] + ' |') lines.append('') lines.append('## Resultattabell') lines.append('') lines.append('| R-label | R-varde | Rx8 | Normaliserad Rx8 | Status |') lines.append('|---|---:|---:|---:|---|') for item in payload['results']: lines.append('| ' + item['label'] + ' | ' + item['R_input']['fraction'] + ' | ' + item['Rx8']['fraction'] + ' | ' + item['normalized_Rx8']['fraction'] + ' | ' + item['status'] + ' |') lines.append('') lines.append('## Slutsats') lines.append('') if payload['verification']['final_status'] == 'PASS': lines.append('Testet godkanns: alla representativa R-varden normaliseras till Rx8 = 8, och samma restpuls 1/3 <-> 2/3 bevaras genom 3/4-representationen.') else: lines.append('Testet underkanns: R-normalisering eller restpuls bröts i minst ett fall.') lines.append('') lines.append('## Sparbarhet') lines.append('') lines.append('- JSON: ' + payload['metadata']['json_path']) lines.append('- Logg: ' + payload['metadata']['log_path']) lines.append('- Markdownrapport: ' + payload['metadata']['markdown_report_path']) lines.append('') lines.append('---') REPORT_PATH.write_text('
'.join(lines) + '
', encoding='utf-8') def main(): try: status = run_analysis() if status != 'PASS': raise SystemExit(1) except Exception as exc: OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) write_log('ERROR ' + repr(exc)) write_log(traceback.format_exc()) print('SLUTSTATUS: FAIL') print('Fel:', exc) raise if __name__ == '__main__': main() ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.

item.description: # -*- coding: utf-8 -*- # RP9_RX8_MASTER_VALIDATION_PIPELINE.py # Version: 1.0.0 # Purpose: # Execute and audit the full RP9/Rx8 validation chain. # This is FAS 6: orchestration, execution, verification and master reporting. # It runs FAS 1 to FAS 5 in fixed order when the validator scripts are present. # It fails if a validator is missing, crashes, reports FAIL, or lacks expected output. # It writes WHAT/HOW/WHY/RESULT to JSON, Markdown, trace, audit, verify and log. import json import subprocess import sys from datetime import datetime from pathlib import Path SCRIPT_VERSION = '1.0.0' SCRIPT_NAME = 'RP9_RX8_MASTER_VALIDATION_PIPELINE.py' OUTPUT_DIR_NAME = 'RP9_RX8_MASTER_VALIDATION_PIPELINE_OUTPUT' VALIDATORS = [ { 'phase': 'FAS_1_GENEALOGICAL_VALIDATION', 'script': 'RP9_RX8_GENEALOGICAL_VALIDATOR.py', 'output_dir': 'RP9_RX8_GENEALOGICAL_VALIDATOR_OUTPUT', 'verify_file': 'rp9_rx8_genealogical_verify.json', 'audit_file': 'rp9_rx8_genealogical_audit.json' }, { 'phase': 'FAS_2_PROPORTION_STRUCTURE_VALIDATION', 'script': 'RP9_RX8_PROPORTION_STRUCTURE_VALIDATOR.py', 'output_dir': 'RP9_RX8_PROPORTION_STRUCTURE_VALIDATOR_OUTPUT', 'verify_file': 'rp9_rx8_proportion_structure_verify.json', 'audit_file': 'rp9_rx8_proportion_structure_audit.json' }, { 'phase': 'FAS_3_STRUCTURE_VALIDATION', 'script': 'RP9_RX8_STRUCTURE_VALIDATOR.py', 'output_dir': 'RP9_RX8_STRUCTURE_VALIDATOR_OUTPUT', 'verify_file': 'rp9_rx8_structure_verify.json', 'audit_file': 'rp9_rx8_structure_audit.json' }, { 'phase': 'FAS_4_RESIDUAL_VALIDATION', 'script': 'RP9_RX8_RESIDUAL_VALIDATOR.py', 'output_dir': 'RP9_RX8_RESIDUAL_VALIDATOR_OUTPUT', 'verify_file': 'rp9_rx8_residual_verify.json', 'audit_file': 'rp9_rx8_residual_audit.json' }, { 'phase': 'FAS_5_INTEGRITY_VALIDATION', 'script': 'RP9_RX8_INTEGRITY_VALIDATOR.py', 'output_dir': 'RP9_RX8_INTEGRITY_VALIDATOR_OUTPUT', 'verify_file': 'rp9_rx8_integrity_verify.json', 'audit_file': 'rp9_rx8_integrity_audit.json' } ] def now_iso(): return datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds') def make_output_dir(): out_dir = Path.cwd() / OUTPUT_DIR_NAME out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) return out_dir def write_text(path, content): path.write_text(content, encoding='utf-8') def write_json(path, data): path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8') def status(pass_value): if pass_value: return 'PASS' return 'FAIL' def make_test_record(test_id, title, what_is_tested, how_it_is_tested, why_it_is_tested, expected_result, observed_result, passed, data): return { 'test_id': test_id, 'title': title, 'vad_som_testas': what_is_tested, 'hur_det_testas': how_it_is_tested, 'varfor_det_testas': why_it_is_tested, 'forvantat_resultat': expected_result, 'observerat_resultat': observed_result, 'slutresultat': status(passed), 'data': data } def read_json_if_exists(path): if not path.exists(): return None try: return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) except Exception as exc: return { 'READ_ERROR': str(exc) } def extract_global_status(payload): if not isinstance(payload, dict): return 'MISSING' if 'VERIFY' in payload and isinstance(payload['VERIFY'], dict): verify = payload['VERIFY'] if 'global_status' in verify: return str(verify['global_status']) if 'final_result' in verify: return str(verify['final_result']) if 'SUMMARY' in payload and isinstance(payload['SUMMARY'], dict): summary = payload['SUMMARY'] if 'global_status' in summary: return str(summary['global_status']) if 'System_Status' in summary: return str(summary['System_Status']) if 'final_result' in summary: return str(summary['final_result']) if 'AUDIT' in payload and isinstance(payload['AUDIT'], dict): audit = payload['AUDIT'] if 'global_status' in audit: return str(audit['global_status']) if 'final_result' in audit: return str(audit['final_result']) if 'READ_ERROR' in payload: return 'READ_ERROR' return 'UNKNOWN' def test_1_validator_presence(base_dir): rows = [] for item in VALIDATORS: path = base_dir / item['script'] rows.append({ 'phase': item['phase'], 'script': item['script'], 'script_path': str(path), 'exists': path.exists() }) missing = [row for row in rows if not row['exists']] passed = len(missing) == 0 return make_test_record( 'TEST_1', 'VALIDATOR_NARVARO', 'Narvaro av samtliga FAS 1 till FAS 5-validatorer.', 'Kontrollerar att varje forvantad Python-fil finns i aktuell katalog innan exekvering.', 'For att masterkedjan inte ska kunna godkannas om nagon validator saknas.', 'Alla fem validatorfiler ska finnas.', 'Saknade validatorer: ' + str(len(missing)) + '.', passed, { 'validators': rows, 'missing_validators': missing } ) def execute_validators(base_dir): execution_rows = [] for item in VALIDATORS: script_path = base_dir / item['script'] if not script_path.exists(): execution_rows.append({ 'phase': item['phase'], 'script': item['script'], 'executed': False, 'returncode': None, 'stdout': '', 'stderr': 'SCRIPT_MISSING', 'status': 'FAIL' }) continue result = subprocess.run( [sys.executable, str(script_path)], cwd=str(base_dir), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120 ) execution_rows.append({ 'phase': item['phase'], 'script': item['script'], 'executed': True, 'returncode': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr, 'status': 'PASS' if result.returncode == 0 else 'FAIL' }) return execution_rows def test_2_validator_execution(execution_rows): failed = [row for row in execution_rows if row['status'] != 'PASS'] passed = len(failed) == 0 return make_test_record( 'TEST_2', 'VALIDATOR_EXEKVERING', 'Exekvering av FAS 1 till FAS 5 i fast ordning.', 'Kor varje validator med samma Python-tolk och lagrar returncode, stdout och stderr.', 'For att masterpipeline ska kontrollera faktisk korning, inte bara filnarvaro.', 'Alla validatorer ska exekveras med returncode 0.', 'Misslyckade exekveringar: ' + str(len(failed)) + '.', passed, { 'execution_rows': execution_rows, 'failed_executions': failed } ) def collect_phase_outputs(base_dir): rows = [] for item in VALIDATORS: output_dir = base_dir / item['output_dir'] verify_path = output_dir / item['verify_file'] audit_path = output_dir / item['audit_file'] verify_payload = read_json_if_exists(verify_path) audit_payload = read_json_if_exists(audit_path) rows.append({ 'phase': item['phase'], 'script': item['script'], 'output_dir': str(output_dir), 'output_dir_exists': output_dir.exists(), 'verify_file': str(verify_path), 'verify_file_exists': verify_path.exists(), 'verify_status': extract_global_status(verify_payload), 'verify_payload': verify_payload, 'audit_file': str(audit_path), 'audit_file_exists': audit_path.exists(), 'audit_status': extract_global_status(audit_payload), 'audit_payload': audit_payload }) return rows def test_3_verify_control(phase_outputs): missing = [row for row in phase_outputs if not row['verify_file_exists']] failed = [row for row in phase_outputs if row['verify_status'] == 'FAIL'] bad_status = [row for row in phase_outputs if row['verify_status'] not in ['PASS']] passed = len(missing) == 0 and len(failed) == 0 and len(bad_status) == 0 return make_test_record( 'TEST_3', 'VERIFY_KONTROLL', 'Verify-output fran samtliga FAS-validatorer.', 'Laser varje *_verify.json och kraver global_status PASS.', 'For att slutstatus ska vara baserad pa verifieringslager fran varje fas.', 'Alla verify-filer ska finnas och rapportera PASS.', 'Saknade verify-filer: ' + str(len(missing)) + ', icke-PASS-statusar: ' + str(len(bad_status)) + '.', passed, { 'phase_outputs': phase_outputs, 'missing_verify_files': missing, 'failed_verify_statuses': failed, 'bad_verify_statuses': bad_status } ) def test_4_audit_control(phase_outputs): missing = [row for row in phase_outputs if not row['audit_file_exists']] failed = [row for row in phase_outputs if row['audit_status'] == 'FAIL'] read_errors = [row for row in phase_outputs if row['audit_status'] == 'READ_ERROR'] passed = len(missing) == 0 and len(failed) == 0 and len(read_errors) == 0 return make_test_record( 'TEST_4', 'AUDIT_KONTROLL', 'Audit-output fran samtliga FAS-validatorer.', 'Laser varje *_audit.json och kontrollerar att filerna finns och inte rapporterar FAIL eller lasfel.', 'For att masterrapporten ska ha revisionsspar fran varje tidigare fas.', 'Alla audit-filer ska finnas och vara lasbara utan FAIL.', 'Saknade audit-filer: ' + str(len(missing)) + ', FAIL: ' + str(len(failed)) + ', lasfel: ' + str(len(read_errors)) + '.', passed, { 'missing_audit_files': missing, 'failed_audit_statuses': failed, 'read_errors': read_errors } ) def test_5_global_chain_status(phase_outputs): statuses = [] for row in phase_outputs: statuses.append({ 'phase': row['phase'], 'verify_status': row['verify_status'], 'audit_status': row['audit_status'] }) non_pass = [row for row in statuses if row['verify_status'] != 'PASS'] passed = len(non_pass) == 0 return make_test_record( 'TEST_5', 'GLOBAL_CHAIN_STATUS', 'Samlad PASS/FAIL-status fran FAS 1 till FAS 5.', 'Kontrollerar att varje fas har verify_status PASS.', 'For att global masterstatus endast ska bli PASS om hela kedjan ar godkand.', 'FAS 1, FAS 2, FAS 3, FAS 4 och FAS 5 ska alla vara PASS.', 'Icke-PASS-faser: ' + str(len(non_pass)) + '.', passed, { 'phase_statuses': statuses, 'non_pass_phases': non_pass } ) def test_6_master_consistency(previous_tests): failed = [test for test in previous_tests if test['slutresultat'] != 'PASS'] chain = [ 'FAS 1: Relationell genealogi', 'FAS 2: Proportion och struktur', 'FAS 3: Strukturharledning', 'FAS 4: Residual som representationellt spar', 'FAS 5: Integritetskontroll' ] passed = len(failed) == 0 return make_test_record( 'TEST_6', 'MASTER_CONSISTENCY', 'Masterkedjans sammanhang fran relation till integrity.', 'Sammanstaller TEST_1 till TEST_5 och kraver att samtliga ar PASS.', 'For att sakerstalla att orkestrering, exekvering och kontroll inte har brutit kedjan.', 'Alla mastertester innan rapportsteget ska vara PASS.', 'Antal fail innan rapportsteget: ' + str(len(failed)) + '.', passed, { 'chain': chain, 'failed_tests': [test['test_id'] for test in failed], 'chain_state': 'CHAIN_INTACT' if passed else 'CHAIN_BROKEN' } ) def test_7_master_revision_report(out_dir): expected_files = [ 'rp9_rx8_master_data.json', 'rp9_rx8_master_trace.json', 'rp9_rx8_master_audit.json', 'rp9_rx8_master_verify.json', 'rp9_rx8_master_control_log.txt', 'rp9_rx8_master_presentation.md' ] existing = [] missing = [] for name in expected_files: path = out_dir / name if path.exists(): existing.append(name) else: missing.append(name) passed = len(missing) == 0 return make_test_record( 'TEST_7', 'MASTER_REVISION_REPORT', 'Masterpipelinen skapar komplett revisionspaket.', 'Kontrollerar att masterdata, trace, audit, verify, control_log och presentation finns efter skrivning.', 'For att slutpaketet ska vara granskningsbart och maskinellt sparbart.', 'Alla sex masterfiler ska finnas.', 'Existerande masterfiler: ' + str(len(existing)) + ', saknade: ' + str(len(missing)) + '.', passed, { 'expected_files': expected_files, 'existing_files': existing, 'missing_files': missing } ) def build_markdown(summary, tests, execution_rows, phase_outputs): lines = [] lines.append('# RP9 RX8 MASTER VALIDATION PIPELINE') lines.append('') lines.append('## GLOBALT SLUTRESULTAT') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('STATUS: ' + summary['global_status']) lines.append('SCRIPT: ' + summary['script']) lines.append('VERSION: ' + summary['version']) lines.append('GENERATED: ' + summary['generated_at']) lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## SYFTE') lines.append('') lines.append('Denna pipeline ar FAS 6 i RP9/Rx8-kedjan.') lines.append('') lines.append('Den skriver ingen ny teori.') lines.append('') lines.append('Den kor, samlar, granskar och sammanstaller FAS 1 till FAS 5.') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## EXEKVERINGSORDNING') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') for row in execution_rows: lines.append(row['phase'] + ' -> ' + row['status']) lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## VERIFY STATUS PER FAS') lines.append('') lines.append('| Fas | Verify | Audit |') lines.append('|---|---|---|') for row in phase_outputs: lines.append('| ' + row['phase'] + ' | ' + row['verify_status'] + ' | ' + row['audit_status'] + ' |') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') for test in tests: lines.append('## ' + test['test_id'] + ' - ' + test['title']) lines.append('') lines.append('### Vad som testas') lines.append('') lines.append(test['vad_som_testas']) lines.append('') lines.append('### Hur det testas') lines.append('') lines.append(test['hur_det_testas']) lines.append('') lines.append('### Varfor det testas') lines.append('') lines.append(test['varfor_det_testas']) lines.append('') lines.append('### Forvantat resultat') lines.append('') lines.append(test['forvantat_resultat']) lines.append('') lines.append('### Observerat resultat') lines.append('') lines.append(test['observerat_resultat']) lines.append('') lines.append('### Slutresultat') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append(test['slutresultat']) lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## SLUTSATS') lines.append('') if summary['global_status'] == 'PASS': lines.append('FAS 6 ar godkand.') lines.append('') lines.append('Hela RP9/Rx8-valideringskedjan ar exekverad och sammanstalld.') else: lines.append('FAS 6 ar inte godkand.') lines.append('') lines.append('Minst en validator saknas, kraschade, rapporterade FAIL eller saknade kravd output.') lines.append('') return '\n'.join(lines) def build_control_log(summary, tests, execution_rows, phase_outputs, out_dir): lines = [] lines.append('RP9 RX8 MASTER VALIDATION PIPELINE CONTROL LOG') lines.append('Generated: ' + summary['generated_at']) lines.append('Script: ' + summary['script']) lines.append('Version: ' + summary['version']) lines.append('Output directory: ' + str(out_dir)) lines.append('Global status: ' + summary['global_status']) lines.append('') lines.append('EXECUTION ROWS') for row in execution_rows: lines.append(row['phase'] + ' | ' + row['script'] + ' | returncode=' + str(row['returncode']) + ' | ' + row['status']) lines.append('') lines.append('PHASE OUTPUTS') for row in phase_outputs: lines.append(row['phase'] + ' | verify=' + row['verify_status'] + ' | audit=' + row['audit_status']) lines.append('') lines.append('MASTER TESTS') for test in tests: lines.append(test['test_id'] + ' | ' + test['slutresultat'] + ' | ' + test['title']) lines.append('WHAT: ' + test['vad_som_testas']) lines.append('HOW: ' + test['hur_det_testas']) lines.append('WHY: ' + test['varfor_det_testas']) lines.append('RESULT: ' + test['observerat_resultat']) lines.append('') return '\n'.join(lines) def write_master_outputs(out_dir, summary, tests, execution_rows, phase_outputs): payload = { 'SUMMARY': summary, 'VALIDATORS': VALIDATORS, 'EXECUTION_ROWS': execution_rows, 'PHASE_OUTPUTS': phase_outputs, 'TESTS': tests } trace_payload = { 'TRACE': tests, 'EXECUTION_ROWS': execution_rows } audit_payload = { 'AUDIT': { 'all_tests_include_what_how_why_result': all( all(key in test for key in ['vad_som_testas', 'hur_det_testas', 'varfor_det_testas', 'slutresultat']) for test in tests ), 'master_pipeline_only': True, 'no_new_theory_introduced': True, 'validators': VALIDATORS, 'global_status': summary['global_status'] } } verify_payload = { 'VERIFY': { 'test_1_validator_presence': tests[0]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'test_2_validator_execution': tests[1]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'test_3_verify_control': tests[2]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'test_4_audit_control': tests[3]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'test_5_global_chain_status': tests[4]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'test_6_master_consistency': tests[5]['slutresultat'] == 'PASS', 'global_status': summary['global_status'] } } write_json(out_dir / 'rp9_rx8_master_data.json', payload) write_json(out_dir / 'rp9_rx8_master_trace.json', trace_payload) write_json(out_dir / 'rp9_rx8_master_audit.json', audit_payload) write_json(out_dir / 'rp9_rx8_master_verify.json', verify_payload) markdown = build_markdown(summary, tests, execution_rows, phase_outputs) write_text(out_dir / 'rp9_rx8_master_presentation.md', markdown) control_log = build_control_log(summary, tests, execution_rows, phase_outputs, out_dir) write_text(out_dir / 'rp9_rx8_master_control_log.txt', control_log) def run_pipeline(): out_dir = make_output_dir() base_dir = Path.cwd() tests = [] presence_test = test_1_validator_presence(base_dir) tests.append(presence_test) execution_rows = execute_validators(base_dir) tests.append(test_2_validator_execution(execution_rows)) phase_outputs = collect_phase_outputs(base_dir) tests.append(test_3_verify_control(phase_outputs)) tests.append(test_4_audit_control(phase_outputs)) tests.append(test_5_global_chain_status(phase_outputs)) tests.append(test_6_master_consistency(tests)) global_pass_pre_report = all(test['slutresultat'] == 'PASS' for test in tests) summary = { 'system': 'RP9_RX8', 'phase': 'FAS_6_MASTER_VALIDATION_PIPELINE', 'script': SCRIPT_NAME, 'version': SCRIPT_VERSION, 'generated_at': now_iso(), 'global_status': status(global_pass_pre_report), 'principle': 'Master pipeline orchestrates existing validators only.', 'validation_boundary': 'No new relation, no new geometry, no new residual theory.' } write_master_outputs(out_dir, summary, tests, execution_rows, phase_outputs) tests.append(test_7_master_revision_report(out_dir)) global_pass = all(test['slutresultat'] == 'PASS' for test in tests) summary['global_status'] = status(global_pass) write_master_outputs(out_dir, summary, tests, execution_rows, phase_outputs) print('=' * 72) print('RP9 RX8 MASTER VALIDATION PIPELINE') print('STATUS:', summary['global_status']) print('OUTPUT:', out_dir) print('=' * 72) for test in tests: print(test['test_id'] + ' | ' + test['slutresultat'] + ' | ' + test['title']) print('=' * 72) if not global_pass: return 1 return 0 if __name__ == '__main__': exit_code = run_pipeline() sys.exit(exit_code) ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.
