RELATION VS REPRESENTATION RP9 FINAL RELATION VS REPRESENTATION verifies the difference between:Representation andRelation The purpose of the code is to show that the same structure can be described in two different ways:As a numerical value orAs a functional relationship without changing the underlying structure.This layer verifies:Relation versus representation The focus is not on creating new proportions.The focus is on distinguishing:Measurement fromInterpretation and:Numerical value fromStructural function The code compares two different readings of the same object.Example:√2 π φ 3/4 For each object, the following is recorded:Classical representation RP9 function Dimensional role Relational function At the same time, an exact H-D-R sequence is executed where:H = r / 4 D = h × 4 R = d / 2 is iterated through several levels.Previous layers establish:Differentiation Residual Proportion However, these layers do not answer the question:How should the results be read? RP9 FINAL RELATION VS REPRESENTATION therefore serves as the method boundary between:Representation andRelation The layer explicitly defines that:Representation describes the value. Relation describes the function. The following checks are performed:A. Constant comparison B. H-D-R iterations C. Vesica relation D. Diagonal relation E. Area ratio F. Comparison matrix G. Final method check All steps are documented in JSON, Markdown and control log.Expected observation:The scale changes but:3/4 remains throughout the entire H-D-R sequence.Expected conclusion:Representation varies Relation remains The verification shows that:R R/2 R/4 R/8 R/16 continues to produce:3/4 as exact relation.The control chain shows:Area ratio = 3/4 All iterations = PASS Relation invariant Despite:Radius Diagonal Vesica height changing between iterations.The code verifies that:Representation andRelation are not the same thing.Numeric values ​​change.The core relational structure:3/4 remains unchanged.The conclusion is therefore that:Relation precedes representation. The code generates:rp9_final_relation_vs_representation_data.json rp9_final_relation_vs_representation_presentation.md rp9_final_relation_vs_representation_control_log.txt and associated Python code.FIRST DIFFERENTIATION establishes:The first relation. RESIDUAL VALUE establishes:The first residual. RELATION VS REPRESENTATION establishes:How the relation should be separated from its representation. The next layer can therefore focus on the structure itself without mixing:Object Relation Representation which makes this layer the methodological bridge in K1 META. ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.

README # RP9_RESIDUAL_ALL_IN_ONE_PRESENTATION.py # Version: 2.0 # File type: Python # Purpose: # - All-in-one residual verification for R15 / R16. # - Writes JSON data, trace JSON, Markdown report, control log and execution log. # - Uses standard library only. No numpy dependency. # - Keeps measurement and RP9 interpretation separated for review. import json import datetime import math import sys from pathlib import Path SCRIPT_VERSION = 'RP9_RESIDUAL_VALUE' OUTPUT_DIR_NAME = 'RP9_RESIDUAL_VALUE' def get_base_dir(): try: return Path(__file__).resolve().parent except NameError: return Path.cwd() BASE_DIR = get_base_dir() OUTPUT_DIR = BASE_DIR / OUTPUT_DIR_NAME def now_stamp(): return datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') def iso_stamp(): return datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds') def ensure_output_dir(): OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) def as_float_text(value): return format(float(value), '.20e') def as_plain_text(value): return str(value) def json_safe(value): if isinstance(value, dict): return {str(k): json_safe(v) for k, v in value.items()} if isinstance(value, list): return [json_safe(v) for v in value] if isinstance(value, tuple): return [json_safe(v) for v in value] if isinstance(value, Path): return str(value) if isinstance(value, bool): return bool(value) if isinstance(value, int): return int(value) if isinstance(value, float): if math.isnan(value): return 'NaN' if math.isinf(value): return 'Infinity' if value > 0 else '-Infinity' return float(value) return value def write_text_file(path, lines): path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) path.write_text('\n'.join(lines) + '\n', encoding='utf-8') def write_json_file(path, payload): path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) safe_payload = json_safe(payload) path.write_text(json.dumps(safe_payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8') def make_trace_step(step, operation, formula, inputs, result, status, note): return { 'step': int(step), 'timestamp': iso_stamp(), 'operation': operation, 'formula': formula, 'inputs': inputs, 'result': result, 'status': status, 'note': note } def run_measurements(): trace = [] eps = sys.float_info.epsilon trace.append(make_trace_step( 1, 'read_machine_epsilon', 'sys.float_info.epsilon', {}, { 'epsilon_decimal': as_plain_text(eps), 'epsilon_scientific': as_float_text(eps), 'epsilon_expected_power': '2^-52' }, 'PASS', 'Reads IEEE754 double precision machine epsilon from Python standard library.' )) r16 = eps trace.append(make_trace_step( 2, 'assign_r16', 'R16 = epsilon', {'epsilon': as_float_text(eps)}, { 'r16': as_float_text(r16), 'r16_power': '2^-52' }, 'PASS', 'Defines R16 as machine epsilon for double precision.' )) r15 = r16 * 8.0 trace.append(make_trace_step( 3, 'calculate_r15', 'R15 = R16 * 8', { 'r16': as_float_text(r16), 'factor': '8' }, { 'r15': as_float_text(r15), 'r15_power': '2^-49' }, 'PASS', 'Calculates R15 as three binary steps larger than R16.' )) quotient = r15 / r16 quotient_passed = bool(quotient == 8.0) trace.append(make_trace_step( 4, 'calculate_quotient', 'R15 / R16', { 'r15': as_float_text(r15), 'r16': as_float_text(r16) }, { 'quotient': as_plain_text(quotient), 'expected': '8.0' }, 'PASS' if quotient_passed else 'FAIL', 'Verifies that the R15/R16 relation gives exact quotient 8.0.' )) power_52 = 2.0 ** -52 power_49 = 2.0 ** -49 power_quotient = power_49 / power_52 power_passed = bool(power_quotient == 8.0) trace.append(make_trace_step( 5, 'direct_power_verification', '(2.0**-49) / (2.0**-52)', { '2^-52': as_float_text(power_52), '2^-49': as_float_text(power_49) }, { 'quotient': as_plain_text(power_quotient), 'expected': '8.0' }, 'PASS' if power_passed else 'FAIL', 'Direct verification using powers of two.' )) x = 1.0 next_x = math.nextafter(x, 2.0) diff_r16 = next_x - x nextafter_passed = bool(diff_r16 == r16) trace.append(make_trace_step( 6, 'nextafter_practical_verification', 'math.nextafter(1.0, 2.0) - 1.0', { 'x': '1.0', 'direction': '2.0' }, { 'next_value': as_float_text(next_x), 'diff': as_float_text(diff_r16), 'expected_r16': as_float_text(r16) }, 'PASS' if nextafter_passed else 'FAIL', 'Practical verification of the smallest representable step above 1.0.' )) nextafter_series = [] x_series = 1.0 for i in range(1, 6): next_value = math.nextafter(x_series, 2.0) diff = next_value - x_series nextafter_series.append({ 'step': int(i), 'input_value': as_float_text(x_series), 'next_value': as_float_text(next_value), 'diff': as_float_text(diff) }) x_series = next_value trace.append(make_trace_step( 7, 'nextafter_series', 'repeat math.nextafter(x, 2.0) for 5 steps', { 'start': '1.0', 'steps': '5' }, {'series': nextafter_series}, 'PASS', 'Shows several consecutive representable float values around 1.0.' )) scale_series = [] for exp in range(-3, 4): value = 1.0 * (2.0 ** exp) local_eps_estimate = eps * abs(value) scale_series.append({ 'power': '2^' + str(exp), 'value': as_float_text(value), 'local_epsilon_estimate': as_float_text(local_eps_estimate) }) trace.append(make_trace_step( 8, 'scale_demo', 'local_eps = sys.float_info.epsilon * abs(value)', {'range': '2^-3 to 2^3'}, {'series': scale_series}, 'PASS', 'Shows how machine epsilon scales with magnitude as an estimate.' )) total_passed = bool(quotient_passed and power_passed and nextafter_passed) payload = { 'script': { 'name': SCRIPT_VERSION, 'created_at': now_stamp(), 'purpose': 'All-in-one presentation and verification code for RP9 residual R15/R16.', 'method': 'IEEE754 double precision inspection using Python standard library.', 'review_design': 'Measurement, trace, presentation, control log and RP9 interpretation are separated.', 'dependency_note': 'No external packages required.' }, 'measurement': { 'name': 'R15_R16_RESIDUAL_VERIFICATION', 'machine_epsilon': { 'value': as_float_text(eps), 'definition': 'sys.float_info.epsilon', 'power_relation': '2^-52' }, 'r16': { 'value': as_float_text(r16), 'definition': 'R16 = epsilon', 'power_relation': '2^-52' }, 'r15': { 'value': as_float_text(r15), 'definition': 'R15 = R16 * 8', 'power_relation': '2^-49' }, 'quotient': { 'formula': 'R15 / R16', 'value': as_plain_text(quotient), 'expected': '8.0', 'passed': bool(quotient_passed) }, 'direct_power_check': { 'formula': '(2.0**-49) / (2.0**-52)', 'value': as_plain_text(power_quotient), 'expected': '8.0', 'passed': bool(power_passed) }, 'nextafter_check': { 'formula': 'math.nextafter(1.0, 2.0) - 1.0', 'value': as_float_text(diff_r16), 'expected': as_float_text(r16), 'passed': bool(nextafter_passed) }, 'nextafter_series': nextafter_series, 'scale_series': scale_series, 'total_status': 'PASS' if total_passed else 'FAIL' }, 'relation_chain': { 'r16': '2^-52', 'r15': '2^-49', 'binary_step_difference': '3', 'ratio': '2^3 = 8', 'review_note': 'This is a machine precision relation measured inside IEEE754 double precision.' }, 'rp9_interpretation_layer': { 'separated_from_measurement': True, 'interpretation': 'The quotient 8.0 can be related to octal structure and Base 8 as an RP9 interpretation.', 'important_boundary': 'The measurement verifies R15/R16 = 8.0. The RP9 interpretation is a separate layer.' } } return payload, trace def build_markdown(payload): m = payload['measurement'] lines = [] lines.append('---') lines.append('# RP9 RESIDUAL VERIFICATION') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## Purpose') lines.append('') lines.append('This file presents a reviewable verification of the relation between R15 and R16.') lines.append('') lines.append('The measurement layer is separated from the RP9 interpretation layer.') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## Measurement') lines.append('') lines.append('| Object | Definition | Value |') lines.append('|---|---|---|') lines.append('| Machine epsilon | `sys.float_info.epsilon` | `' + m['machine_epsilon']['value'] + '` |') lines.append('| R16 | `R16 = epsilon` | `' + m['r16']['value'] + '` |') lines.append('| R15 | `R15 = R16 * 8` | `' + m['r15']['value'] + '` |') lines.append('| Quotient | `R15 / R16` | `' + m['quotient']['value'] + '` |') lines.append('| Direct power quotient | `(2.0**-49) / (2.0**-52)` | `' + m['direct_power_check']['value'] + '` |') lines.append('| Practical nextafter diff | `math.nextafter(1.0, 2.0) - 1.0` | `' + m['nextafter_check']['value'] + '` |') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## Control status') lines.append('') lines.append('| Control | Expected | Result | Status |') lines.append('|---|---|---|---|') lines.append('| R15 / R16 | `8.0` | `' + m['quotient']['value'] + '` | `' + str(m['quotient']['passed']) + '` |') lines.append('| Powers of two | `8.0` | `' + m['direct_power_check']['value'] + '` | `' + str(m['direct_power_check']['passed']) + '` |') lines.append('| Nextafter | `R16` | `' + m['nextafter_check']['value'] + '` | `' + str(m['nextafter_check']['passed']) + '` |') lines.append('') lines.append('**Total status:** `' + m['total_status'] + '`') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## Nextafter series around 1.0') lines.append('') lines.append('| Step | Input | Next representable value | Difference |') lines.append('|---|---|---|---|') for row in m['nextafter_series']: lines.append('| ' + str(row['step']) + ' | `' + row['input_value'] + '` | `' + row['next_value'] + '` | `' + row['diff'] + '` |') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## Scale demonstration') lines.append('') lines.append('| Power | Value | Local epsilon estimate |') lines.append('|---|---|---|') for row in m['scale_series']: lines.append('| `' + row['power'] + '` | `' + row['value'] + '` | `' + row['local_epsilon_estimate'] + '` |') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## Relation chain') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('R16 = 2^-52') lines.append('R15 = 2^-49') lines.append('R15 / R16 = 2^3 = 8') lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## RP9 interpretation layer') lines.append('') lines.append('The measurement verifies the machine relation `R15 / R16 = 8.0`.') lines.append('') lines.append('The RP9 interpretation relates this quotient to octal structure and Base 8.') lines.append('') lines.append('This interpretation layer is separated from the measurement layer for review quality.') lines.append('') lines.append('---') return lines def build_control_log(payload, trace): lines = [] m = payload['measurement'] lines.append('RP9 RESIDUAL CONTROL LOG') lines.append('=' * 72) lines.append('Created at: ' + payload['script']['created_at']) lines.append('Script version: ' + payload['script']['name']) lines.append('') lines.append('WHAT WAS MEASURED') lines.append('-' * 72) lines.append('- Machine epsilon for IEEE754 double precision.') lines.append('- R16 as epsilon.') lines.append('- R15 as epsilon multiplied by 8.') lines.append('- Quotient R15 / R16.') lines.append('- Direct power quotient (2^-49) / (2^-52).') lines.append('- Practical nextafter difference around 1.0.') lines.append('- Local epsilon scaling across powers 2^-3 to 2^3.') lines.append('') lines.append('HOW IT WAS MEASURED') lines.append('-' * 72) for step in trace: lines.append('STEP ' + str(step['step']).zfill(3)) lines.append('Operation: ' + step['operation']) lines.append('Formula: ' + step['formula']) lines.append('Status: ' + step['status']) lines.append('Note: ' + step['note']) lines.append('') lines.append('CONTROL RESULT') lines.append('-' * 72) lines.append('R16: ' + m['r16']['value']) lines.append('R15: ' + m['r15']['value']) lines.append('Quotient: ' + m['quotient']['value']) lines.append('Total status: ' + m['total_status']) lines.append('') lines.append('BOUNDARY') lines.append('-' * 72) lines.append('Measurement: R15 / R16 = 8.0') lines.append('Interpretation: RP9 relates 8.0 to octal structure.') lines.append('The measurement and interpretation are intentionally separated.') return lines def write_all_outputs(payload, trace): ensure_output_dir() json_path = OUTPUT_DIR / 'rp9_residual_data.json' trace_path = OUTPUT_DIR / 'rp9_residual_trace.json' markdown_path = OUTPUT_DIR / 'rp9_residual_presentation.md' control_path = OUTPUT_DIR / 'rp9_residual_control_log.txt' execution_path = OUTPUT_DIR / 'rp9_residual_execution.log' write_json_file(json_path, payload) write_json_file(trace_path, trace) write_text_file(markdown_path, build_markdown(payload)) write_text_file(control_path, build_control_log(payload, trace)) log_lines = [] log_lines.append('RP9 RESIDUAL EXECUTION LOG') log_lines.append('=' * 72) log_lines.append('Timestamp: ' + now_stamp()) log_lines.append('Status: ' + payload['measurement']['total_status']) log_lines.append('JSON: ' + str(json_path)) log_lines.append('Trace: ' + str(trace_path)) log_lines.append('Markdown: ' + str(markdown_path)) log_lines.append('Control log: ' + str(control_path)) write_text_file(execution_path, log_lines) return { 'json': json_path, 'trace': trace_path, 'markdown': markdown_path, 'control': control_path, 'execution': execution_path } def print_summary(payload): m = payload['measurement'] print('') print('=' * 72) print('RP9 RESIDUAL SUMMARY') print('=' * 72) print('R16:', m['r16']['value']) print('R15:', m['r15']['value']) print('R15 / R16:', m['quotient']['value']) print('Direct power check:', m['direct_power_check']['value']) print('Nextafter diff:', m['nextafter_check']['value']) print('Total status:', m['total_status']) print('=' * 72) print('') def print_nextafter(payload): print('') print('=' * 72) print('NEXTAFTER SERIES AROUND 1.0') print('=' * 72) for row in payload['measurement']['nextafter_series']: print('Step', row['step']) print(' Input:', row['input_value']) print(' Next :', row['next_value']) print(' Diff :', row['diff']) print('=' * 72) print('') def print_scale(payload): print('') print('=' * 72) print('SCALE DEMO') print('=' * 72) for row in payload['measurement']['scale_series']: print(row['power'], '-> value:', row['value'], '| local eps:', row['local_epsilon_estimate']) print('=' * 72) print('') def print_paths(paths): print('') print('FILES WRITTEN') print('-' * 72) print('JSON data :', paths['json']) print('Trace JSON :', paths['trace']) print('Markdown :', paths['markdown']) print('Control log :', paths['control']) print('Execution log :', paths['execution']) print('') def run_all(): payload, trace = run_measurements() paths = write_all_outputs(payload, trace) return payload, trace, paths def interactive_menu(): payload, trace, paths = run_all() print_summary(payload) print_paths(paths) while True: print('') print('=' * 72) print('RP9 - ALL IN ONE RESIDUAL PRESENTATION') print('=' * 72) print('1. Visa grundsammanfattning') print('2. Visa nextafter-serie runt 1.0') print('3. Visa skalningsdemonstration') print('4. Visa alla') print('5. Skriv om alla exportfiler') print('6. Visa exportvagar') print('0. Avsluta') print('') choice = input('Ditt val (0-6): ').strip() if choice == '1': print_summary(payload) elif choice == '2': print_nextafter(payload) elif choice == '3': print_scale(payload) elif choice == '4': print_summary(payload) print_nextafter(payload) print_scale(payload) print_paths(paths) elif choice == '5': payload, trace, paths = run_all() print('Alla exportfiler skrevs om.') print_paths(paths) elif choice == '6': print_paths(paths) elif choice == '0': print('Avslutar.') break else: print('Ogiltigt val.') input('Tryck Enter for att fortsatta...') def run_once_mode(): payload, trace, paths = run_all() print_summary(payload) print_paths(paths) return payload, trace, paths def main(): exit_code = 0 try: if '--run-once' in sys.argv: run_once_mode() else: interactive_menu() except KeyboardInterrupt: print('') print('Avbrutet av anvandaren.') exit_code = 130 except Exception as exc: ensure_output_dir() error_path = OUTPUT_DIR / 'rp9_residual_error.log' lines = [] lines.append('RP9 RESIDUAL ERROR LOG') lines.append('=' * 72) lines.append('Timestamp: ' + now_stamp()) lines.append('Error type: ' + type(exc).__name__) lines.append('Error message: ' + str(exc)) write_text_file(error_path, lines) print('ERROR:', str(exc)) print('Error log written to:', error_path) exit_code = 1 finally: if '--run-once' not in sys.argv: input('Tryck Enter for att stanga...') return exit_code if __name__ == '__main__': raise SystemExit(main()) ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.

LINK — 🔗. K1. 2. B. PRS. Residual values RP9 RESIDUAL VALUE verifies the numerical residual structure that occurs in the machine's own representation.The purpose of the code is to establish the relationship between:R16 and R15 and verify that their quotient is exact:8 within IEEE754 double precision.This layer verifies:Residual rather than:Geometry The focus is not on shape or structure.The focus is on the smallest measurable difference in the machine representation.The code tests:Machine epsilon which is defined as:R16 = 2^-52 Then it derives:R15 = R16 × 8 which gives:R15 = 2^-49 Finally it verifies:R15 / R16 = 8 through several independent verification methods.FIRST DIFFERENTIATION establishes:3/4 ↔ 1/4 as the first relational division.RP9 RESIDUAL VALUE then verifies that the residual concept also exists in the numerical representation level.The store therefore acts as a bridge between:Relation andRepresentation The following checks are performed:A. Machine epsilon B. R16 definition C. R15 calculation D. Quotient check E. Power check F. Nextafter verification G. Scaling verification All tests are separated from the RP9 interpretation.Expected structure:R16 = 2^-52 R15 = 2^-49 R15 / R16 = 8 Expected status:PASS The verification shows:R16 = 2.22044604925031308085e−16 R15 = 1.77635683940025046468e−15 The quotient is verified as:8.0 by:Direct division Power check Nextafter verification All checks pass.Final status:PASS The code verifies that the relation:R15 / R16 = 8 is a reproducible property of IEEE754 double precision.The measurement is verified.The RP9 interpretation is kept separate from the measurement store.The code generates:rp9_residual_data.json rp9_residual_trace.json rp9_residual_presentation.md rp9_residual_control_log.txt rp9_residual_execution.log and associated Python code.FIRST DIFFERENTIATION establishes:Differentiation RP9 RESIDUAL VALUE establishes:Residual The next layer examines how the residual can be related to structure and representation in the continued K1 chain.RP9 RESIDUAL VALUE therefore functions as the transition between:Geometric relation andNumeric representation. ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.

item.description:
Quote DOCUMENT — id: K1. META. README FOLDER — Name META GROUP 1-5 GROUP id — Name: FIRST DIFFERENTIATION GROUP id — Number: GROUP ID. K1. 01
LINK 🔗. GROUP ID. K1. 01
LINK — 🔗. K1. 2. A. README # FIRST_DIFFERENTIATION_all_inclusive.py # Version: 1.0.0 # Purpose: # - All-in-one presentation and verification code for RP9 FIRST DIFFERENTIATION. # - No HTML rendering. # - Generates JSON data, JSON trace, full datasheet, Markdown, control log, execution log, audit and verify files. # - Separates measurement from interpretation for review quality. import argparse import datetime import hashlib import json import math import platform import sys import traceback from decimal import Decimal, getcontext from fractions import Fraction from pathlib import Path getcontext().prec = 80 SCRIPT_NAME = "RP9_FIRST_DIFFERENTIATION.py" SCRIPT_VERSION = "1.0.0" OUTPUT_DIR_NAME = "RP9_FIRST_DIFFERENTIATION" def now_local(): return datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") def now_utc_iso(): return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z" def script_dir(): try: return Path(__file__).resolve().parent except NameError: return Path.cwd().resolve() BASE_DIR = script_dir() OUTPUT_DIR = BASE_DIR / OUTPUT_DIR_NAME def ensure_output_dir(): OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) def decimal_from_fraction(value, places): d = Decimal(value.numerator) / Decimal(value.denominator) return format(d, "." + str(places) + "f") def sci(value, digits=20): return format(float(value), "." + str(digits) + "e") def json_safe(obj): if isinstance(obj, dict): return {str(k): json_safe(v) for k, v in obj.items()} if isinstance(obj, list): return [json_safe(v) for v in obj] if isinstance(obj, tuple): return [json_safe(v) for v in obj] if isinstance(obj, Path): return str(obj) if isinstance(obj, Fraction): return str(obj) if isinstance(obj, Decimal): return str(obj) if isinstance(obj, bool): return bool(obj) if isinstance(obj, int): return int(obj) if isinstance(obj, float): return float(obj) if obj is None: return None return obj def write_text(path, lines): path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8") def write_json(path, payload): path.write_text(json.dumps(json_safe(payload), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8") def sha256_file(path): h = hashlib.sha256() with path.open("rb") as f: while True: chunk = f.read(1024 * 1024) if not chunk: break h.update(chunk) return h.hexdigest() def make_trace(index, layer, operation, formula, inputs, result, status, note): return { "index": int(index), "timestamp_utc": now_utc_iso(), "layer": str(layer), "operation": str(operation), "formula": str(formula), "inputs": json_safe(inputs), "result": json_safe(result), "status": str(status), "note": str(note) } def append_audit(audit_entries, action, status, details): audit_entries.append({ "index": len(audit_entries) + 1, "timestamp_utc": now_utc_iso(), "action": str(action), "status": str(status), "details": json_safe(details) }) def compute_first_structure(trace): layer = "A_FIRST_STRUCTURE" r = Fraction(1, 1) d = Fraction(1, 1) ri_squared = r * r - (d / 2) * (d / 2) ri_float = math.sqrt(float(ri_squared)) ay_float = math.pi * float(r * r) ai_float = math.pi * float(ri_squared) ratio_float = ai_float / ay_float lock_float = 1.0 - ratio_float ratio_expected = Fraction(3, 4) lock_expected = Fraction(1, 4) ratio_float_residual = ratio_float - float(ratio_expected) lock_float_residual = lock_float - float(lock_expected) steps = [ {"index": 1, "title": "POTENTIAL FORM", "formula": "r = 1", "structural_role": "Potential form before self-relation."}, {"index": 2, "title": "SPHERICAL SELF-RELATION", "formula": "D = R", "structural_role": "The sphere measures itself through equal-radius displacement."}, {"index": 3, "title": "VESICA PISCIS", "formula": "P1, P2 = A intersect B", "structural_role": "The first intersection pair becomes readable."}, {"index": 4, "title": "INTERSECTION RADIUS", "formula": "ri^2 = R^2 - (D/2)^2", "structural_role": "The intersection radius is derived from equal-sphere relation."}, {"index": 5, "title": "AREA COMPARISON", "formula": "AY = pi * R^2 ; AI = pi * ri^2", "structural_role": "Area relation becomes measurable."}, {"index": 6, "title": "PRIMARY RELATION", "formula": "AI / AY = 3/4", "structural_role": "The primary relation locks as three fourths."}, {"index": 7, "title": "LOCKED DIFFERENTIAL", "formula": "1 - 3/4 = 1/4", "structural_role": "The remaining differential is one fourth."} ] trace.append(make_trace(len(trace) + 1, layer, "define_radius", "R = 1", {}, {"R": str(r)}, "PASS", "Defines the first measurable relation.")) trace.append(make_trace(len(trace) + 1, layer, "define_distance", "D = 1", {"R": str(r)}, {"D": str(d)}, "PASS", "Defines equal-radius self-relation distance.")) trace.append(make_trace(len(trace) + 1, layer, "calculate_intersection_radius_squared", "ri^2 = R^2 - (D/2)^2", {"R": str(r), "D": str(d)}, {"ri_squared": str(ri_squared), "ri_symbolic": "sqrt(3)/2"}, "PASS", "Computes the squared intersection radius with exact Fraction arithmetic.")) trace.append(make_trace(len(trace) + 1, layer, "calculate_area_ratio", "AI / AY = (pi * ri^2) / (pi * R^2)", {"ri_squared": str(ri_squared), "R_squared": str(r * r)}, {"ratio_exact": str(ri_squared / (r * r)), "ratio_expected": "3/4"}, "PASS", "Pi cancels in the exact ratio.")) return { "layer_name": layer, "purpose": "Defines the first structural differentiation from self-relation to locked differential.", "core_values": { "R_exact": str(r), "D_exact": str(d), "RI_squared_exact": str(ri_squared), "RI_symbolic": "sqrt(3)/2", "RI_float": sci(ri_float), "AY_formula": "pi * R^2", "AY_float": sci(ay_float), "AI_formula": "pi * RI^2", "AI_float": sci(ai_float), "RATIO_exact": str(ratio_expected), "RATIO_float_rendering": sci(ratio_float), "LOCK_exact": str(lock_expected), "LOCK_float_rendering": sci(lock_float), "RATIO_float_minus_0_75": sci(ratio_float_residual), "LOCK_float_minus_0_25": sci(lock_float_residual) }, "steps": steps, "status": "PASS" } def compute_exact_ratio_test(trace): layer = "B_EXACT_RATIO_TEST" r = Fraction(1, 1) d = Fraction(1, 1) ri_squared = r * r - (d / 2) * (d / 2) ratio_exact = ri_squared / (r * r) lock_exact = Fraction(1, 1) - ratio_exact ratio_float = float(ratio_exact) lock_float = float(lock_exact) ratio_residual = Fraction.from_float(ratio_float) - ratio_exact lock_residual = Fraction.from_float(lock_float) - lock_exact passed = ratio_exact == Fraction(3, 4) and lock_exact == Fraction(1, 4) and ratio_residual == 0 and lock_residual == 0 trace.append(make_trace(len(trace) + 1, layer, "exact_fraction_geometry", "R=1 ; D=1 ; ri^2=R^2-(D/2)^2", {"R": str(r), "D": str(d)}, {"ri_squared": str(ri_squared)}, "PASS", "Uses Fraction arithmetic only.")) trace.append(make_trace(len(trace) + 1, layer, "exact_fraction_ratio", "ratio = ri^2 / R^2", {"ri_squared": str(ri_squared), "R_squared": str(r * r)}, {"ratio_exact": str(ratio_exact)}, "PASS", "Verifies exact 3/4 without float.")) trace.append(make_trace(len(trace) + 1, layer, "exact_lock", "lock = 1 - ratio", {"ratio_exact": str(ratio_exact)}, {"lock_exact": str(lock_exact)}, "PASS", "Verifies exact 1/4 without float.")) trace.append(make_trace(len(trace) + 1, layer, "float_residual_against_exact_fraction", "Fraction.from_float(float(value)) - exact", {"ratio_float": ratio_float, "lock_float": lock_float}, {"ratio_residual": str(ratio_residual), "lock_residual": str(lock_residual)}, "PASS" if passed else "FAIL", "Checks whether exact 3/4 and 1/4 survive normal binary float conversion.")) return { "layer_name": layer, "purpose": "Exact geometric reference layer.", "input": {"R": str(r), "D": str(d)}, "exact_geometry": { "RI_squared": str(ri_squared), "AI_over_AY_fraction": str(ratio_exact), "AI_over_AY_percent": "75", "LOCK_fraction": str(lock_exact), "LOCK_percent": "25" }, "decimal_rendering": { "AI_over_AY_16_places": decimal_from_fraction(ratio_exact, 16), "LOCK_16_places": decimal_from_fraction(lock_exact, 16) }, "float_rendering": {"AI_over_AY_float": ratio_float, "LOCK_float": lock_float}, "float_residual_against_exact": { "AI_over_AY_residual_fraction": str(ratio_residual), "AI_over_AY_residual_float": float(ratio_residual), "LOCK_residual_fraction": str(lock_residual), "LOCK_residual_float": float(lock_residual) }, "status": "PASS" if passed else "FAIL" } def compute_ieee_probe(trace): layer = "C_IEEE_RESIDUAL_PROBE" values = [] cases = [ ("decimal_addition", "0.1 + 0.2", 0.1 + 0.2, 0.3, "Classic binary float decimal representation check."), ("sin_pi", "math.sin(math.pi)", math.sin(math.pi), 0.0, "Checks transcendental rendering near zero."), ("tan_pi", "math.tan(math.pi)", math.tan(math.pi), 0.0, "Checks tangent rendering near zero at pi."), ("sqrt2_squared_minus_2", "math.sqrt(2)**2 - 2", math.sqrt(2) ** 2 - 2.0, 0.0, "Checks square-root roundtrip residual.") ] for name, expression, observed, expected, note in cases: residual = observed - expected is_close = math.isclose(observed, expected, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=1e-15) row = {"name": name, "expression": expression, "observed": sci(observed), "expected": sci(expected), "residual": sci(residual), "is_close_abs_1e_minus_15": bool(is_close), "note": note} values.append(row) trace.append(make_trace(len(trace) + 1, layer, name, expression, {}, row, "PASS" if is_close else "REVIEW", note)) eps = sys.float_info.epsilon r16 = eps r15 = eps * 8.0 quotient = r15 / r16 quotient_passed = bool(quotient == 8.0) next_value = math.nextafter(1.0, 2.0) next_diff = next_value - 1.0 next_passed = bool(next_diff == r16) trace.append(make_trace(len(trace) + 1, layer, "machine_epsilon", "sys.float_info.epsilon", {}, {"epsilon": sci(eps), "power_relation": "2^-52"}, "PASS", "Reads Python float machine epsilon.")) trace.append(make_trace(len(trace) + 1, layer, "r15_r16_ratio", "(epsilon * 8) / epsilon", {"r16": sci(r16), "r15": sci(r15)}, {"quotient": str(quotient)}, "PASS" if quotient_passed else "FAIL", "Verifies R15/R16 quotient in binary precision.")) trace.append(make_trace(len(trace) + 1, layer, "nextafter", "math.nextafter(1.0, 2.0) - 1.0", {"start": "1.0", "direction": "2.0"}, {"next_value": sci(next_value), "diff": sci(next_diff)}, "PASS" if next_passed else "FAIL", "Checks the next representable float above 1.0.")) passed = quotient_passed and next_passed return { "layer_name": layer, "purpose": "Control group for IEEE-754 style float behaviour using Python float.", "float_cases": values, "machine_precision": { "epsilon": sci(eps), "R16": sci(r16), "R15": sci(r15), "R15_div_R16": str(quotient), "R15_div_R16_passed": quotient_passed, "nextafter_1_to_2": sci(next_value), "nextafter_diff": sci(next_diff), "nextafter_matches_R16": next_passed }, "status": "PASS" if passed else "REVIEW" } def compute_final_float_lock(trace): layer = "D_FINAL_FLOAT_LOCK" r = 1.0 d = 1.0 ri = math.sqrt((r * r) - ((d / 2.0) * (d / 2.0))) ay = math.pi * r * r ai = math.pi * ri * ri ratio = ai / ay lock = 1.0 - ratio ratio_target = 0.75 lock_target = 0.25 ratio_residual = ratio - ratio_target lock_residual = lock - lock_target ratio_next_down = math.nextafter(ratio, 0.0) ratio_next_up = math.nextafter(ratio, 1.0) lock_next_down = math.nextafter(lock, 0.0) lock_next_up = math.nextafter(lock, 1.0) symmetric_residual = bool(abs(ratio_residual + lock_residual) <= 1e-30) ratio_is_lower = bool(ratio < ratio_target) lock_is_higher = bool(lock > lock_target) confirmed = symmetric_residual and ratio_is_lower and lock_is_higher trace.append(make_trace(len(trace) + 1, layer, "float_geometry", "ri = sqrt(R^2 - (D/2)^2)", {"R": sci(r), "D": sci(d)}, {"RI": sci(ri)}, "PASS", "Runs the same geometry through binary float path.")) trace.append(make_trace(len(trace) + 1, layer, "float_area_ratio", "ratio = (pi * RI^2) / (pi * R^2)", {"AI": sci(ai), "AY": sci(ay)}, {"ratio": sci(ratio), "lock": sci(lock)}, "PASS", "Computes visible float rendering of 3/4 and 1/4.")) trace.append(make_trace(len(trace) + 1, layer, "float_lock_residual", "ratio - 0.75 ; lock - 0.25", {"ratio": sci(ratio), "lock": sci(lock)}, {"ratio_residual": sci(ratio_residual), "lock_residual": sci(lock_residual)}, "PASS" if confirmed else "REVIEW", "Checks symmetric float lock residual.")) classification = "SYMMETRIC_FLOAT_LOCK_CONFIRMED" if confirmed else "FLOAT_LOCK_REVIEW_REQUIRED" return { "layer_name": layer, "purpose": "Final float-path confirmation of the locked differential rendering.", "float_geometry": {"R": sci(r), "D": sci(d), "RI": sci(ri), "AY": sci(ay), "AI": sci(ai)}, "float_lock": { "ratio_observed": sci(ratio), "ratio_expected": sci(ratio_target), "ratio_residual": sci(ratio_residual), "ratio_hex": ratio.hex(), "ratio_next_down": sci(ratio_next_down), "ratio_next_up": sci(ratio_next_up), "lock_observed": sci(lock), "lock_expected": sci(lock_target), "lock_residual": sci(lock_residual), "lock_hex": lock.hex(), "lock_next_down": sci(lock_next_down), "lock_next_up": sci(lock_next_up) }, "classification": {"ratio_is_lower_than_0_75": ratio_is_lower, "lock_is_higher_than_0_25": lock_is_higher, "symmetric_residual": symmetric_residual, "classification": classification}, "status": "PASS" if confirmed else "REVIEW" } def build_master_conclusion(layer_a, layer_b, layer_c, layer_d): statuses = [layer_a["status"], layer_b["status"], layer_c["status"], layer_d["status"]] if any(status == "FAIL" for status in statuses): total = "FAIL" elif any(status == "REVIEW" for status in statuses): total = "PASS_WITH_REVIEW_NOTES" else: total = "PASS" return { "layer_name": "E_MASTER_CONCLUSION", "chain": ["EXACT GEOMETRY", "DECIMAL RENDERING", "IEEE REPRESENTATION", "FLOAT RESIDUAL", "LOCKED DIFFERENTIAL"], "summary": {"first_structure": layer_a["status"], "exact_ratio_test": layer_b["status"], "ieee_probe": layer_c["status"], "final_float_lock": layer_d["status"], "total_status": total}, "measurement_boundary": "The measurement verifies exact geometry and machine representation behaviour. RP9 interpretation is separated below.", "rp9_interpretation_layer": {"separated_from_measurement": True, "interpretation": "FIRST DIFFERENTIATION is presented as the transition from self-relation to exact 3/4 and 1/4, followed by decimal and float rendering behaviour.", "review_note": "The exact geometric relation is independent from the float residual. The float residual belongs to representation behaviour."} } def run_all(): trace = [] layer_a = compute_first_structure(trace) layer_b = compute_exact_ratio_test(trace) layer_c = compute_ieee_probe(trace) layer_d = compute_final_float_lock(trace) conclusion = build_master_conclusion(layer_a, layer_b, layer_c, layer_d) payload = { "script": {"name": SCRIPT_NAME, "version": SCRIPT_VERSION, "created_at_local": now_local(), "created_at_utc": now_utc_iso(), "python_version": sys.version, "platform": platform.platform(), "working_directory": str(BASE_DIR), "output_directory": str(OUTPUT_DIR), "html_rendering": "disabled", "purpose": "All-in-one presentation code for RP9 FIRST DIFFERENTIATION.", "review_design": "Measurement, trace, control log, audit, verify and interpretation layer are separated."}, "layers": {"A_first_structure": layer_a, "B_exact_ratio_test": layer_b, "C_ieee_residual_probe": layer_c, "D_final_float_lock": layer_d, "E_master_conclusion": conclusion} } return payload, trace def build_markdown(payload, trace): layers = payload["layers"] a = layers["A_first_structure"] b = layers["B_exact_ratio_test"] c = layers["C_ieee_residual_probe"] d = layers["D_final_float_lock"] e = layers["E_master_conclusion"] lines = [] lines.append("---") lines.append("# FIRST DIFFERENTIATION") lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("") lines.append("## Syfte") lines.append("") lines.append("Detta dokument sammanför FIRST DIFFERENTIATION som en granskningsbar presentationskod utan HTML-rendering.") lines.append("") lines.append("Mätning, representation, residual och RP9-tolkning hålls separerade.") lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("") lines.append("## Kontrollkedja") lines.append("") lines.append("```text") lines.extend(e["chain"]) lines.append("```") lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("") lines.append("## A. First Structure") lines.append("") lines.append("| Objekt | Värde |") lines.append("|---|---|") for key, value in a["core_values"].items(): lines.append("| " + key + " | `" + str(value) + "` |") lines.append("") lines.append("### Steg") lines.append("") lines.append("| Steg | Titel | Formel | Funktion |") lines.append("|---|---|---|---|") for step in a["steps"]: lines.append("| " + str(step["index"]) + " | " + step["title"] + " | `" + step["formula"] + "` | " + step["structural_role"] + " |") lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("") lines.append("## B. Exact Ratio Test") lines.append("") lines.append("| Objekt | Värde |") lines.append("|---|---|") lines.append("| RI squared | `" + b["exact_geometry"]["RI_squared"] + "` |") lines.append("| AI over AY | `" + b["exact_geometry"]["AI_over_AY_fraction"] + "` |") lines.append("| LOCK | `" + b["exact_geometry"]["LOCK_fraction"] + "` |") lines.append("| Ratio residual | `" + b["float_residual_against_exact"]["AI_over_AY_residual_fraction"] + "` |") lines.append("| Lock residual | `" + b["float_residual_against_exact"]["LOCK_residual_fraction"] + "` |") lines.append("| Status | `" + b["status"] + "` |") lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("") lines.append("## C. IEEE Residual Probe") lines.append("") lines.append("| Test | Uttryck | Observerat | Förväntat | Residual |") lines.append("|---|---|---|---|---|") for row in c["float_cases"]: lines.append("| " + row["name"] + " | `" + row["expression"] + "` | `" + row["observed"] + "` | `" + row["expected"] + "` | `" + row["residual"] + "` |") lines.append("") lines.append("### Machine Precision") lines.append("") lines.append("| Objekt | Värde |") lines.append("|---|---|") for key, value in c["machine_precision"].items(): lines.append("| " + key + " | `" + str(value) + "` |") lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("") lines.append("## D. Final Float Lock") lines.append("") lines.append("| Objekt | Värde |") lines.append("|---|---|") for key, value in d["float_lock"].items(): lines.append("| " + key + " | `" + str(value) + "` |") lines.append("") lines.append("### Klassificering") lines.append("") lines.append("| Kontroll | Värde |") lines.append("|---|---|") for key, value in d["classification"].items(): lines.append("| " + key + " | `" + str(value) + "` |") lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("") lines.append("## E. Master Conclusion") lines.append("") lines.append("| Lager | Status |") lines.append("|---|---|") for key, value in e["summary"].items(): lines.append("| " + key + " | `" + str(value) + "` |") lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("") lines.append("## RP9-tolkningslager") lines.append("") lines.append(e["rp9_interpretation_layer"]["interpretation"]) lines.append("") lines.append("**Granskningsgräns:** " + e["rp9_interpretation_layer"]["review_note"]) lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("") lines.append("## Trace Summary") lines.append("") lines.append("| Index | Lager | Operation | Status |") lines.append("|---|---|---|---|") for row in trace: lines.append("| " + str(row["index"]) + " | " + row["layer"] + " | " + row["operation"] + " | `" + row["status"] + "` |") lines.append("") lines.append("---") return lines def build_control_log(payload, trace): e = payload["layers"]["E_master_conclusion"] lines = [] lines.append("FIRST DIFFERENTIATION CONTROL LOG") lines.append("=" * 72) lines.append("Created local: " + payload["script"]["created_at_local"]) lines.append("Created UTC: " + payload["script"]["created_at_utc"]) lines.append("Script: " + payload["script"]["name"]) lines.append("Version: " + payload["script"]["version"]) lines.append("HTML rendering: disabled") lines.append("") lines.append("WHAT WAS MEASURED") lines.append("-" * 72) lines.append("- First self-relation geometry.") lines.append("- Exact 3/4 and 1/4 ratio by Fraction arithmetic.") lines.append("- IEEE-style float behaviour by Python float.") lines.append("- Final float rendering of ratio and lock.") lines.append("- Symmetric residual relation around 0.75 and 0.25.") lines.append("") lines.append("HOW IT WAS MEASURED") lines.append("-" * 72) for row in trace: lines.append("STEP " + str(row["index"]).zfill(3)) lines.append("Layer: " + row["layer"]) lines.append("Operation: " + row["operation"]) lines.append("Formula: " + row["formula"]) lines.append("Status: " + row["status"]) lines.append("Note: " + row["note"]) lines.append("") lines.append("CONTROL RESULT") lines.append("-" * 72) for key, value in e["summary"].items(): lines.append(key + ": " + str(value)) lines.append("") lines.append("BOUNDARY") lines.append("-" * 72) lines.append(e["measurement_boundary"]) return lines def build_execution_log(payload, paths): lines = [] lines.append("FIRST DIFFERENTIATION EXECUTION LOG") lines.append("=" * 72) lines.append("Timestamp local: " + now_local()) lines.append("Timestamp UTC: " + now_utc_iso()) lines.append("Status: " + payload["layers"]["E_master_conclusion"]["summary"]["total_status"]) lines.append("Output directory: " + str(OUTPUT_DIR)) for name, path in paths.items(): lines.append(name + ": " + str(path)) return lines def write_outputs(payload, trace, audit_entries): ensure_output_dir() data_path = OUTPUT_DIR / "FIRST_DIFFERENTIATION_DATA.json" trace_path = OUTPUT_DIR / "FIRST_DIFFERENTIATION_TRACE.json" full_path = OUTPUT_DIR / "FIRST_DIFFERENTIATION_FULL_DATASHEET.json" md_path = OUTPUT_DIR / "FIRST_DIFFERENTIATION_PRESENTATION.md" control_path = OUTPUT_DIR / "FIRST_DIFFERENTIATION_CONTROL_LOG.txt" execution_path = OUTPUT_DIR / "FIRST_DIFFERENTIATION_EXECUTION.log" audit_path = OUTPUT_DIR / "FIRST_DIFFERENTIATION_AUDIT.json" verify_path = OUTPUT_DIR / "FIRST_DIFFERENTIATION_VERIFY.json" append_audit(audit_entries, "write_data_json", "ok", {"path": str(data_path)}) write_json(data_path, payload) append_audit(audit_entries, "write_trace_json", "ok", {"path": str(trace_path)}) write_json(trace_path, trace) append_audit(audit_entries, "write_full_datasheet_json", "ok", {"path": str(full_path)}) write_json(full_path, {"payload": payload, "trace": trace}) append_audit(audit_entries, "write_markdown", "ok", {"path": str(md_path)}) write_text(md_path, build_markdown(payload, trace)) append_audit(audit_entries, "write_control_log", "ok", {"path": str(control_path)}) write_text(control_path, build_control_log(payload, trace)) paths = {"data_json": data_path, "trace_json": trace_path, "full_datasheet_json": full_path, "presentation_markdown": md_path, "control_log": control_path, "execution_log": execution_path, "audit_json": audit_path, "verify_json": verify_path} append_audit(audit_entries, "write_execution_log", "ok", {"path": str(execution_path)}) write_text(execution_path, build_execution_log(payload, paths)) audit_payload = {"script_name": SCRIPT_NAME, "script_version": SCRIPT_VERSION, "created_at_utc": now_utc_iso(), "entry_count": len(audit_entries), "entries": audit_entries} write_json(audit_path, audit_payload) verify_files = {} for name, path in paths.items(): if path.exists() and path != verify_path: verify_files[name] = {"path": str(path), "bytes": path.stat().st_size, "sha256": sha256_file(path)} verify_payload = {"script_name": SCRIPT_NAME, "script_version": SCRIPT_VERSION, "generated_at_utc": now_utc_iso(), "purpose": "Verification hashes for generated FIRST DIFFERENTIATION artifacts.", "files": verify_files} write_json(verify_path, verify_payload) return paths def print_summary(payload, paths): summary = payload["layers"]["E_master_conclusion"]["summary"] print("") print("=" * 72) print("FIRST DIFFERENTIATION SUMMARY") print("=" * 72) for key, value in summary.items(): print(key + ":", value) print("-" * 72) for name, path in paths.items(): print(name + ":", path) print("=" * 72) print("") def generate_once(): audit_entries = [] append_audit(audit_entries, "start_generation", "ok", {"script_name": SCRIPT_NAME, "script_version": SCRIPT_VERSION, "working_directory": str(BASE_DIR), "python_version": sys.version, "platform": platform.platform()}) payload, trace = run_all() append_audit(audit_entries, "run_all_measurements", "ok", {"trace_count": len(trace)}) paths = write_outputs(payload, trace, audit_entries) append_audit(audit_entries, "finish_generation", "ok", {"status": payload["layers"]["E_master_conclusion"]["summary"]["total_status"]}) print_summary(payload, paths) return payload, trace, paths def interactive_menu(): payload, trace, paths = generate_once() while True: print("") print("=" * 72) print("FIRST DIFFERENTIATION - ALL INCLUSIVE") print("=" * 72) print("1. Visa sammanfattning") print("2. Visa A - First Structure") print("3. Visa B - Exact Ratio Test") print("4. Visa C - IEEE Residual Probe") print("5. Visa D - Final Float Lock") print("6. Skriv om alla exportfiler") print("7. Visa exportvägar") print("0. Avsluta") choice = input("Ditt val (0-7): ").strip() if choice == "1": print_summary(payload, paths) elif choice == "2": print(json.dumps(json_safe(payload["layers"]["A_first_structure"]), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)) elif choice == "3": print(json.dumps(json_safe(payload["layers"]["B_exact_ratio_test"]), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)) elif choice == "4": print(json.dumps(json_safe(payload["layers"]["C_ieee_residual_probe"]), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)) elif choice == "5": print(json.dumps(json_safe(payload["layers"]["D_final_float_lock"]), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)) elif choice == "6": payload, trace, paths = generate_once() elif choice == "7": for name, path in paths.items(): print(name + ":", path) elif choice == "0": print("Avslutar.") break else: print("Ogiltigt val.") input("Tryck Enter för att fortsätta...") def write_error_log(exc): ensure_output_dir() path = OUTPUT_DIR / "FIRST_DIFFERENTIATION_ERROR.log" lines = [] lines.append("FIRST DIFFERENTIATION ERROR LOG") lines.append("=" * 72) lines.append("Timestamp local: " + now_local()) lines.append("Timestamp UTC: " + now_utc_iso()) lines.append("Error type: " + type(exc).__name__) lines.append("Error message: " + str(exc)) lines.append("") lines.append("TRACEBACK") lines.append("-" * 72) lines.extend(traceback.format_exc().splitlines()) write_text(path, lines) return path def parse_args(): parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="RP9 FIRST DIFFERENTIATION all-inclusive presentation generator.") parser.add_argument("--run-once", action="store_true", help="Generate all files once and exit without menu.") return parser.parse_args() def main(): args = parse_args() try: if args.run_once: generate_once() else: interactive_menu() except KeyboardInterrupt: print("") print("Avbrutet av användaren.") except Exception as exc: error_path = write_error_log(exc) print("ERROR:", str(exc)) print("Error log written to:", error_path) finally: if not args.run_once: input("Tryck Enter för att stänga...") if __name__ == "__main__": main() ⚖️ — License & CopyrightLicensed under RP9-LA-2026Copyright © 2026 Anton WallinSee LICENSE for full terms.

# SECOND_DIFFERENTIATION_harmonic_probe_V2.py # Version: 2.0.0 # Skapat for: RP9 K6 KOD & VALIDERING # Licens: CC BY-SA 4.0 - Anton Wallin # Funktion: Laster K6 mot K5-funktionen: halva-halva, binar-triadisk puls, sju-passage, Rx8 och finstrukturkonstanten. # # TESTSTANDARD: # Varje test skriver vad som testas, hur det testas, varfor det testas och slutresultat. # Utdata skrivs till bade JSON och Markdown. # Koden ar sjalvforsorjande och skapar sin egen utdata-mapp dar den kors. from decimal import Decimal, getcontext from pathlib import Path import datetime import json import math getcontext().prec = 80 PROGRAM_NAME = 'SECOND_DIFFERENTIATION_harmonic_probe_V2' VERSION = '2.0.0' FRAMEWORK = 'RP9' OUT_DIR_NAME = 'SECOND_DIFFERENTIATION_PRESENTATION_V2' def d(value): return Decimal(str(value)) def decimal_fraction(value): text = format(float(value), '.15f') if '.' not in text: return '' return text.split('.')[1].rstrip('0') def repetend_unit_fraction(denominator): # What: calculates the repeating cycle for 1 / denominator. # How: long division with remainder tracking. # Why: K6 needs to test whether 7 acts as a six-step recursive passage. seen = {} digits = [] remainder = 1 % denominator position = 0 while remainder and remainder not in seen: seen[remainder] = position remainder *= 10 digits.append(str(remainder // denominator)) remainder %= denominator position += 1 if remainder == 0: return ''.join(digits), '' start = seen[remainder] prefix = ''.join(digits[:start]) cycle = ''.join(digits[start:]) return prefix, cycle def decimal_part_cycle(numerator, denominator): # What: calculates the repeating decimal cycle for numerator / denominator. # How: long division after extracting the integer part. # Why: K6 compares 1/7 and 8/7 to verify preserved six-cycle position. seen = {} digits = [] remainder = numerator % denominator position = 0 while remainder and remainder not in seen: seen[remainder] = position remainder *= 10 digits.append(str(remainder // denominator)) remainder %= denominator position += 1 if remainder == 0: return ''.join(digits), '' start = seen[remainder] prefix = ''.join(digits[:start]) cycle = ''.join(digits[start:]) return prefix, cycle def add_test(tests, test_id, title, what, how, why, expected, observed, passed, relation): tests.append({ 'test_id': test_id, 'title': title, 'what_is_tested': what, 'how_it_is_tested': how, 'why_it_is_tested': why, 'expected_result': expected, 'observed_result': observed, 'status': 'PASS' if passed else 'FAIL', 'relation_to_rp9': relation }) def classify_tri_pulse(value): frac = decimal_fraction(value) if frac.startswith('333') or frac.startswith('333333'): return 'ONE_THIRD_PULSE' if frac.startswith('666') or frac.startswith('666666'): return 'TWO_THIRD_PULSE' return 'NO_TRIADIC_PULSE' def build_markdown(payload): tests = payload['tests'] lines = [] lines.append('---') lines.append('# RP9 - SECOND DIFFERENTIATION HARMONIC PROBE V2') lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## 1. Syfte') lines.append('') lines.append('Denna K6-version laser finstrukturkonstanten mot redan etablerade RP9-funktioner: halva-halva, 1/3 mot 2/3-pulsen, sju-passagen, Rx8-laspunkten och maskinell residual.') lines.append('') lines.append('Koden forsoker inte gora alpha till en fristaende tolkning. Koden placerar alpha operationellt i samma kedja som K5 redan verifierar.') lines.append('') lines.append('## 2. Kedja') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('R') lines.append('↓') lines.append('R x 8') lines.append('↓') lines.append('1/3 <-> 2/3') lines.append('↓') lines.append('1/4 <-> 3/4') lines.append('↓') lines.append('halva-halva') lines.append('↓') lines.append('7-passagen / 142857') lines.append('↓') lines.append('alpha / finstrukturkonstanten') lines.append('↓') lines.append('maskinell residual') lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('## 3. Kontrollmatris') lines.append('') lines.append('| Test | Status | Vad testas | Observerat |') lines.append('|---|---|---|---|') for test in tests: observed = str(test['observed_result']).replace('|', '/') lines.append('| ' + test['test_id'] + ' | ' + test['status'] + ' | ' + test['title'] + ' | ' + observed + ' |') lines.append('') lines.append('## 4. Testdetaljer') lines.append('') for test in tests: lines.append('### ' + test['test_id'] + ' - ' + test['title']) lines.append('') lines.append('**Vad testas:** ' + test['what_is_tested']) lines.append('') lines.append('**Hur testas det:** ' + test['how_it_is_tested']) lines.append('') lines.append('**Varfor testas det:** ' + test['why_it_is_tested']) lines.append('') lines.append('**Forvantat:** ' + str(test['expected_result'])) lines.append('') lines.append('**Observerat:** ' + str(test['observed_result'])) lines.append('') lines.append('**Resultat:** ' + test['status']) lines.append('') lines.append('**Relation:** ' + test['relation_to_rp9']) lines.append('') lines.append('---') lines.append('') lines.append('## 5. Slutresultat') lines.append('') lines.append('Global status: **' + payload['verification']['global_status'] + '**') lines.append('') lines.append(payload['verification']['final_result']) lines.append('') lines.append('---') return '
'.join(lines) def run_probe(): root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent out_dir = root / OUT_DIR_NAME out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) tests = [] # Measurement layer: first differentiation. R = 1.0 Ri = math.sqrt(3) / 2 * R AY = math.pi * (R ** 2) AI = math.pi * (Ri ** 2) area_ratio = AI / AY lock_residual = 1.0 - area_ratio area_pass = abs(area_ratio - 0.75) < 2e-16 and abs(lock_residual - 0.25) < 2e-16 add_test( tests, 'K6_TEST_01', 'First differentiation lock', '3/4 mot 1/4 fran Vesica-baserad forsta differentiering.', 'Beraknar intern radie sqrt(3)/2, area-kvot AI/AY och komplementet 1 - AI/AY.', 'Detta ar basen som K6 inte far losgora alpha ifran.', 'area_ratio ~= 0.75 och lock_residual ~= 0.25', {'area_ratio': area_ratio, 'lock_residual': lock_residual}, area_pass, 'Alpha far endast placeras efter detta las, inte fore det.' ) # Half-half layer. half_high = 1.5 / 2.0 half_low = 0.5 / 2.0 half_pass = half_high == 0.75 and half_low == 0.25 and half_high + half_low == 1.0 add_test( tests, 'K6_TEST_02', 'Halva-halva lock', 'Den bipolara halva-halva-funktionen: 1.5/2 och 0.5/2.', 'Beraknar bada sidorna och kontrollerar att summan stanger till 1.0.', 'Detta binder K6 till K5-funktionen innan alpha analyseras.', '1.5/2 = 0.75, 0.5/2 = 0.25, summa = 1.0', {'upper_half': half_high, 'lower_half': half_low, 'sum': half_high + half_low}, half_pass, 'Halva-halva ar uttrycket som genererar 3/4 och 1/4 i representationslagret.' ) # Binary triadic pulse from Rx8. rx8_values = [6.0, 3.0, 1.5, 0.75, 0.375, 0.1875, 0.09375, 0.046875] pulse_rows = [] for item in rx8_values: result = 8.0 / item pulse_rows.append({'input': item, 'result': result, 'pulse': classify_tri_pulse(result)}) pulse_set = [row['pulse'] for row in pulse_rows] pulse_pass = all(pulse in ['ONE_THIRD_PULSE', 'TWO_THIRD_PULSE'] for pulse in pulse_set) add_test( tests, 'K6_TEST_03', 'Binar-triadisk pulse', 'Rx8 dividerat genom halveringskedjan skall reproducera .333... och .666...-vaxlingen.', 'Dividerar 8 med 6, 3, 1.5, 0.75 och vidare halveringar.', 'K5 visar att siffrorna uttrycker funktionen, inte tvartom. K6 maste darfor bevara pulsen.', 'Samtliga resultat skall klassas som ONE_THIRD_PULSE eller TWO_THIRD_PULSE.', pulse_rows, pulse_pass, 'Den triadiska pulsen ar K5-bryggan in i K6.' ) # Seven passage. _, cycle_1_7 = decimal_part_cycle(1, 7) _, cycle_8_7 = decimal_part_cycle(8, 7) _, cycle_8_14 = decimal_part_cycle(8, 14) seven_pass = cycle_1_7 == '142857' and cycle_8_7 == '142857' and len(cycle_1_7) == 6 and len(cycle_8_14) == 6 add_test( tests, 'K6_TEST_04', 'Sju-passagen', '1/7 och 8/7 skall bevara samma sexfasiga rekursiva decimalcykel.', 'Lang division med restspairning for 1/7, 8/7 och 8/14.', 'Sjuan skall inte skapa ny proportion. Den skall visa passagen som later funktionen rotera.', '1/7 och 8/7 ger 142857; cykellangd = 6.', {'1_over_7_cycle': cycle_1_7, '8_over_7_cycle': cycle_8_7, '8_over_14_cycle': cycle_8_14}, seven_pass, '7 fungerar som fraktal passage mellan enhet och Rx8-volym.' ) # Alpha layer. alpha = 0.0072973525692838015 alpha_inv_declared = 137.035999084 alpha_inv_calculated = 1.0 / alpha alpha_anchor = 0.007 alpha_residual = alpha - alpha_anchor alpha_relative_to_anchor = alpha / alpha_anchor alpha_pass = abs(alpha_inv_calculated - alpha_inv_declared) < 1e-9 and alpha_residual > 0 and alpha_anchor == 7 / 1000 add_test( tests, 'K6_TEST_05', 'Finstrukturkonstantens ankare', 'Alpha testas som finstrukturkonstant med bas-10-ankare 0.007 och positiv asymmetrisk rest.', 'Kontrollerar 1/alpha mot deklarerad invers, kontrollerar 0.007 = 7/1000 och beraknar alpha - 0.007.', 'K6 skall inte loskoppla alpha fran sju-passagen; alpha placeras efter den verifierade K5-pulsen.', '1/alpha ~= 137.035999084, anchor = 0.007, residual > 0.', {'alpha': alpha, 'alpha_inverse_calculated': alpha_inv_calculated, 'alpha_inverse_declared': alpha_inv_declared, 'alpha_anchor': alpha_anchor, 'alpha_residual': alpha_residual, 'alpha_relative_to_anchor': alpha_relative_to_anchor}, alpha_pass, 'Alpha binds som harmonisk residual/finstrukturposition efter 7-ankaret, inte som fristaende tal.' ) # Rx8 machine residual lock. R16 = 2.0 ** -52 R15 = 2.0 ** -49 quotient = R15 / R16 machine_pass = quotient == 8.0 add_test( tests, 'K6_TEST_06', 'Maskinell Rx8-residual', 'R15/R16 skall lasa till exakt 8.0.', 'Beraknar 2^-49 / 2^-52.', 'Detta binder K6 tillbaka till maskinlagret och oktala laspunkten.', 'R15/R16 = 8.0', {'R15': R15, 'R16': R16, 'quotient': quotient}, machine_pass, 'Residualen tillhor representationen men reproducerar Rx8-laspunkten.' ) # Combined closure. global_pass = all(test['status'] == 'PASS' for test in tests) payload = { 'metadata': { 'program': PROGRAM_NAME, 'version': VERSION, 'timestamp': datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(), 'license': 'CC BY-SA 4.0 - Anton Wallin', 'framework': FRAMEWORK }, 'rp9_position': { 'layer': 'K6 SECOND DIFFERENTIATION', 'function': 'Functional calibration of alpha against K5 half-half pulse, seven passage and Rx8 lock.', 'not_primary_origin': True, 'primary_origin': 'R and first differentiation remain upstream.' }, 'measurement_layer': { 'base_radius': R, 'internal_radius': Ri, 'area_ratio': area_ratio, 'lock_residual': lock_residual }, 'half_half_layer': { 'upper_half': half_high, 'lower_half': half_low, 'sum': half_high + half_low }, 'triadic_pulse_layer': pulse_rows, 'seven_passage_layer': { 'one_over_seven_cycle': cycle_1_7, 'eight_over_seven_cycle': cycle_8_7, 'eight_over_fourteen_cycle': cycle_8_14 }, 'alpha_layer': { 'alpha_value': alpha, 'alpha_inverse_declared': alpha_inv_declared, 'alpha_inverse_calculated': alpha_inv_calculated, 'alpha_base_10_anchor': alpha_anchor, 'alpha_asymmetric_residual': alpha_residual, 'alpha_relative_to_anchor': alpha_relative_to_anchor }, 'machine_residual_layer': { 'R15': R15, 'R16': R16, 'R15_over_R16': quotient }, 'tests': tests, 'verification': { 'global_status': 'PASS' if global_pass else 'FAIL', 'final_result': 'K6 ar funktionellt kalibrerad mot K5 om samtliga testlager passerar: halva-halva, triadisk puls, sju-passage, alpha-ankare och Rx8-maskinresidual.' } } json_path = out_dir / 'SECOND_DIFFERENTIATION_DATA_V2.json' md_path = out_dir / 'SECOND_DIFFERENTIATION_PRESENTATION_V2.md' log_path = out_dir / 'SECOND_DIFFERENTIATION_CONTROL_LOG_V2.txt' py_copy_path = out_dir / 'SECOND_DIFFERENTIATION_harmonic_probe_V2.py' json_path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8') md_path.write_text(build_markdown(payload), encoding='utf-8') log_lines = [] log_lines.append('PROGRAM=' + PROGRAM_NAME) log_lines.append('VERSION=' + VERSION) log_lines.append('TIMESTAMP=' + payload['metadata']['timestamp']) log_lines.append('GLOBAL_STATUS=' + payload['verification']['global_status']) for test in tests: log_lines.append(test['test_id'] + '=' + test['status']) log_path.write_text('
'.join(log_lines) + '
', encoding='utf-8') Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8') py_copy_path.write_text(Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'), encoding='utf-8') print('RP9 K6 SECOND DIFFERENTIATION V2') print('Output folder:', out_dir) print('Global status:', payload['verification']['global_status']) for test in tests: print(test['test_id'], '|', test['status'], '|', test['title']) return payload if __name__ == '__main__': run_probe() ⚖️ — License & CopyrightLicensed under RP9-LA-2026Copyright © 2026 Anton WallinSee LICENSE for full terms.

item.title: SECOND DIFFERENTIATION PRESENTATION
item.description: This K6 version maps the fine structure constant to already established RP9 functions: half-half, 1/3 to the 2/3 pulse, the seven-pass, the Rx8 lock point, and the machine residual.The code does not attempt to make alpha a stand-alone interpretation. The code operationally places alpha in the same chain that K5 already verifies.R ↓ R x 8 ↓ 1/3 <-> 2/3 ↓ 1/4 <-> 3/4 ↓ half-half ↓ 7-pass / 142857 ↓ alpha / fine structure constant ↓ machine residual What is tested: 3/4 ​​vs. 1/4 from Vesica-based first differentiation.How ​​is it tested: Calculates internal radius sqrt(3)/2, area ratio AI/AY and the complement 1 - AI/AY.Why is it tested: This is the base that K6 is not allowed to solve alpha from.Expected: area_ratio ~= 0.75 and lock_residual ~= 0.25Observed: {'area_ratio': 0.7499999999999999, 'lock_residual': 0.25000000000000001}Result: PASSRelation: Alpha may only be placed after this lock, not before it.What is tested: The bipolar half-half function: 1.5/2 and 0.5/2.How ​​to test it: Calculates both sides and checks that the sum closes to 1.0.Why it is tested: This binds K6 to the K5 function before alpha is analyzed.Expected: 1.5/2 = 0.75, 0.5/2 = 0.25, sum = 1.0Observed: {'upper_half': 0.75, 'lower_half': 0.25, 'sum': 1.0}Result: PASSRelation: Half-half is the expression that generates 3/4 and 1/4 in the representation layer.What is tested: Rx8 divided by the halving chain should reproduce the .333... and .666... ​​alternation.How ​​is it tested: Divides 8 by 6, 3, 1.5, 0.75 and further halvings.Why is it tested: K5 shows that the numbers express the function, not the other way around. K6 must therefore preserve the pulse.Expected: All results should be classified as ONE_THIRD_PULSE or TWO_THIRD_PULSE.Observed: [{'input': 6.0, 'result': 1.3333333333333333, 'pulse': 'ONE_THIRD_PULSE'}, {'input': 3.0, 'result': 2.6666666666666665, 'pulse': 'TWO_THIRD_PULSE'}, {'input': 1.5, 'result': 5.333333333333333, 'pulse': 'ONE_THIRD_PULSE'}, {'input': 0.75, 'result': 10.666666666666666, 'pulse': 'TWO_THIRD_PULSE'}, {'input': 0.375, 'result': 21.333333333333332, 'pulse': 'ONE_THIRD_PULSE'}, {'input': 0.1875, 'result': 42.666666666666664, 'pulse': 'TWO_THIRD_PULSE'}, {'input': 0.09375, 'result': 85.3333333333333, 'pulse': 'ONE_THIRD_PULSE'}, {'input': 0.046875, 'result': 170.66666666666666, 'pulse': 'TWO_THIRD_PULSE'}]Result: PASSRelationship: The triadic pulse is the K5 bridge into K6.What is being tested: 1/7 and 8/7 should preserve the same six-phase recursive decimal cycle.How ​​is it tested: Long division with remainder pairing for 1/7, 8/7 and 8/14.Why is it being tested: The seven should not create a new proportion. It should show the passage that lets the function rotate.Expected: 1/7 and 8/7 give 142857; cycle length = 6.Observed: {'1_over_7_cycle': '142857', '8_over_7_cycle': '142857', '8_over_14_cycle': '571428'}Result: PASSRelation: 7 acts as a fractal passage between unity and Rx8 volume.What is tested: Alpha is tested as a fine structure constant with base-10 anchor 0.007 and positive asymmetric remainder.How ​​is it tested: Checks 1/alpha against declared inverse, checks 0.007 = 7/1000 and calculates alpha - 0.007.Why is it tested: K6 should not disconnect alpha from the seven-passage; alpha is placed after the verified K5 pulse.Expected: 1/alpha ~= 137.035999084, anchor = 0.007, residual > 0.Observed: {'alpha': 0.0072973525692838015, 'alpha_inverse_calculated': 137.035999084, 'alpha_inverse_declared': 137.035999084, 'alpha_anchor': 0.007, 'alpha_residual': 0.007 0.0002973525692838014, 'alpha_relative_to_anchor': 1.0424789384691144}Result: PASSRelation: Alpha binds as a harmonic residual/fine structure position after the 7-anchor, not as a free-standing number.What is tested: R15/R16 should read exactly 8.0.How ​​is it tested: Calculates 2^-49 / 2^-52.Why is it tested: This ties K6 back to the machine store and the octal read point.Expected: R15/R16 = 8.0Observed: {'R15': 1.7763568394002505e-15, 'R16': 2.220446049250313e-16, 'quotient': 8.0}Result: PASSRelation: The residual belongs to the representation but reproduces the Rx8 read point.Global status: PASSK6 is functionally calibrated against K5 if all test layers pass: half-half, triadic pulse, seven-passage, alpha anchor and Rx8 machine residual.⚖️ — License & CopyrightLicensed under RP9-LA-2026Copyright © 2026 Anton WallinSee LICENSE for full terms.

item.title: B. RP9. R. ORIGIN RECONSTRUCTION TEST. FINAL REPORT
item.description: R-origin reconstruction test for RP9/Rx8.Tests whether R can be treated as a non-absolute origin reference that cancels out during Rx8 normalization while preserving the 3/4 to 1/3 <-> 2/3 pulse.For each representative R value, the script computes Rx8, normalizes Rx8 by R, verifies normalized Rx8 = 8, then verifies that 8 / ((3/4) / 2^n) produces the alternating 2/3 and 1/3 remainder pulse.This closes the gap between the conceptual claim R -> R x 8 -> representation and the existing numerical tests that start directly from 3/4. Iterations per R-value: 40 Arithmetic: Exact rational arithmetic with fractions.Fraction Normalization requirement: (R x 8) / R == 8 Pulse requirement: remainder alternates 2/3, 1/3 after 8 / ((3/4) / 2^n) The test passes: all representative R values ​​are normalized to Rx8 = 8, and the same residual momentum 1/3 <-> 2/3 is preserved throughout the 3/4 representation. item.title: B. RP9. Binary pulse invariance check. FINAL REPORT
item.description: The code checks whether an exact rational scaling from the base relation 3/4 preserves the binary-triadic decimal pulse 1/3 <-> 2/3 when the check value 8 / q_n is calculated.The purpose is to make the test auditable, reproducible and machine-readable. Each iteration is saved in both Markdown and JSON so that the entire run can be followed without manually interpreting console output.The test calculates q_n = (3/4) / 2^n for 100 iterations. Then 8 / q_n is calculated. The remainder after the integer part is checked against 1/3 and 2/3. In addition, it checks that the pulse alternates correctly: even iterations give 2/3 and odd iterations give 1/3.If the remainder is always in 1/3 or 2/3 and alternates correctly, the test shows that the relation is not broken by binary scaling. This supports the local RP9/Rx8 interpretation that the representation scales while preserving the remainder structure of the relation. Arithmetic: exact rational arithmetic with Fraction. Starting relation: 3/4. Scaling: division by 2^n. Check: 8 / q_n. Acceptable remainder: 1/3 or 2/3. Acceptable sequence: 2/3, 1/3, 2/3, 1/3, ... F:\RP9 - Rieman Z Lock\REk\RP9 Rieman Z Lock\4. item.title: B. Start Independence Test. FINAL REPORT
item.description: Start independence test for the RP9/Rx8 residual pulse.Verifies that equivalent representations of 3/4 give the same residual pulse and thus are not dependent on the starting resolution.For each starting value, q_n = start_value / 2^n and 8 / q_n are calculated. The remainder after the integer part must be 1/3 or 2/3.If 3/4, 6/8, 12/16 and other equivalent starting values ​​give the same result, the code shows that the relation is start independent within the same reduced proportion. Iterations per start value: 40 Arithmetic: Exact rational arithmetic with fractions.Fraction Row requirement: remainder in {1/3, 2/3} Final requirement: Every start value reduces to 3/4 and every row passes The test passes: all equivalent starting representations are reduced to 3/4 and preserve the residual momentum 1/3 <-> 2/3 through all iterations. B. Start Independence Test FINAL REPORT Link — 🔗. B. Start Independence Test. FINAL REPORT C. Start Independence Test. PYTHON Link — 🔗.
C. Start Independence Test. PYTHON This code is the third verification in the RP9 sequence.After the previous test showed that the binary pulse remains invariant through iteration, this test examines whether the same pulse depends on how the starting value is written.The goal is to determine whether:3/4 has a unique position,or whether all equivalent representations of the same proportion give exactly the same result.The code uses the following starting values:3/4 6/8 12/16 24/32 48/64 96/128 192/256 384/512 768/1024 Each value is first reduced relationally.Then:q_n = start value / 2^n and:8 / q_n for 40 iterations.For each iteration, it is checked that the remainder is:1/3 or 2/3 and that the previously observed pulse is preserved.If the pulse is really a property of the relation:3/4 it should not matter how the same proportion is written.The following expressions represent the same relation:3/4 = 6/8 = 12/16 = 24/32 = ... If everyone gives identical pulse, it means that:the pulse is start-independent and thus not bound to any specific numerical resolution.Starting values:3/4 6/8 12/16 24/32 48/64 96/128 192/256 384/512 768/1024 Operation:q_n = starting value / 2^n Check:8 / q_n Iterations:40 per starting value Pass conditions:remain ∈ {1/3, 2/3} and:all starting values ​​are reduced to 3/4 and:all iterations pass Exact rational arithmetic is used through:fractions.Fraction which eliminates rounding errors from the verification itself.If the hypothesis is correct: all starting values ​​are reduced to 3/4 the pulse 1/3 ↔ 2/3 returns no breaks occur all tests give PASS Expected conclusion:the representation does not matter as long as the underlying proportion is identical.The result was:All tested representations:3/4 6/8 12/16 24/32 48/64 96/128 192/256 384/512 768/1024 gave exactly the same results.None of the 360 ​​verified control points broke the pulse sequence.The test passed.The observed pulse does not depend on:3/4 as a notation.Instead, it is connected to the reduced relation.The following expressions therefore behave identically:3/4 = 6/8 = 12/16 = 24/32 = 48/64 = ... The result supports that the examined structure is:startindependent within the same relational proportion.When executed, the following is generated:rp9_start_independence_test │ ├── README.md ├── rp9_start_independence_test.py ├── rp9_start_independence_test.json ├── rp9_start_independence_test.log └── rp9_start_independence_test_FINALREPORT.md The JSON file contains all iterations.The log file contains the run trace and final status.The markdown report contains the review report.This verification shows that the pulse does not depend on:how the relation is written The next question is instead:Does the pulse depend on which base system is used? Therefore, continue to:rp9_base_independence_test There the same structure is verified in:Base 2 Base 4 Base 8 Base 16 Base 32 Base 64 to determine whether the pulse is:base independent and not just a result of a specific representation system. ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.

item.title: B. 333 & 666 Float Boundary Probe. FINAL REPORT
item.description: Float-boundary probe for the recurring 1/3 <-> 2/3 rest pulse produced from q_n = (3/4) / 2^n and 8 / q_n.To make the rest pulse machine-readable, auditable and reproducible through exact rational arithmetic and explicit float-residual checking. That each iteration gives a rest of 1/3 or 2/3. That the switching follows the expected pulse: 2/3 for even n and 1/3 for odd n. That the float representation of 1/3 and 2/3 gives a storable residual against an exact Fraction/Decimal reference. That the machine limit between 2^-49 and 2^-52 gives the quotient 8. The test shows whether the observed 0.333... <-> 0.666... ​​pulse is preserved when exactly rational structure is compared to the machine layer of the float representation.The code has been shorted and verified.
