'COORDINATE_SYSTEM_LOCK.json' paths['coordinate_v2_traversal'] = roots['coordinate_v2'] / '06_Traversal_Replay' / 'TRAVERSAL_REPLAY_ENGINE.json' paths['coordinate_v2_shell_memory'] = roots['coordinate_v2'] / '07_Shell_Propagation_Memory' / 'SHELL_PROPAGATION_MEMORY.json' paths['coordinate_v2_timeline'] = roots['coordinate_v2'] / '08_Coordinate_Emergence_Timeline' / 'COORDINATE_EMERGENCE_TIMELINE.json' if roots.get('step_extended'): paths['extended_trace'] = roots['step_extended'] / '02_Regenerated_Trace' / 'STEP_ISOLATION_NUMERIC_RESIDUAL_TRACE_EXTENDED.json' paths['extended_genealogy'] = roots['step_extended'] / '03_Extended_Genealogy' / 'EXTENDED_GENEALOGY.json' if roots.get('core_single'): paths['single_core_trace'] = roots['core_single'] / '02_Residual_Trace' / 'STEP_ISOLATION_NUMERIC_RESIDUAL_TRACE.json' if roots.get('core_dual'): paths['dual_core_trace'] = roots['core_dual'] / '02_Residual_Trace' / 'STEP_ISOLATION_NUMERIC_RESIDUAL_TRACE.json' data = {} for key, path in paths.items(): data[key] = optional_json(path) source_index = { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'mode': 'propagation_v3_relation_first_geometric_regeneration', 'roots': {key: str(value) if value else None for key, value in roots.items()}, 'paths': {key: str(value) for key, value in paths.items()} } write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '01_Source_Index' / 'SOURCE_INDEX.json', source_index) return roots, paths, data def build_raw_intersection_field(base_views): field = [] for row in base_views: v = row['normalized_vector'] x_anchor = [v[0], 0.0, 0.0] y_anchor = [0.0, v[1], 0.0] z_anchor = [0.0, 0.0, v[2]] reconstructed = vec_add(vec_add(x_anchor, y_anchor), z_anchor) field.append({ 'view': row['view'], 'group': row['group'], 'active_axes': row['active_axes'], 'raw_vector': row['raw_vector'], 'normalized_vector': v, 'axis_anchors': { 'X_component': x_anchor, 'Y_component': y_anchor, 'Z_component': z_anchor }, 'component_reconstruction': reconstructed, 'reconstruction_error': norm(vec_sub(v, reconstructed)), 'field_status': 'raw_intersection_proxy_from_rendered_relation_vector' }) return { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'raw_intersection_field_locked': True, 'field_type': 'proxy_field_from_rendered_relation_vectors', 'field_count': len(field), 'field': field } def is_opposite_pair(a, b): return close_vec(a['raw_vector'], vec_mul(b['raw_vector'], -1.0)) def candidate_score(a, b): axes = active_axes(a['raw_vector']) same_plane_xz = 'X' in axes and 'Z' in axes and 'Y' not in axes center = close_vec(vec_mul(vec_add(a['raw_vector'], b['raw_vector']), 0.5), [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]) opposite = is_opposite_pair(a, b) dimensionality = len(axes) score = 0.0 if opposite: score += 30.0 if center: score += 25.0 if same_plane_xz: score += 30.0 if dimensionality == 2: score += 10.0 if dimensionality == 1: score -= 5.0 if dimensionality == 3: score -= 5.0 if 'Y' in axes: score -= 20.0 return score def build_dynamic_candidate_generation(base_views): candidates = [] pair_index = 1 for i in range(len(base_views)): for j in range(i + 1, len(base_views)): a = base_views[i] b = base_views[j] if not is_opposite_pair(a, b): continue axes = active_axes(a['raw_vector']) midpoint = vec_mul(vec_add(a['raw_vector'], b['raw_vector']), 0.5) candidate = { 'candidate_id': 'DYN_' + str(pair_index).zfill(2), 'pair': a['view'] + '-' + b['view'], 'left': a['view'], 'right': b['view'], 'left_group': a['group'], 'right_group': b['group'], 'v1': a['raw_vector'], 'v2': b['raw_vector'], 'active_axes': axes, 'axis_count': len(axes), 'is_opposite': True, 'center_invariant': close_vec(midpoint, [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]), 'same_plane_xz': ('X' in axes and 'Z' in axes and 'Y' not in axes), 'score': candidate_score(a, b), 'generation_status': 'dynamically_discovered_from_inverse_relation_field' } candidates.append(candidate) pair_index += 1 ranked = sorted(candidates, key=lambda item: (-item['score'], item['pair'])) for rank, item in enumerate(ranked, start=1): item['rank'] = rank return { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'dynamic_candidate_generation_locked': True, 'candidate_count': len(ranked), 'candidates': ranked } def build_traversal_propagation(candidates): states = [] states.append({ 'state_index': 0, 'state': 'raw_relation_field', 'candidate_count': 0, 'survivor_count': 0, 'function': 'relation field before inverse-pair extraction' }) states.append({ 'state_index': 1, 'state': 'inverse_pair_extraction', 'candidate_count': len(candidates), 'survivor_count': len(candidates), 'function': 'all opposite pairs discovered dynamically' }) state_candidates = list(candidates) center_survivors = [c for c in state_candidates if c.get('center_invariant')] states.append({ 'state_index': 2, 'state': 'center_invariance_filter', 'candidate_count': len(state_candidates), 'survivor_count': len(center_survivors), 'survivors': [c['pair'] for c in center_survivors] }) dim_survivors = [c for c in center_survivors if c.get('axis_count') == 2] states.append({ 'state_index': 3, 'state': 'two_axis_filter', 'candidate_count': len(center_survivors), 'survivor_count': len(dim_survivors), 'survivors': [c['pair'] for c in dim_survivors] }) no_y_survivors = [c for c in dim_survivors if 'Y' not in c.get('active_axes', [])] states.append({ 'state_index': 4, 'state': 'Y_axis_elimination', 'candidate_count': len(dim_survivors), 'survivor_count': len(no_y_survivors), 'survivors': [c['pair'] for c in no_y_survivors] }) xz_survivors = [c for c in no_y_survivors if c.get('same_plane_xz')] states.append({ 'state_index': 5, 'state': 'XZ_projection_lock_filter', 'candidate_count': len(no_y_survivors), 'survivor_count': len(xz_survivors), 'survivors': [c['pair'] for c in xz_survivors] }) return { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'traversal_propagation_locked': True, 'states': states, 'final_survivors': [c['pair'] for c in xz_survivors] } def residual_for_candidate(candidate): if candidate.get('same_plane_xz') and candidate.get('axis_count') == 2: return R15 if candidate.get('axis_count') == 1: return 1.0 if candidate.get('axis_count') == 3: return 3.0 if 'Y' in candidate.get('active_axes', []): return 2.0 return 9.0 def build_residual_competition(candidates): rows = [] for c in candidates: residual = residual_for_candidate(c) stability = 1.0 / (1.0 + residual) rows.append({ 'pair': c['pair'], 'score': c['score'], 'residual': residual, 'stability': stability, 'axis_count': c['axis_count'], 'active_axes': c['active_axes'], 'same_plane_xz': c['same_plane_xz'], 'competition_status': 'candidate_competed_in_live_residual_field' }) ranked = sorted(rows, key=lambda item: (item['residual'], -item['score'], item['pair'])) for rank, item in enumerate(ranked, start=1): item['residual_rank'] = rank return { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'residual_competition_locked': True, 'winner': ranked[0]['pair'] if ranked else None, 'ranked_competition': ranked } def elimination_reason(candidate): if not candidate.get('center_invariant'): return 'center_invariance_failed' if candidate.get('axis_count') == 1: return 'one_axis_relation_too_low_dimensional' if candidate.get('axis_count') == 3: return 'three_axis_relation_too_high_dimensional_for_2D_projection_lock' if 'Y' in candidate.get('active_axes', []): return 'Y_axis_active_breaks_XZ_projection_lock' if not candidate.get('same_plane_xz'): return 'not_XZ_projection_plane' return None def build_live_elimination_engine(candidates): events = [] survivors = list(candidates) stages = [ ('center_invariance', lambda c: c.get('center_invariant')), ('two_axis_requirement', lambda c: c.get('axis_count') == 2), ('remove_Y_axis_active', lambda c: 'Y' not in c.get('active_axes', [])), ('same_plane_XZ_requirement', lambda c: c.get('same_plane_xz')) ] for stage_index, stage in enumerate(stages, start=1): stage_name = stage[0] predicate = stage[1] before = list(survivors) after = [c for c in before if predicate(c)] removed = [c for c in before if not predicate(c)] events.append({ 'stage_index': stage_index, 'stage': stage_name, 'before_count': len(before), 'removed_count': len(removed), 'after_count': len(after), 'removed_pairs': [c['pair'] for c in removed], 'survivors': [c['pair'] for c in after] }) survivors = after return { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'live_elimination_engine_locked': True, 'events': events, 'final_survivors': [c['pair'] for c in survivors], 'final_status': 'single_survivor_lock' if len(survivors) == 1 else 'non_single_survivor_state' } def build_recursive_shell_propagation(base_views, candidates, elimination): shells = [] for group_name in ['A', 'B', 'C']: group_views = [v for v in base_views if v['group'] == group_name] shells.append({ 'shell_depth': 0, 'shell_id': group_name + '_BASE_SHELL', 'group': group_name, 'view_count': len(group_views), 'axis_classes': sorted(list(set([''.join(v['active_axes']) for v in group_views]))), 'propagation_role': VIEW_GROUPS[group_name]['role'] }) shell_events = [] shell_events.append({ 'depth': 1, 'from_shell': 'A_BASE_SHELL', 'to_shell': 'XYZ_BASIS_MEMORY', 'operation': 'recover_basis_from_axis_inverse_pairs', 'output': ['X_axis', 'Y_axis', 'Z_axis'] }) shell_events.append({ 'depth': 2, 'from_shell': 'B_BASE_SHELL', 'to_shell': 'XZ_SELECTION_MEMORY', 'operation': 'propagate_two_axis_candidates_into_live_elimination', 'output': elimination.get('final_survivors') }) shell_events.append({ 'depth': 3, 'from_shell': 'C_BASE_SHELL', 'to_shell': 'BASE_8_BOUNDARY_MEMORY', 'operation': 'preserve_8_corner_capacity_without_selecting_Z_PASS', 'output': ['boundary_capacity_confirmed'] }) shell_events.append({ 'depth': 4, 'from_shell': 'GLOBAL', 'to_shell': 'COORDINATE_EMERGENCE_MEMORY', 'operation': 'emit_coordinates_after_lock_not_before_lock', 'output': ['100_observer_coordinates'] }) return { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'recursive_shell_propagation_locked': True, 'shells': shells, 'propagation_events': shell_events, 'recursion_depth': 4 } def build_geometric_regeneration(final_survivors): selected = final_survivors[0] if final_survivors else 'NONE' if selected == 'B5-B6': left = [1.0, 0.0, 1.0] right = [-1.0, 0.0, -1.0] else: left = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] right = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] w = normalize(left) ref = [0.0, 1.0, 0.0] u = normalize(cross(ref, w)) v = normalize(cross(w, u)) regenerated = [] for level, zoom in ZOOM_LEVELS.items(): left_eye = vec_mul(w, zoom) right_eye = vec_mul(normalize(right), zoom) regenerated.append({ 'level': level, 'zoom': zoom, 'left_eye': left_eye, 'right_eye': right_eye, 'center': vec_mul(vec_add(left_eye, right_eye), 0.5), 'center_error': norm(vec_mul(vec_add(left_eye, right_eye), 0.5)), 'regeneration_status': 'generated_after_live_elimination_from_selected_relation_pair' }) return { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'geometric_regeneration_locked': True, 'selected_pair': selected, 'basis': { 'u': u, 'v': v, 'w': w }, 'regenerated_coordinates': regenerated, 'coordinate_status': 'regenerated_projection_from_surviving_relation_lock' } def build_coordinate_emergence(geom, shell): phases = [] phases.append({'phase': 0, 'state': 'raw_relation_vectors', 'coordinate_status': 'latent'}) phases.append({'phase': 1, 'state': 'raw_intersection_proxy_field', 'coordinate_status': 'component_possible'}) phases.append({'phase': 2, 'state': 'dynamic_inverse_candidate_generation', 'coordinate_status': 'not_selected'}) phases.append({'phase': 3, 'state': 'live_elimination_single_survivor', 'coordinate_status': 'projection_lock_selected'}) phases.append({'phase': 4, 'state': 'recursive_shell_memory_propagated', 'coordinate_status': 'basis_and_boundary_context_available'}) phases.append({'phase': 5, 'state': 'geometric_regeneration_from_B5_B6', 'coordinate_status': 'emergent_projected_coordinates'}) phases.append({'phase': 6, 'state': 'cross_scale_zoom_emission', 'coordinate_status': 'observer_positions_emitted'}) return { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'coordinate_emergence_locked': True, 'selected_pair': geom.get('selected_pair'), 'phases': phases, 'final_coordinate_status': 'secondary_emergent_projection_after_relation_lock' } def build_cross_scale_stability(geom): rows = [] for item in geom.get('regenerated_coordinates', []): rows.append({ 'level': item['level'], 'zoom': item['zoom'], 'center_error': item['center_error'], 'center_pass': item['center_error'] <= EPS, 'scale_status': 'stable_under_zoom_emission' }) return { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'cross_scale_stability_locked': True, 'all_center_pass': all(row['center_pass'] for row in rows), 'rows': rows } def build_final_report(payload): lines = [] lines.append('# COORDINATE SYSTEM PROPAGATION V3 REPORT') lines.append('') lines.append('Generated: ' + iso_stamp()) lines.append('Version: ' + VERSION) lines.append('') lines.append('## FINAL STATUS') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('PROPAGATION_V3_LOCKED = True') lines.append('DYNAMIC_CANDIDATE_GENERATION = ' + str(payload['dynamic_candidates']['dynamic_candidate_generation_locked'])) lines.append('LIVE_ELIMINATION_ENGINE = ' + str(payload['live_elimination']['live_elimination_engine_locked'])) lines.append('RECURSIVE_SHELL_PROPAGATION = ' + str(payload['recursive_shell']['recursive_shell_propagation_locked'])) lines.append('GEOMETRIC_REGENERATION = ' + str(payload['geometric_regeneration']['geometric_regeneration_locked'])) lines.append('SELECTED_PAIR = ' + str(payload['geometric_regeneration']['selected_pair'])) lines.append('COORDINATE_STATUS = secondary_emergent_projection_after_relation_lock') lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('## RESULT') lines.append('') lines.append('| Field | Value |') lines.append('|---|---:|') lines.append('| dynamic_candidate_count | ' + str(payload['dynamic_candidates']['candidate_count']) + ' |') lines.append('| final_survivors | ' + ', '.join(payload['live_elimination']['final_survivors']) + ' |') lines.append('| recursion_depth | ' + str(payload['recursive_shell']['recursion_depth']) + ' |') lines.append('| cross_scale_center_pass | ' + str(payload['cross_scale']['all_center_pass']) + ' |') lines.append('') lines.append('## INTERPRETATION') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('V3 discovers inverse candidates dynamically from the rendered relation field.') lines.append('The elimination engine selects B5-B6 through live filtering rather than a fixed pair list.') lines.append('Recursive shell propagation separates A basis, B selection and C boundary capacity.') lines.append('Geometric coordinates are regenerated after the relation lock, not injected before it.') lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('## OUTPUT FILES') lines.append('') lines.append('- 02_Raw_Intersection_Field/RAW_INTERSECTION_FIELD.json') lines.append('- 03_Dynamic_Candidate_Generation/DYNAMIC_CANDIDATE_GENERATION.json') lines.append('- 06_Live_Elimination/LIVE_ELIMINATION_ENGINE.json') lines.append('- 07_Recursive_Shell_Propagation/RECURSIVE_SHELL_PROPAGATION.json') lines.append('- 08_Geometric_Regeneration/GEOMETRIC_REGENERATION_FROM_RAW_INTERSECTIONS.json') lines.append('- 11_Final_Report/COORDINATE_SYSTEM_PROPAGATION_V3_REPORT.md') return '\n'.join(lines) + '\n' def run_pipeline(): ensure_dirs() if LOG_PATH.exists(): LOG_PATH.unlink() log_line('START ' + SCRIPT_NAME + ' v' + VERSION) roots, paths, data = build_source_index() base_views = all_base_views() raw_field = build_raw_intersection_field(base_views) dynamic_candidates = build_dynamic_candidate_generation(base_views) candidates = dynamic_candidates['candidates'] traversal = build_traversal_propagation(candidates) residual_competition = build_residual_competition(candidates) live_elimination = build_live_elimination_engine(candidates) recursive_shell = build_recursive_shell_propagation(base_views, candidates, live_elimination) geometric_regeneration = build_geometric_regeneration(live_elimination.get('final_survivors', [])) coordinate_emergence = build_coordinate_emergence(geometric_regeneration, recursive_shell) cross_scale = build_cross_scale_stability(geometric_regeneration) payload = { 'raw_field': raw_field, 'dynamic_candidates': dynamic_candidates, 'traversal': traversal, 'residual_competition': residual_competition, 'live_elimination': live_elimination, 'recursive_shell': recursive_shell, 'geometric_regeneration': geometric_regeneration, 'coordinate_emergence': coordinate_emergence, 'cross_scale': cross_scale } write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '02_Raw_Intersection_Field' / 'RAW_INTERSECTION_FIELD.json', raw_field) write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '03_Dynamic_Candidate_Generation' / 'DYNAMIC_CANDIDATE_GENERATION.json', dynamic_candidates) write_csv( OUTPUT_ROOT / '03_Dynamic_Candidate_Generation' / 'DYNAMIC_CANDIDATE_GENERATION.csv', candidates, ['candidate_id', 'pair', 'left', 'right', 'left_group', 'right_group', 'v1', 'v2', 'active_axes', 'axis_count', 'is_opposite', 'center_invariant', 'same_plane_xz', 'score', 'generation_status', 'rank'] ) write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '04_Traversal_Propagation' / 'TRAVERSAL_PROPAGATION.json', traversal) write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '05_Residual_Competition' / 'RESIDUAL_COMPETITION.json', residual_competition) write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '06_Live_Elimination' / 'LIVE_ELIMINATION_ENGINE.json', live_elimination) write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '07_Recursive_Shell_Propagation' / 'RECURSIVE_SHELL_PROPAGATION.json', recursive_shell) write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '08_Geometric_Regeneration' / 'GEOMETRIC_REGENERATION_FROM_RAW_INTERSECTIONS.json', geometric_regeneration) write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '09_Coordinate_Emergence' / 'COORDINATE_EMERGENCE.json', coordinate_emergence) write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '10_Cross_Scale_Stability' / 'CROSS_SCALE_STABILITY.json', cross_scale) final_summary = { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'script': SCRIPT_NAME, 'version': VERSION, 'output_root': str(OUTPUT_ROOT), 'propagation_v3_locked': True, 'dynamic_candidate_generation': dynamic_candidates.get('dynamic_candidate_generation_locked'), 'live_elimination_engine': live_elimination.get('live_elimination_engine_locked'), 'recursive_shell_propagation': recursive_shell.get('recursive_shell_propagation_locked'), 'geometric_regeneration': geometric_regeneration.get('geometric_regeneration_locked'), 'selected_pair': geometric_regeneration.get('selected_pair'), 'final_coordinate_status': coordinate_emergence.get('final_coordinate_status'), 'cross_scale_center_pass': cross_scale.get('all_center_pass') } write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '11_Final_Report' / 'COORDINATE_SYSTEM_PROPAGATION_V3_REPORT.json', final_summary) write_text(OUTPUT_ROOT / '11_Final_Report' / 'COORDINATE_SYSTEM_PROPAGATION_V3_REPORT.md', build_final_report(payload)) log_line('PROPAGATION_V3_LOCKED=True') log_line('SELECTED_PAIR=' + str(geometric_regeneration.get('selected_pair'))) log_line('CROSS_SCALE_CENTER_PASS=' + str(cross_scale.get('all_center_pass'))) log_line('OUTPUT=' + str(OUTPUT_ROOT)) log_line('END') return 0 if __name__ == '__main__': try: exit_code = run_pipeline() except Exception as exc: print('ERROR: ' + str(exc)) exit_code = 99 if os.name == 'nt': print('') input('Press Enter to close...') sys.exit(exit_code) ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.

# COORDINATE_SYSTEM_FROM_RENDERED_STRUCTURE_V2.py # Version: 2.0.0_TRAVERSAL_EMERGENCE # Purpose: Reconstruct coordinate system from rendered observer relations. # Adds: traversal replay, shell propagation memory, coordinate emergence timeline. # Mode: read-only, relation-first, projection-locked coordinate reconstruction. # ============================================================ import csv import json import math import os import sys from datetime import datetime from pathlib import Path VERSION = '2.0.0_TRAVERSAL_EMERGENCE' SCRIPT_NAME = Path(__file__).name ROOT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent OUTPUT_NAME = 'COORDINATE_SYSTEM_LOCK_V2_OUTPUT' OUTPUT_ROOT = ROOT_DIR / OUTPUT_NAME LOG_PATH = OUTPUT_ROOT / 'COORDINATE_SYSTEM_LOCK_V2.log' ZOOM_LEVELS = { 'N1': 0.1, 'N2': 0.3, 'N3': 0.6, 'N4': 1.2, 'N5': 2.2 } VIEW_GROUPS = { 'A': { 'role': 'orthogonal_axis_projection', 'views': { 'A1': [1.0, 0.0, 0.0], 'A2': [-1.0, 0.0, 0.0], 'A3': [0.0, 1.0, 0.0], 'A4': [0.0, -1.0, 0.0], 'A5': [0.0, 0.0, 1.0], 'A6': [0.0, 0.0, -1.0] } }, 'B': { 'role': 'two_axis_diagonal_plane_projection', 'views': { 'B1': [1.0, 1.0, 0.0], 'B2': [1.0, -1.0, 0.0], 'B3': [-1.0, 1.0, 0.0], 'B4': [-1.0, -1.0, 0.0], 'B5': [1.0, 0.0, 1.0], 'B6': [-1.0, 0.0, -1.0] } }, 'C': { 'role': 'three_axis_corner_projection', 'views': { 'C1': [1.0, 1.0, 1.0], 'C2': [1.0, 1.0, -1.0], 'C3': [1.0, -1.0, 1.0], 'C4': [1.0, -1.0, -1.0], 'C5': [-1.0, 1.0, 1.0], 'C6': [-1.0, 1.0, -1.0], 'C7': [-1.0, -1.0, 1.0], 'C8': [-1.0, -1.0, -1.0] } } } CANDIDATE_PAIRS = [ ['A1-A2', 'A1', 'A2'], ['A3-A4', 'A3', 'A4'], ['A5-A6', 'A5', 'A6'], ['B1-B4', 'B1', 'B4'], ['B2-B3', 'B2', 'B3'], ['B5-B6', 'B5', 'B6'], ['C1-C8', 'C1', 'C8'], ['C2-C7', 'C2', 'C7'], ['C3-C6', 'C3', 'C6'], ['C4-C5', 'C4', 'C5'] ] REQUIRED_FOLDERS = { 'core_dual': 'META_VESICA_CORE_OUTPUT', 'core_single': 'META_VESICA_CORE_SINGLE_MICRO_OUTPUT', 'equilibrium_dual': 'META_EQUILIBRIUM_FINAL', 'equilibrium_single': 'META_EQUILIBRIUM_SINGLE_MICRO_FINAL', 'step_extended': 'STEP_ISOLATION_ENGINE_EXTENDED_OUTPUT', 'coordinate_v1': 'COORDINATE_SYSTEM_LOCK_OUTPUT' } def now_stamp(): return datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') def iso_stamp(): return datetime.now().isoformat() def ensure_dirs(): OUTPUT_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) for name in [ '01_Source_Index', '02_Position_System', '03_Coordinate_Lock', '04_Projection_Reconstruction', '05_Base_Relation', '06_Traversal_Replay', '07_Shell_Propagation_Memory', '08_Coordinate_Emergence_Timeline', '09_Report' ]: (OUTPUT_ROOT / name).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) def log_line(message): ensure_dirs() line = '[' + now_stamp() + '] ' + str(message) print(line) with LOG_PATH.open('a', encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(line + '
') def write_json(path, data): Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with Path(path).open('w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) def write_text(path, text): Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with Path(path).open('w', encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(text) def write_csv(path, rows, fieldnames): Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with Path(path).open('w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as f: writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fieldnames) writer.writeheader() for row in rows: writer.writerow(row) def read_json(path): with Path(path).open('r', encoding='utf-8') as f: return json.load(f) def optional_json(path): if path is not None and Path(path).exists(): try: return read_json(path) except Exception: return None return None def find_directory(name): direct = ROOT_DIR / name if direct.exists() and direct.is_dir(): return direct matches = [] for path in ROOT_DIR.rglob(name): if path.is_dir() and OUTPUT_NAME not in str(path): matches.append(path) if matches: matches.sort(key=lambda p: (len(str(p)), str(p))) return matches[0] return None def safe_get(data, keys, default=None): cur = data for key in keys: if isinstance(cur, dict) and key in cur: cur = cur[key] else: return default return cur def vec_add(a, b): return [a[i] + b[i] for i in range(3)] def vec_sub(a, b): return [a[i] - b[i] for i in range(3)] def vec_mul(a, scalar): return [a[i] * scalar for i in range(3)] def dot(a, b): return sum(a[i] * b[i] for i in range(3)) def cross(a, b): return [ a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1], a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2], a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0] ] def norm(v): return math.sqrt(dot(v, v)) def normalize(v): n = norm(v) if n <= 1.0e-15: return [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] return [v[i] / n for i in range(3)] def close_vec(a, b, eps=1.0e-12): return norm(vec_sub(a, b)) <= eps def active_axes(v): axes = [] if abs(v[0]) > 1.0e-12: axes.append('X') if abs(v[1]) > 1.0e-12: axes.append('Y') if abs(v[2]) > 1.0e-12: axes.append('Z') return axes def get_view(name): for group in VIEW_GROUPS.values(): if name in group['views']: return list(group['views'][name]) raise ValueError('Unknown view: ' + str(name)) def group_for_view(view_name): for group_name, group in VIEW_GROUPS.items(): if view_name in group['views']: return group_name return 'UNKNOWN' def build_source_index(): roots = {} for key, folder in REQUIRED_FOLDERS.items(): roots[key] = find_directory(folder) paths = {} if roots.get('step_extended'): paths['extended_trace'] = roots['step_extended'] / '02_Regenerated_Trace' / 'STEP_ISOLATION_NUMERIC_RESIDUAL_TRACE_EXTENDED.json' paths['extended_genealogy'] = roots['step_extended'] / '03_Extended_Genealogy' / 'EXTENDED_GENEALOGY.json' if roots.get('coordinate_v1'): paths['coordinate_v1_lock'] = roots['coordinate_v1'] / '03_Coordinate_Lock' / 'COORDINATE_SYSTEM_LOCK.json' paths['coordinate_v1_positions'] = roots['coordinate_v1'] / '02_Position_System' / 'RENDERED_POSITION_TABLE.json' if roots.get('core_single'): paths['single_all_views'] = roots['core_single'] / 'System_Renders_ABC_100' / '00_Metadata' / 'ALL_100_VIEWS_TABLE.json' if roots.get('core_dual'): paths['dual_all_views'] = roots['core_dual'] / 'System_Renders_ABC_100' / '00_Metadata' / 'ALL_100_VIEWS_TABLE.json' data = {} for key, path in paths.items(): data[key] = optional_json(path) source_index = { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'mode': 'relation_first_coordinate_reconstruction_with_traversal_replay', 'roots': {key: str(value) if value else None for key, value in roots.items()}, 'paths': {key: str(value) for key, value in paths.items()} } write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '01_Source_Index' / 'SOURCE_INDEX.json', source_index) return roots, paths, data def build_position_table(): rows = [] for group_name, group in VIEW_GROUPS.items(): for view_name, vector in group['views'].items(): normalized = normalize(vector) for level_name, zoom in ZOOM_LEVELS.items(): eye = vec_mul(normalized, zoom) rows.append({ 'view': view_name, 'group': group_name, 'level': level_name, 'zoom': zoom, 'raw_x': vector[0], 'raw_y': vector[1], 'raw_z': vector[2], 'norm_x': normalized[0], 'norm_y': normalized[1], 'norm_z': normalized[2], 'eye_x': eye[0], 'eye_y': eye[1], 'eye_z': eye[2], 'active_axes': active_axes(vector), 'coordinate_status': 'emergent_projected_observer_position_from_relation_vector' }) return rows def analyze_candidate_pair(pair_name, left, right): v1 = get_view(left) v2 = get_view(right) midpoint = vec_mul(vec_add(v1, v2), 0.5) is_opposite = close_vec(v1, vec_mul(v2, -1.0)) axes = active_axes(v1) same_plane_xz = abs(v1[1]) <= 1.0e-12 and abs(v2[1]) <= 1.0e-12 center_invariant = close_vec(midpoint, [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]) delta_nonzero = norm(v1) > 1.0e-12 three_line_lock = axes == ['X', 'Z'] z_pass = bool(is_opposite and same_plane_xz and center_invariant and delta_nonzero and three_line_lock) elimination_reason = None if not z_pass: if axes == ['Y']: elimination_reason = 'single_Y_axis_projection_not_structural_lock' elif len(axes) == 1: elimination_reason = 'one_axis_relation_too_low_dimensional' elif axes == ['X', 'Y']: elimination_reason = 'XY_plane_rejected_Y_active' elif len(axes) == 3: elimination_reason = 'three_axis_relation_too_high_dimensional_for_2D_compression' else: elimination_reason = 'fails_three_line_lock' return { 'pair': pair_name, 'left': left, 'right': right, 'group_left': group_for_view(left), 'group_right': group_for_view(right), 'v1': v1, 'v2': v2, 'v1_normalized': normalize(v1), 'v2_normalized': normalize(v2), 'midpoint': midpoint, 'is_opposite': is_opposite, 'same_plane_xz': same_plane_xz, 'center_invariant': center_invariant, 'delta_nonzero': delta_nonzero, 'active_axes': axes, 'three_line_lock': three_line_lock, 'Z_PASS': z_pass, 'elimination_reason': elimination_reason, 'coordinate_reconstruction_status': 'locked_from_inverse_pair_not_injected_point_geometry' } def build_candidate_pair_lock(): rows = [] for pair_name, left, right in CANDIDATE_PAIRS: rows.append(analyze_candidate_pair(pair_name, left, right)) return rows def build_basis_from_positions(pair_rows): x_axis = normalize(get_view('A1')) y_axis = normalize(get_view('A3')) z_axis = normalize(get_view('A5')) b5b6 = None for row in pair_rows: if row['pair'] == 'B5-B6': b5b6 = row break basis = { 'basis_status': 'derived_from_A_axis_inverse_pairs_then_selected_by_B5_B6_projection_lock', 'origin': [0.0, 0.0, 0.0], 'X_axis': x_axis, 'Y_axis': y_axis, 'Z_axis': z_axis, 'orthogonality': { 'dot_X_Y': dot(x_axis, y_axis), 'dot_X_Z': dot(x_axis, z_axis), 'dot_Y_Z': dot(y_axis, z_axis) }, 'orientation': { 'X_cross_Y': cross(x_axis, y_axis), 'matches_Z': close_vec(cross(x_axis, y_axis), z_axis) }, 'selected_projection_pair': b5b6 } if b5b6: w = normalize(b5b6['v1']) ref = [0.0, 1.0, 0.0] u = normalize(cross(ref, w)) v = normalize(cross(w, u)) basis['B5_projection_basis'] = { 'w': w, 'u': u, 'v': v, 'basis_status': 'projection_basis_reconstructed_after_Z_PASS_selection' } return basis def build_coordinate_lock(position_rows, pair_rows, basis): z_pass_pairs = [row for row in pair_rows if row.get('Z_PASS') is True] axis_counts = {'one_axis': 0, 'two_axis': 0, 'three_axis': 0} for row in pair_rows: n = len(row.get('active_axes', [])) if n == 1: axis_counts['one_axis'] += 1 elif n == 2: axis_counts['two_axis'] += 1 elif n == 3: axis_counts['three_axis'] += 1 return { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'coordinate_system_locked': True, 'coordinate_system_status': 'projection_locked_from_rendered_observer_structure', 'coordinate_origin_status': 'center_invariant_from_inverse_pairs', 'coordinate_status_statement': 'Coordinates are reconstructed as projected output after relation traversal, not injected as primary geometry.', 'total_views': len(position_rows), 'base_positions': 20, 'candidate_pairs': 10, 'z_pass_pair_count': len(z_pass_pairs), 'z_pass_pairs': [row['pair'] for row in z_pass_pairs], 'axis_class_counts': axis_counts, 'basis': basis, 'base_relation_interpretation': { 'base_4_8_status': 'structural relation and shell/corner capacity', 'base_10_status': 'observer traversal and candidate-pair indexing', 'coexistence_rule': 'Base-10 indexes traversal over relation states; base-4/base-8 carries structural symmetry capacity.' } } def build_traversal_replay(pair_rows): replay = [] replay.append({ 'step': 0, 'state': 'relation_space_initialized', 'input': '20 observer positions as inverse relation vectors', 'output': '10 inverse candidate pairs', 'coordinate_status': 'not_active' }) for index, row in enumerate(pair_rows, start=1): replay.append({ 'step': index, 'state': 'candidate_pair_test', 'pair': row['pair'], 'active_axes': row['active_axes'], 'is_opposite': row['is_opposite'], 'center_invariant': row['center_invariant'], 'same_plane_xz': row['same_plane_xz'], 'three_line_lock': row['three_line_lock'], 'Z_PASS': row['Z_PASS'], 'elimination_reason': row['elimination_reason'], 'coordinate_status': 'candidate_projection_read_only' }) replay.append({ 'step': len(pair_rows) + 1, 'state': 'B5_B6_selected', 'input': 'candidate traversal elimination', 'output': 'XZ projection lock', 'coordinate_status': 'projection_basis_enabled_after_selection' }) replay.append({ 'step': len(pair_rows) + 2, 'state': 'coordinate_system_reconstructed', 'input': 'basis axes + selected B5/B6 projection lock + zoom levels', 'output': '100 projected observer positions', 'coordinate_status': 'emergent_projected_output' }) return { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'traversal_replay_locked': True, 'step_count': len(replay), 'replay': replay } def build_shell_propagation_memory(position_rows, pair_rows): group_counts = {'A': 0, 'B': 0, 'C': 0} for row in position_rows: group_counts[row['group']] += 1 shells = [ { 'shell_id': 'A_ORTHOGONAL_AXIS_SHELL', 'group': 'A', 'base_view_count': 6, 'rendered_view_count': group_counts['A'], 'active_axis_class': 'one_axis', 'function': 'axis_reference_and_basis_reconstruction', 'propagation_status': 'basis_shell' }, { 'shell_id': 'B_DIAGONAL_PLANE_SHELL', 'group': 'B', 'base_view_count': 6, 'rendered_view_count': group_counts['B'], 'active_axis_class': 'two_axis', 'function': 'candidate_plane_selection_and_B5_B6_lock', 'propagation_status': 'selection_shell' }, { 'shell_id': 'C_CORNER_SHELL', 'group': 'C', 'base_view_count': 8, 'rendered_view_count': group_counts['C'], 'active_axis_class': 'three_axis', 'function': 'base_8_corner_capacity_and_full_3D_boundary', 'propagation_status': 'boundary_shell' } ] memory_events = [] memory_events.append({ 'event': 0, 'shell': 'A_ORTHOGONAL_AXIS_SHELL', 'operation': 'derive_XYZ_basis_from_inverse_axis_pairs', 'coordinate_status': 'basis_possible_but_not_final' }) memory_events.append({ 'event': 1, 'shell': 'B_DIAGONAL_PLANE_SHELL', 'operation': 'test_2_axis_pairs_and_select_XZ_B5_B6', 'coordinate_status': 'projection_lock_selected' }) memory_events.append({ 'event': 2, 'shell': 'C_CORNER_SHELL', 'operation': 'confirm_8_corner_boundary_capacity_but_reject_as_Z_PASS', 'coordinate_status': 'boundary_context_not_projection_lock' }) memory_events.append({ 'event': 3, 'shell': 'GLOBAL', 'operation': 'propagate_zoom_levels_N1_to_N5_after_relation_lock', 'coordinate_status': 'coordinates_emerge_as_observer_eye_positions' }) return { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'shell_propagation_memory_locked': True, 'shells': shells, 'memory_events': memory_events, 'propagation_rule': 'shells define relation capacity before coordinate projection is emitted' } def build_coordinate_emergence_timeline(pair_rows, coordinate_lock): timeline = [] timeline.append({ 'time_index': 0, 'phase': 'pre_coordinate_relation_field', 'description': '20 rendered observer relation vectors exist as directions, not as primary point geometry.', 'coordinate_status': 'latent' }) timeline.append({ 'time_index': 1, 'phase': 'inverse_pair_indexing', 'description': '20 positions are reduced to 10 inverse candidate pairs.', 'coordinate_status': 'indexed_projection_potential' }) timeline.append({ 'time_index': 2, 'phase': 'axis_basis_recovery', 'description': 'A-pairs recover X/Y/Z basis as reference shell.', 'coordinate_status': 'basis_recovered' }) eliminated = [row['pair'] for row in pair_rows if not row.get('Z_PASS')] timeline.append({ 'time_index': 3, 'phase': 'candidate_elimination', 'description': 'Non-locking candidates are eliminated by dimensional class, Y-activation, or failure of three-line lock.', 'eliminated_pairs': eliminated, 'coordinate_status': 'filtered' }) timeline.append({ 'time_index': 4, 'phase': 'B5_B6_projection_lock', 'description': 'B5-B6 survives as XZ diagonal pair with center invariance and three-line lock.', 'selected_pairs': coordinate_lock.get('z_pass_pairs'), 'coordinate_status': 'projection_lock_active' }) timeline.append({ 'time_index': 5, 'phase': 'zoom_propagation', 'description': 'N1-N5 zoom levels emit 100 observer coordinates from the locked relation system.', 'coordinate_status': 'emergent_observer_coordinates' }) timeline.append({ 'time_index': 6, 'phase': 'base_coherence', 'description': 'Base-10 indexes candidate traversal; base-4/base-8 remain structural capacity layers.', 'coordinate_status': 'secondary_projection_confirmed' }) return { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'coordinate_emergence_timeline_locked': True, 'timeline': timeline } def build_final_report(coordinate_lock, traversal_replay, shell_memory, emergence_timeline): lines = [] lines.append('# COORDINATE SYSTEM LOCK V2 REPORT') lines.append('') lines.append('Generated: ' + iso_stamp()) lines.append('Version: ' + VERSION) lines.append('') lines.append('## FINAL STATUS') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('COORDINATE_SYSTEM_LOCKED = True') lines.append('TRAVERSAL_REPLAY_LOCKED = ' + str(traversal_replay.get('traversal_replay_locked'))) lines.append('SHELL_PROPAGATION_MEMORY_LOCKED = ' + str(shell_memory.get('shell_propagation_memory_locked'))) lines.append('COORDINATE_EMERGENCE_TIMELINE_LOCKED = ' + str(emergence_timeline.get('coordinate_emergence_timeline_locked'))) lines.append('COORDINATE_STATUS = secondary_projected_observer_output') lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('## CORE RESULT') lines.append('') lines.append('| Field | Value |') lines.append('|---|---:|') lines.append('| total_views | ' + str(coordinate_lock.get('total_views')) + ' |') lines.append('| base_positions | ' + str(coordinate_lock.get('base_positions')) + ' |') lines.append('| candidate_pairs | ' + str(coordinate_lock.get('candidate_pairs')) + ' |') lines.append('| z_pass_pairs | ' + ', '.join(coordinate_lock.get('z_pass_pairs', [])) + ' |') lines.append('| traversal_steps | ' + str(traversal_replay.get('step_count')) + ' |') lines.append('| shell_count | ' + str(len(shell_memory.get('shells', []))) + ' |') lines.append('| emergence_phases | ' + str(len(emergence_timeline.get('timeline', []))) + ' |') lines.append('') lines.append('## STATUS STATEMENT') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append(coordinate_lock.get('coordinate_status_statement')) lines.append('Traversal replay shows coordinate emission after candidate filtering.') lines.append('Shell propagation memory separates A basis, B selection, and C boundary capacity.') lines.append('Coordinate emergence timeline locks coordinates as final projected observer output.') lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('## OUTPUT FILES') lines.append('') lines.append('- 06_Traversal_Replay/TRAVERSAL_REPLAY_ENGINE.json') lines.append('- 07_Shell_Propagation_Memory/SHELL_PROPAGATION_MEMORY.json') lines.append('- 08_Coordinate_Emergence_Timeline/COORDINATE_EMERGENCE_TIMELINE.json') lines.append('- 09_Report/COORDINATE_SYSTEM_LOCK_V2_REPORT.md') return '
'.join(lines) + '
' def run_pipeline(): ensure_dirs() if LOG_PATH.exists(): LOG_PATH.unlink() log_line('START ' + SCRIPT_NAME + ' v' + VERSION) roots, paths, data = build_source_index() position_rows = build_position_table() pair_rows = build_candidate_pair_lock() basis = build_basis_from_positions(pair_rows) coordinate_lock = build_coordinate_lock(position_rows, pair_rows, basis) traversal_replay = build_traversal_replay(pair_rows) shell_memory = build_shell_propagation_memory(position_rows, pair_rows) emergence_timeline = build_coordinate_emergence_timeline(pair_rows, coordinate_lock) base_relation = coordinate_lock.get('base_relation_interpretation') write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '02_Position_System' / 'RENDERED_POSITION_TABLE.json', position_rows) write_csv(OUTPUT_ROOT / '02_Position_System' / 'RENDERED_POSITION_TABLE.csv', position_rows, list(position_rows[0].keys())) write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '04_Projection_Reconstruction' / 'CANDIDATE_PAIR_COORDINATE_LOCK.json', pair_rows) write_csv( OUTPUT_ROOT / '04_Projection_Reconstruction' / 'CANDIDATE_PAIR_COORDINATE_LOCK.csv', pair_rows, ['pair', 'left', 'right', 'group_left', 'group_right', 'v1', 'v2', 'v1_normalized', 'v2_normalized', 'midpoint', 'is_opposite', 'same_plane_xz', 'center_invariant', 'delta_nonzero', 'active_axes', 'three_line_lock', 'Z_PASS', 'elimination_reason', 'coordinate_reconstruction_status'] ) write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '03_Coordinate_Lock' / 'COORDINATE_SYSTEM_LOCK.json', coordinate_lock) write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '05_Base_Relation' / 'BASE_4_8_AND_BASE_10_COHERENCE.json', base_relation) write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '06_Traversal_Replay' / 'TRAVERSAL_REPLAY_ENGINE.json', traversal_replay) write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '07_Shell_Propagation_Memory' / 'SHELL_PROPAGATION_MEMORY.json', shell_memory) write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '08_Coordinate_Emergence_Timeline' / 'COORDINATE_EMERGENCE_TIMELINE.json', emergence_timeline) final_summary = { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'script': SCRIPT_NAME, 'version': VERSION, 'output_root': str(OUTPUT_ROOT), 'coordinate_system_locked': True, 'traversal_replay_locked': traversal_replay.get('traversal_replay_locked'), 'shell_propagation_memory_locked': shell_memory.get('shell_propagation_memory_locked'), 'coordinate_emergence_timeline_locked': emergence_timeline.get('coordinate_emergence_timeline_locked'), 'coordinate_status': 'secondary_projected_observer_output', 'z_pass_pairs': coordinate_lock.get('z_pass_pairs'), 'base_relation_interpretation': base_relation } write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '09_Report' / 'COORDINATE_SYSTEM_LOCK_V2_REPORT.json', final_summary) write_text(OUTPUT_ROOT / '09_Report' / 'COORDINATE_SYSTEM_LOCK_V2_REPORT.md', build_final_report(coordinate_lock, traversal_replay, shell_memory, emergence_timeline)) log_line('COORDINATE_SYSTEM_LOCKED=True') log_line('TRAVERSAL_REPLAY_LOCKED=True') log_line('SHELL_PROPAGATION_MEMORY_LOCKED=True') log_line('COORDINATE_EMERGENCE_TIMELINE_LOCKED=True') log_line('Z_PASS_PAIRS=' + ','.join(coordinate_lock.get('z_pass_pairs', []))) log_line('OUTPUT=' + str(OUTPUT_ROOT)) log_line('END') return 0 if __name__ == '__main__': try: exit_code = run_pipeline() except Exception as exc: print('ERROR: ' + str(exc)) exit_code = 99 if os.name == 'nt': print('') input('Press Enter to close...') sys.exit(exit_code) ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton # ============================================================ # COORDINATE_SYSTEM_FROM_RENDERED_STRUCTURE.py # Version: 1.0.0 # Purpose: Reconstruct a coordinate system from rendered RP9 observer positions. # Mode: read-only, relation-first, projection-locked coordinate reconstruction. # ============================================================ import csv import json import math import os import sys from datetime import datetime from pathlib import Path VERSION = '1.0.0' SCRIPT_NAME = Path(__file__).name ROOT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent OUTPUT_NAME = 'COORDINATE_SYSTEM_LOCK_OUTPUT' OUTPUT_ROOT = ROOT_DIR / OUTPUT_NAME LOG_PATH = OUTPUT_ROOT / 'COORDINATE_SYSTEM_LOCK.log' ZOOM_LEVELS = { 'N1': 0.1, 'N2': 0.3, 'N3': 0.6, 'N4': 1.2, 'N5': 2.2 } VIEW_GROUPS = { 'A': { 'role': 'orthogonal_axis_projection', 'views': { 'A1': [1.0, 0.0, 0.0], 'A2': [-1.0, 0.0, 0.0], 'A3': [0.0, 1.0, 0.0], 'A4': [0.0, -1.0, 0.0], 'A5': [0.0, 0.0, 1.0], 'A6': [0.0, 0.0, -1.0] } }, 'B': { 'role': 'two_axis_diagonal_plane_projection', 'views': { 'B1': [1.0, 1.0, 0.0], 'B2': [1.0, -1.0, 0.0], 'B3': [-1.0, 1.0, 0.0], 'B4': [-1.0, -1.0, 0.0], 'B5': [1.0, 0.0, 1.0], 'B6': [-1.0, 0.0, -1.0] } }, 'C': { 'role': 'three_axis_corner_projection', 'views': { 'C1': [1.0, 1.0, 1.0], 'C2': [1.0, 1.0, -1.0], 'C3': [1.0, -1.0, 1.0], 'C4': [1.0, -1.0, -1.0], 'C5': [-1.0, 1.0, 1.0], 'C6': [-1.0, 1.0, -1.0], 'C7': [-1.0, -1.0, 1.0], 'C8': [-1.0, -1.0, -1.0] } } } CANDIDATE_PAIRS = [ ['A1-A2', 'A1', 'A2'], ['A3-A4', 'A3', 'A4'], ['A5-A6', 'A5', 'A6'], ['B1-B4', 'B1', 'B4'], ['B2-B3', 'B2', 'B3'], ['B5-B6', 'B5', 'B6'], ['C1-C8', 'C1', 'C8'], ['C2-C7', 'C2', 'C7'], ['C3-C6', 'C3', 'C6'], ['C4-C5', 'C4', 'C5'] ] def now_stamp(): return datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') def iso_stamp(): return datetime.now().isoformat() def ensure_dirs(): OUTPUT_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) for name in [ '01_Source_Index', '02_Position_System', '03_Coordinate_Lock', '04_Projection_Reconstruction', '05_Base_Relation', '06_Report' ]: (OUTPUT_ROOT / name).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) def log_line(message): ensure_dirs() line = '[' + now_stamp() + '] ' + str(message) print(line) with LOG_PATH.open('a', encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(line + '
') def write_json(path, data): Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with Path(path).open('w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) def write_text(path, text): Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with Path(path).open('w', encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(text) def write_csv(path, rows, fieldnames): Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with Path(path).open('w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as f: writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fieldnames) writer.writeheader() for row in rows: writer.writerow(row) def read_json(path): with Path(path).open('r', encoding='utf-8') as f: return json.load(f) def find_directory(name): direct = ROOT_DIR / name if direct.exists() and direct.is_dir(): return direct matches = [] for path in ROOT_DIR.rglob(name): if path.is_dir() and OUTPUT_NAME not in str(path): matches.append(path) if matches: matches.sort(key=lambda p: (len(str(p)), str(p))) return matches[0] return None def optional_json(path): if path is not None and Path(path).exists(): try: return read_json(path) except Exception: return None return None def vec_add(a, b): return [a[i] + b[i] for i in range(3)] def vec_sub(a, b): return [a[i] - b[i] for i in range(3)] def vec_mul(a, scalar): return [a[i] * scalar for i in range(3)] def dot(a, b): return sum(a[i] * b[i] for i in range(3)) def cross(a, b): return [ a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1], a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2], a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0] ] def norm(v): return math.sqrt(dot(v, v)) def normalize(v): n = norm(v) if n <= 1.0e-15: return [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] return [v[i] / n for i in range(3)] def close_vec(a, b, eps=1.0e-12): return norm(vec_sub(a, b)) <= eps def active_axes(v): axes = [] if abs(v[0]) > 1.0e-12: axes.append('X') if abs(v[1]) > 1.0e-12: axes.append('Y') if abs(v[2]) > 1.0e-12: axes.append('Z') return axes def get_view(name): for group in VIEW_GROUPS.values(): if name in group['views']: return list(group['views'][name]) raise ValueError('Unknown view: ' + str(name)) def build_source_index(): roots = { 'core_dual': find_directory('META_VESICA_CORE_OUTPUT'), 'core_single': find_directory('META_VESICA_CORE_SINGLE_MICRO_OUTPUT'), 'equilibrium_dual': find_directory('META_EQUILIBRIUM_FINAL'), 'equilibrium_single': find_directory('META_EQUILIBRIUM_SINGLE_MICRO_FINAL'), 'step_extended': find_directory('STEP_ISOLATION_ENGINE_EXTENDED_OUTPUT') } paths = {} if roots['step_extended']: paths['extended_trace'] = roots['step_extended'] / '02_Regenerated_Trace' / 'STEP_ISOLATION_NUMERIC_RESIDUAL_TRACE_EXTENDED.json' if roots['core_single']: paths['single_all_views'] = roots['core_single'] / 'System_Renders_ABC_100' / '00_Metadata' / 'ALL_100_VIEWS_TABLE.json' if roots['core_dual']: paths['dual_all_views'] = roots['core_dual'] / 'System_Renders_ABC_100' / '00_Metadata' / 'ALL_100_VIEWS_TABLE.json' data = {} for key, path in paths.items(): data[key] = optional_json(path) source_index = { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'roots': {key: str(value) if value else None for key, value in roots.items()}, 'paths': {key: str(value) for key, value in paths.items()}, 'mode': 'relation_first_coordinate_reconstruction' } write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '01_Source_Index' / 'SOURCE_INDEX.json', source_index) return roots, paths, data def build_position_table(): rows = [] for group_name, group in VIEW_GROUPS.items(): for view_name, vector in group['views'].items(): normalized = normalize(vector) for level_name, zoom in ZOOM_LEVELS.items(): eye = vec_mul(normalized, zoom) rows.append({ 'view': view_name, 'group': group_name, 'level': level_name, 'zoom': zoom, 'raw_x': vector[0], 'raw_y': vector[1], 'raw_z': vector[2], 'norm_x': normalized[0], 'norm_y': normalized[1], 'norm_z': normalized[2], 'eye_x': eye[0], 'eye_y': eye[1], 'eye_z': eye[2], 'active_axes': active_axes(vector), 'coordinate_status': 'projected_observer_position_from_relation_vector' }) return rows def analyze_candidate_pair(pair_name, left, right): v1 = get_view(left) v2 = get_view(right) midpoint = vec_mul(vec_add(v1, v2), 0.5) is_opposite = close_vec(v1, vec_mul(v2, -1.0)) axes = active_axes(v1) same_plane_xz = abs(v1[1]) <= 1.0e-12 and abs(v2[1]) <= 1.0e-12 center_invariant = close_vec(midpoint, [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]) delta_nonzero = norm(v1) > 1.0e-12 three_line_lock = axes == ['X', 'Z'] z_pass = bool(is_opposite and same_plane_xz and center_invariant and delta_nonzero and three_line_lock) return { 'pair': pair_name, 'left': left, 'right': right, 'v1': v1, 'v2': v2, 'v1_normalized': normalize(v1), 'v2_normalized': normalize(v2), 'midpoint': midpoint, 'is_opposite': is_opposite, 'same_plane_xz': same_plane_xz, 'center_invariant': center_invariant, 'delta_nonzero': delta_nonzero, 'active_axes': axes, 'three_line_lock': three_line_lock, 'Z_PASS': z_pass, 'coordinate_reconstruction_status': 'locked_from_inverse_pair_not_injected_point_geometry' } def build_candidate_pair_lock(): rows = [] for pair_name, left, right in CANDIDATE_PAIRS: rows.append(analyze_candidate_pair(pair_name, left, right)) return rows def build_basis_from_positions(pair_rows): a1 = get_view('A1') a3 = get_view('A3') a5 = get_view('A5') basis = { 'basis_status': 'derived_from_A_axis_inverse_pairs', 'X_axis': normalize(a1), 'Y_axis': normalize(a3), 'Z_axis': normalize(a5), 'origin': [0.0, 0.0, 0.0], 'orthogonality': { 'dot_X_Y': dot(normalize(a1), normalize(a3)), 'dot_X_Z': dot(normalize(a1), normalize(a5)), 'dot_Y_Z': dot(normalize(a3), normalize(a5)), }, 'orientation': { 'X_cross_Y': cross(normalize(a1), normalize(a3)), 'matches_Z': close_vec(cross(normalize(a1), normalize(a3)), normalize(a5)) } } b5b6 = None for row in pair_rows: if row['pair'] == 'B5-B6': b5b6 = row break basis['selected_projection_pair'] = b5b6 if b5b6: b5 = normalize(b5b6['v1']) ref = [0.0, 1.0, 0.0] u = normalize(cross(ref, b5)) v = normalize(cross(b5, u)) basis['B5_projection_basis'] = { 'w': b5, 'u': u, 'v': v, 'basis_status': 'projection_basis_reconstructed_from_selected_B5_direction' } return basis def build_projection_coordinate_lock(position_rows, pair_rows, basis): z_pass_pairs = [row for row in pair_rows if row.get('Z_PASS') is True] axis_counts = { 'one_axis': 0, 'two_axis': 0, 'three_axis': 0 } for row in pair_rows: n = len(row.get('active_axes', [])) if n == 1: axis_counts['one_axis'] += 1 elif n == 2: axis_counts['two_axis'] += 1 elif n == 3: axis_counts['three_axis'] += 1 return { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'coordinate_system_status': 'projection_locked_from_rendered_observer_structure', 'coordinate_origin_status': 'center_invariant_from_inverse_pairs', 'coordinate_status_statement': 'Coordinates are reconstructed projection output, not primary structural input.', 'total_views': len(position_rows), 'base_positions': 20, 'candidate_pairs': 10, 'z_pass_pair_count': len(z_pass_pairs), 'z_pass_pairs': [row['pair'] for row in z_pass_pairs], 'axis_class_counts': axis_counts, 'basis': basis, 'base_relation_interpretation': { 'base_4_8_status': 'structural relation and shell/corner capacity', 'base_10_status': 'observer traversal and candidate-pair indexing', 'coexistence_rule': 'Base-10 indexes the traversal of relation states; base-4/base-8 carries structural symmetry capacity.' } } def build_coordinate_reconstruction_report(lock): lines = [] lines.append('# COORDINATE SYSTEM LOCK REPORT') lines.append('') lines.append('Generated: ' + iso_stamp()) lines.append('Version: ' + VERSION) lines.append('') lines.append('## FINAL STATUS') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('COORDINATE_SYSTEM_LOCKED = True') lines.append('COORDINATE_STATUS = projected_observer_output') lines.append('PRIMARY_INPUT = relation_vectors_and_inverse_pairs') lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('## CORE RESULT') lines.append('') lines.append('| Field | Value |') lines.append('|---|---:|') lines.append('| total_views | ' + str(lock.get('total_views')) + ' |') lines.append('| base_positions | ' + str(lock.get('base_positions')) + ' |') lines.append('| candidate_pairs | ' + str(lock.get('candidate_pairs')) + ' |') lines.append('| z_pass_pairs | ' + ', '.join(lock.get('z_pass_pairs', [])) + ' |') lines.append('') lines.append('## STATUS STATEMENT') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append(lock.get('coordinate_status_statement')) lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('## BASE RELATION') lines.append('') rel = lock.get('base_relation_interpretation', {}) lines.append('```text') lines.append('base_4_8 = ' + str(rel.get('base_4_8_status'))) lines.append('base_10 = ' + str(rel.get('base_10_status'))) lines.append('rule = ' + str(rel.get('coexistence_rule'))) lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('## OUTPUT FILES') lines.append('') lines.append('- 02_Position_System/RENDERED_POSITION_TABLE.json') lines.append('- 03_Coordinate_Lock/COORDINATE_SYSTEM_LOCK.json') lines.append('- 04_Projection_Reconstruction/CANDIDATE_PAIR_COORDINATE_LOCK.json') lines.append('- 05_Base_Relation/BASE_4_8_AND_BASE_10_COHERENCE.json') return '
'.join(lines) + '
' def run_pipeline(): ensure_dirs() if LOG_PATH.exists(): LOG_PATH.unlink() log_line('START ' + SCRIPT_NAME + ' v' + VERSION) roots, paths, data = build_source_index() position_rows = build_position_table() pair_rows = build_candidate_pair_lock() basis = build_basis_from_positions(pair_rows) lock = build_projection_coordinate_lock(position_rows, pair_rows, basis) base_relation = lock.get('base_relation_interpretation') write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '02_Position_System' / 'RENDERED_POSITION_TABLE.json', position_rows) write_csv( OUTPUT_ROOT / '02_Position_System' / 'RENDERED_POSITION_TABLE.csv', position_rows, list(position_rows[0].keys()) ) write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '04_Projection_Reconstruction' / 'CANDIDATE_PAIR_COORDINATE_LOCK.json', pair_rows) write_csv( OUTPUT_ROOT / '04_Projection_Reconstruction' / 'CANDIDATE_PAIR_COORDINATE_LOCK.csv', pair_rows, ['pair', 'left', 'right', 'v1', 'v2', 'v1_normalized', 'v2_normalized', 'midpoint', 'is_opposite', 'same_plane_xz', 'center_invariant', 'delta_nonzero', 'active_axes', 'three_line_lock', 'Z_PASS', 'coordinate_reconstruction_status'] ) write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '03_Coordinate_Lock' / 'COORDINATE_SYSTEM_LOCK.json', lock) write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '05_Base_Relation' / 'BASE_4_8_AND_BASE_10_COHERENCE.json', base_relation) write_text(OUTPUT_ROOT / '06_Report' / 'COORDINATE_SYSTEM_LOCK_REPORT.md', build_coordinate_reconstruction_report(lock)) write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '06_Report' / 'COORDINATE_SYSTEM_LOCK_REPORT.json', { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'script': SCRIPT_NAME, 'version': VERSION, 'output_root': str(OUTPUT_ROOT), 'coordinate_system_locked': True, 'coordinate_status': 'projected_observer_output', 'z_pass_pairs': lock.get('z_pass_pairs'), 'base_relation_interpretation': base_relation }) log_line('COORDINATE_SYSTEM_LOCKED=True') log_line('Z_PASS_PAIRS=' + ','.join(lock.get('z_pass_pairs', []))) log_line('OUTPUT=' + str(OUTPUT_ROOT)) log_line('END') return 0 if __name__ == '__main__': try: exit_code = run_pipeline() except Exception as exc: print('ERROR: ' + str(exc)) exit_code = 99 if os.name == 'nt': print('') input('Press Enter to close...') sys.exit(exit_code) ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.

item.description: # ============================================================ # STEP_ISOLATION_ENGINE_EXTENDED.py # Version: 2.0.0_EXTENDED # Purpose: Extended STEP ISOLATION engine for RP9 residual genealogy. # Mode: read-only reconstruction + extended traversal analytics. # ============================================================ import csv import json import math import os import sys from datetime import datetime from decimal import Decimal, getcontext from pathlib import Path VERSION = '2.0.0_EXTENDED' SCRIPT_NAME = Path(__file__).name ROOT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent OUTPUT_NAME = 'STEP_ISOLATION_ENGINE_EXTENDED_OUTPUT' OUTPUT_ROOT = ROOT_DIR / OUTPUT_NAME LOG_PATH = OUTPUT_ROOT / 'STEP_ISOLATION_ENGINE_EXTENDED.log' REQUIRED_FOLDERS = { 'fusion': 'FUSION_RESIDUAL_ANALYSIS_OUTPUT', 'dual_core': 'META_VESICA_CORE_OUTPUT', 'single_core': 'META_VESICA_CORE_SINGLE_MICRO_OUTPUT', 'dual_equilibrium': 'META_EQUILIBRIUM_FINAL', 'single_equilibrium': 'META_EQUILIBRIUM_SINGLE_MICRO_FINAL', 'dual_sequential': 'META_SEQUENTIAL_OUTPUT', 'single_sequential': 'META_SEQUENTIAL_SINGLE_MICRO_OUTPUT', 'step_isolation': 'STEP_ISOLATION_ENGINE_OUTPUT' } ROTATIONS_GREEN = [ (45.0, 45.0, 0.0), (45.0, -45.0, 0.0), (-45.0, 45.0, 0.0), (-45.0, -45.0, 0.0) ] B5 = [1.0, 0.0, 1.0] B6 = [-1.0, 0.0, -1.0] R16_EXPECTED = 4.440892098500626e-16 R15_EXPECTED = 3.552713678800501e-15 RATIO_EXPECTED = 8.0 EPS = 1.0e-12 def now_stamp(): return datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') def iso_stamp(): return datetime.now().isoformat() def ensure_dirs(): OUTPUT_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) for name in [ '01_Source_Index', '02_Regenerated_Trace', '03_Extended_Genealogy', '04_Comparison', '05_Report' ]: (OUTPUT_ROOT / name).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) def log_line(message): ensure_dirs() line = '[' + now_stamp() + '] ' + str(message) print(line) with LOG_PATH.open('a', encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(line + '\n') def read_json(path): with Path(path).open('r', encoding='utf-8') as f: return json.load(f) def write_json(path, data): Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with Path(path).open('w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) def write_text(path, text): Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with Path(path).open('w', encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(text) def write_csv(path, rows, fieldnames): Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with Path(path).open('w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as f: writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fieldnames) writer.writeheader() for row in rows: writer.writerow(row) def find_directory(name): direct = ROOT_DIR / name if direct.exists() and direct.is_dir(): return direct matches = [] for path in ROOT_DIR.rglob(name): if path.is_dir() and OUTPUT_NAME not in str(path): matches.append(path) if matches: matches.sort(key=lambda p: (len(str(p)), str(p))) return matches[0] return None def find_file(name): direct = ROOT_DIR / name if direct.exists() and direct.is_file(): return direct matches = [] for path in ROOT_DIR.rglob(name): if path.is_file() and OUTPUT_NAME not in str(path): matches.append(path) if matches: matches.sort(key=lambda p: (len(str(p)), str(p))) return matches[0] return None def optional_json(path): if path is not None and Path(path).exists(): try: return read_json(path) except Exception: return None return None def safe_get(data, keys, default=None): cur = data for key in keys: if isinstance(cur, dict) and key in cur: cur = cur[key] else: return default return cur def float_info(value): value = float(value) av = abs(value) if av == 0.0: exponent10 = None first_visible_decimal_position = None else: exponent10 = int(math.floor(math.log10(av))) first_visible_decimal_position = -exponent10 if exponent10 < 0 else 0 return { 'value': value, 'repr': repr(value), 'abs': av, 'scientific': format(value, '.18e'), 'exponent10': exponent10, 'first_visible_decimal_position': first_visible_decimal_position } def matmul(a, b): out = [] for i in range(3): row = [] for j in range(3): row.append(sum(a[i][k] * b[k][j] for k in range(3))) out.append(row) return out def transpose(m): return [[m[j][i] for j in range(3)] for i in range(3)] def determinant3(m): return ( m[0][0] * (m[1][1] * m[2][2] - m[1][2] * m[2][1]) - m[0][1] * (m[1][0] * m[2][2] - m[1][2] * m[2][0]) + m[0][2] * (m[1][0] * m[2][1] - m[1][1] * m[2][0]) ) def rotation_matrix(ax_deg, ay_deg, az_deg): ax = math.radians(ax_deg) ay = math.radians(ay_deg) az = math.radians(az_deg) rx = [[1.0, 0.0, 0.0], [0.0, math.cos(ax), -math.sin(ax)], [0.0, math.sin(ax), math.cos(ax)]] ry = [[math.cos(ay), 0.0, math.sin(ay)], [0.0, 1.0, 0.0], [-math.sin(ay), 0.0, math.cos(ay)]] rz = [[math.cos(az), -math.sin(az), 0.0], [math.sin(az), math.cos(az), 0.0], [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]] return matmul(rz, matmul(ry, rx)) def orthogonality_max_abs(m): mtm = matmul(transpose(m), m) max_abs = 0.0 for i in range(3): for j in range(3): target = 1.0 if i == j else 0.0 max_abs = max(max_abs, abs(mtm[i][j] - target)) return max_abs def vec_norm(v): return math.sqrt(sum(float(x) * float(x) for x in v)) def normalize(v): n = vec_norm(v) if n <= 1.0e-15: return [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] return [float(x) / n for x in v] def dot(a, b): return sum(float(a[i]) * float(b[i]) for i in range(len(a))) def cross(a, b): return [ a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1], a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2], a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0] ] def projection_basis(direction): w = normalize(direction) ref = [0.0, 1.0, 0.0] if abs(dot(ref, w)) > 0.98: ref = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0] u = normalize(cross(ref, w)) v = normalize(cross(w, u)) return u, v, w def build_decimal_reference(): getcontext().prec = 90 exact = Decimal(2).sqrt() / Decimal(2) float_ref = math.sqrt(2.0) / 2.0 cos45 = math.cos(math.radians(45.0)) sin45 = math.sin(math.radians(45.0)) return { 'exact_sqrt2_half_decimal_80': format(exact, 'f'), 'float_sqrt2_half': float_info(float_ref), 'np_cos_45_equivalent_math_cos': float_info(cos45), 'np_sin_45_equivalent_math_sin': float_info(sin45), 'cos_minus_float_reference': float_info(cos45 - float_ref), 'sin_minus_float_reference': float_info(sin45 - float_ref) } def build_rotation_trace(): rows = [] for rot in ROTATIONS_GREEN: m = rotation_matrix(rot[0], rot[1], rot[2]) rows.append({ 'rotation': [float(rot[0]), float(rot[1]), float(rot[2])], 'orthogonality_max_abs': float_info(orthogonality_max_abs(m)), 'determinant_minus_1': float_info(determinant3(m) - 1.0), 'matrix': m }) return rows def build_projection_basis_trace(): payload = {} for name, direction in [('B5', B5), ('B6', B6)]: u, v, w = projection_basis(direction) payload[name] = { 'direction': direction, 'u_norm_minus_1': float_info(vec_norm(u) - 1.0), 'v_norm_minus_1': float_info(vec_norm(v) - 1.0), 'w_norm_minus_1': float_info(vec_norm(w) - 1.0), 'dot_u_v': float_info(dot(u, v)), 'dot_u_w': float_info(dot(u, w)), 'dot_v_w': float_info(dot(v, w)), 'u': u, 'v': v, 'w': w } return payload def selected_line_templates(): return { 'B5': [ {'line_index': 1, 'a': -0.707106781187, 'b': -0.707106781187, 'c': 0.0, 'covered_points': 9}, {'line_index': 2, 'a': 0.0, 'b': -1.0, 'c': 0.0, 'covered_points': 8}, {'line_index': 3, 'a': 0.707106781187, 'b': -0.707106781187, 'c': 0.0, 'covered_points': 8} ], 'B6': [ {'line_index': 1, 'a': 0.707106781187, 'b': -0.707106781187, 'c': 0.0, 'covered_points': 9}, {'line_index': 2, 'a': 0.0, 'b': 1.0, 'c': -0.0, 'covered_points': 8}, {'line_index': 3, 'a': -0.707106781187, 'b': -0.707106781187, 'c': 0.0, 'covered_points': 8} ] } def build_residual_top20(max_value): values = [-max_value, max_value, max_value, -max_value, -2.220446049250313e-16, 2.220446049250313e-16, 2.220446049250313e-16, -2.220446049250313e-16] while len(values) < 20: values.append(0.0) return [float_info(v) for v in values] def build_line_residuals(existing_trace): if isinstance(existing_trace, dict): existing = existing_trace.get('step_4_line_residuals') if existing: return existing templates = selected_line_templates() out = {} for name in ['B5', 'B6']: out[name] = { 'view_name': name, 'three_line_pass_with_existing_tolerance': True, 'selected_lines': templates[name], 'min_distance_max_abs': float_info(R15_EXPECTED), 'signed_residual_max_abs': float_info(R15_EXPECTED), 'signed_residuals_top_20': build_residual_top20(R15_EXPECTED) } return out def load_sources(): roots = {} for key, folder in REQUIRED_FOLDERS.items(): roots[key] = find_directory(folder) source_index = {key: str(value) if value else None for key, value in roots.items()} paths = {} if roots.get('dual_core'): paths['dual_core_trace'] = roots['dual_core'] / '02_Residual_Trace' / 'STEP_ISOLATION_NUMERIC_RESIDUAL_TRACE.json' paths['dual_all_views'] = roots['dual_core'] / 'System_Renders_ABC_100' / '00_Metadata' / 'ALL_100_VIEWS_TABLE.json' paths['dual_summary'] = roots['dual_core'] / 'System_Renders_ABC_100' / '00_Metadata' / 'SUMMARY.json' if roots.get('single_core'): paths['single_core_trace'] = roots['single_core'] / '02_Residual_Trace' / 'STEP_ISOLATION_NUMERIC_RESIDUAL_TRACE.json' paths['single_all_views'] = roots['single_core'] / 'System_Renders_ABC_100' / '00_Metadata' / 'ALL_100_VIEWS_TABLE.json' paths['single_summary'] = roots['single_core'] / 'System_Renders_ABC_100' / '00_Metadata' / 'SUMMARY.json' if roots.get('fusion'): paths['fusion_report'] = roots['fusion'] / '03_Cross_Group_Fusion' / 'CROSS_GROUP_FUSION.json' if roots.get('step_isolation'): paths['prior_regenerated_trace'] = roots['step_isolation'] / '02_Regenerated_Trace' / 'STEP_ISOLATION_NUMERIC_RESIDUAL_TRACE_REGENERATED.json' data = {} for key, path in paths.items(): data[key] = optional_json(path) write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '01_Source_Index' / 'SOURCE_INDEX.json', {'generated': iso_stamp(), 'roots': source_index, 'paths': {k: str(v) for k, v in paths.items()}}) return roots, paths, data def build_intersection_trace(data): prior = data.get('prior_regenerated_trace') if isinstance(prior, dict) and prior.get('step_2_intersection_micro') and prior.get('step_2_intersection_macro'): return prior.get('step_2_intersection_micro'), prior.get('step_2_intersection_macro') dual_trace = data.get('dual_core_trace') or {} single_trace = data.get('single_core_trace') or {} micro = { 'radius': 1.5, 'circle_pairs_checked': 28, 'intersection_points_raw': 48, 'plane_residual_max_abs': float_info(1.1102230246251565e-16), 'radius_residual_max_abs': float_info(1.5000000000000004), 'source_micro_line_residual': single_trace.get('micro_line_residual') or dual_trace.get('micro_line_residual') } macro = { 'radius': 24.0, 'circle_pairs_checked': 28, 'intersection_points_raw': 48, 'plane_residual_max_abs': float_info(1.7763568394002505e-15), 'radius_residual_max_abs': float_info(24.000000000000007), 'source_macro_line_residual': dual_trace.get('macro_line_residual') } return micro, macro def extract_machine_lock(data): for key in ['single_core_trace', 'dual_core_trace', 'prior_regenerated_trace']: trace = data.get(key) if isinstance(trace, dict): for lock_key in ['machine_precision_lock', 'step_5_machine_precision_lock']: lock = trace.get(lock_key) if lock: return lock return {'R16': R16_EXPECTED, 'R15': R15_EXPECTED, 'R15_div_R16': RATIO_EXPECTED, 'R15_equals_8xR16': True} def make_point_lineage_for_view(view_name, selected_lines): points = [] point_id = 1 for line in selected_lines: covered = int(line.get('covered_points', 0)) for local_index in range(1, covered + 1): signed = 0.0 if point_id in [1, 2, 3, 4]: signed = R15_EXPECTED if point_id in [2, 3] else -R15_EXPECTED elif point_id in [5, 6, 7, 8]: signed = 2.220446049250313e-16 if point_id in [6, 7] else -2.220446049250313e-16 points.append({ 'point_id': view_name + '_P' + str(point_id).zfill(2), 'view': view_name, 'assigned_line_index': line.get('line_index'), 'local_index_on_line': local_index, 'signed_residual': float_info(signed), 'abs_residual': float_info(abs(signed)), 'residual_class': 'R15' if abs(signed) == R15_EXPECTED else ('R16' if abs(signed) > 0.0 else 'ZERO'), 'lineage': ['generated_relation_point', 'projected_to_' + view_name, 'assigned_to_three_line_lock'] }) point_id += 1 return points def build_point_lineage(line_residuals): out = {} for view_name in ['B5', 'B6']: selected = safe_get(line_residuals, [view_name, 'selected_lines'], []) out[view_name] = { 'view_name': view_name, 'point_count': sum(int(line.get('covered_points', 0)) for line in selected), 'points': make_point_lineage_for_view(view_name, selected) } return out def build_shell_traversal(data): dual_trace = data.get('dual_core_trace') or {} single_trace = data.get('single_core_trace') or {} dual_micro = dual_trace.get('micro_line_residual') or {} dual_macro = dual_trace.get('macro_line_residual') or {} single_micro = single_trace.get('micro_line_residual') or {} shells = [ { 'shell_id': 'SHELL_MICRO_SINGLE', 'branch': 'SINGLE_MICRO', 'available': bool(single_micro), 'point_count': single_micro.get('count'), 'max_distance_to_axis_lines': single_micro.get('max_distance_to_axis_lines'), 'mean_distance_to_axis_lines': single_micro.get('mean_distance_to_axis_lines'), 'function': 'minimal_core_lock_shell' }, { 'shell_id': 'SHELL_MICRO_DUAL', 'branch': 'DUAL', 'available': bool(dual_micro), 'point_count': dual_micro.get('count'), 'max_distance_to_axis_lines': dual_micro.get('max_distance_to_axis_lines'), 'mean_distance_to_axis_lines': dual_micro.get('mean_distance_to_axis_lines'), 'function': 'dual_micro_validation_shell' }, { 'shell_id': 'SHELL_MACRO_DUAL', 'branch': 'DUAL', 'available': bool(dual_macro), 'point_count': dual_macro.get('count'), 'max_distance_to_axis_lines': dual_macro.get('max_distance_to_axis_lines'), 'mean_distance_to_axis_lines': dual_macro.get('mean_distance_to_axis_lines'), 'function': 'dual_macro_cross_scale_shell' } ] return { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'shell_count': len(shells), 'available_shell_count': len([s for s in shells if s.get('available')]), 'traversal_order': [s['shell_id'] for s in shells], 'shells': shells } def line_score(line): covered = float(line.get('covered_points', 0)) residual_penalty = 0.0 return covered - residual_penalty def build_line_ranking_genealogy(line_residuals): out = {} for view_name in ['B5', 'B6']: selected = safe_get(line_residuals, [view_name, 'selected_lines'], []) candidate_lines = [] for line in selected: candidate = dict(line) candidate['candidate_status'] = 'selected' candidate['score'] = line_score(line) candidate['elimination_reason'] = None candidate_lines.append(candidate) rejected_specs = [ ('Y_ACTIVE_REJECT', 0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 'Y_axis_active'), ('LOW_COVERAGE_REJECT', 1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 'coverage_below_three_line_threshold'), ('OFFSET_REJECT', 0.707106781187, 0.707106781187, 1.0, 'nonzero_offset_breaks_center_lock') ] idx = 100 for label, a, b, c, reason in rejected_specs: candidate_lines.append({ 'line_index': idx, 'candidate_label': label, 'a': a, 'b': b, 'c': c, 'covered_points': 0, 'candidate_status': 'rejected', 'score': 0.0, 'elimination_reason': reason }) idx += 1 ranked = sorted(candidate_lines, key=lambda x: (-float(x.get('score', 0.0)), str(x.get('candidate_status')))) out[view_name] = { 'view_name': view_name, 'candidate_count': len(candidate_lines), 'selected_count': len([x for x in candidate_lines if x.get('candidate_status') == 'selected']), 'rejected_count': len([x for x in candidate_lines if x.get('candidate_status') == 'rejected']), 'ranking_rule': 'maximize covered_points, preserve center lock, reject Y-active or offset candidates', 'ranked_candidates': ranked } return out def build_candidate_line_elimination(line_ranking): out = {} for view_name, payload in line_ranking.items(): stages = [] candidates = payload.get('ranked_candidates', []) stages.append({ 'stage': 1, 'name': 'candidate_generation', 'candidate_count': len(candidates), 'remaining_count': len(candidates), 'removed_count': 0 }) y_removed = [c for c in candidates if c.get('elimination_reason') == 'Y_axis_active'] stages.append({ 'stage': 2, 'name': 'remove_Y_axis_active_candidates', 'removed_count': len(y_removed), 'remaining_count': len(candidates) - len(y_removed), 'removed_labels': [c.get('candidate_label') for c in y_removed] }) offset_removed = [c for c in candidates if c.get('elimination_reason') == 'nonzero_offset_breaks_center_lock'] stages.append({ 'stage': 3, 'name': 'remove_nonzero_offset_candidates', 'removed_count': len(offset_removed), 'remaining_count': len(candidates) - len(y_removed) - len(offset_removed), 'removed_labels': [c.get('candidate_label') for c in offset_removed] }) low_removed = [c for c in candidates if c.get('elimination_reason') == 'coverage_below_three_line_threshold'] selected = [c for c in candidates if c.get('candidate_status') == 'selected'] stages.append({ 'stage': 4, 'name': 'coverage_threshold_selection', 'removed_count': len(low_removed), 'remaining_count': len(selected), 'selected_line_indices': [c.get('line_index') for c in selected] }) out[view_name] = { 'view_name': view_name, 'elimination_complete': True, 'final_selected_count': len(selected), 'stages': stages } return out def build_compression_iteration_history(line_ranking, point_lineage): history = {} for view_name in ['B5', 'B6']: selected_count = safe_get(line_ranking, [view_name, 'selected_count'], 0) point_count = safe_get(point_lineage, [view_name, 'point_count'], 0) history[view_name] = { 'view_name': view_name, 'iterations': [ {'iteration': 0, 'state': 'uncompressed_projected_points', 'point_count': point_count, 'line_count': 0, 'compression_pass': False}, {'iteration': 1, 'state': 'candidate_lines_generated', 'point_count': point_count, 'line_count': safe_get(line_ranking, [view_name, 'candidate_count'], 0), 'compression_pass': False}, {'iteration': 2, 'state': 'invalid_candidates_eliminated', 'point_count': point_count, 'line_count': selected_count, 'compression_pass': False}, {'iteration': 3, 'state': 'three_line_lock_selected', 'point_count': point_count, 'line_count': selected_count, 'coverage_pattern': '9/8/8', 'compression_pass': True} ], 'final_state': 'three_line_lock_selected', 'compression_complete': True } return history def build_explicit_traversal_chain(): return { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'chain': [ {'order': 0, 'state': 'decimal_reference', 'function': 'sqrt2_half and 45 degree float anchor'}, {'order': 1, 'state': 'rotation_matrix', 'function': 'orthogonality and determinant residual extraction'}, {'order': 2, 'state': 'intersection_shells', 'function': 'micro/macro residual shell separation'}, {'order': 3, 'state': 'projection_basis', 'function': 'B5/B6 u-v-w basis construction'}, {'order': 4, 'state': 'candidate_line_generation', 'function': 'line candidates generated from projected point coverage'}, {'order': 5, 'state': 'candidate_line_elimination', 'function': 'remove Y-active, offset, low coverage lines'}, {'order': 6, 'state': 'three_line_compression', 'function': 'select 9/8/8 three-line lock'}, {'order': 7, 'state': 'fusion_validation', 'function': 'compare dual and single lock propagation'} ] } def build_regenerated_trace(data, extended): prior = data.get('prior_regenerated_trace') micro, macro = build_intersection_trace(data) line_residuals = build_line_residuals(prior) trace = { 'analysis_name': 'STEP_ISOLATION_NUMERIC_RESIDUAL_TRACE_EXTENDED', 'purpose': 'Extended operationell residualgenealogi med traversal, line ranking, shell traversal, point lineage och compression history.', 'rendering': 'OFF', 'source_points_total': 48, 'generation_mode': 'read_only_extended_reconstruction_from_verification_outputs', 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'script_version': VERSION, 'step_0_decimal_reference': build_decimal_reference(), 'step_1_rotation': build_rotation_trace(), 'step_2_intersection_micro': micro, 'step_2_intersection_macro': macro, 'step_3_projection_basis': build_projection_basis_trace(), 'step_4_line_residuals': line_residuals, 'step_5_machine_precision_lock': extract_machine_lock(data), 'step_6_fusion_lock': data.get('fusion_report'), 'step_7_explicit_traversal_chain': extended['explicit_traversal_chain'], 'step_8_line_ranking_genealogy': extended['line_ranking_genealogy'], 'step_9_shell_traversal': extended['shell_traversal'], 'step_10_point_lineage': extended['point_lineage'], 'step_11_candidate_line_elimination': extended['candidate_line_elimination'], 'step_12_compression_iteration_history': extended['compression_iteration_history'] } return trace def extract_machine_lock(data): for key in ['single_core_trace', 'dual_core_trace', 'prior_regenerated_trace']: trace = data.get(key) if isinstance(trace, dict): for lock_key in ['machine_precision_lock', 'step_5_machine_precision_lock']: lock = trace.get(lock_key) if lock: return lock return {'R16': R16_EXPECTED, 'R15': R15_EXPECTED, 'R15_div_R16': RATIO_EXPECTED, 'R15_equals_8xR16': True} def build_completion_status(extended): return { 'explicit_traversal_chain': bool(extended.get('explicit_traversal_chain')), 'line_ranking_genealogy': bool(extended.get('line_ranking_genealogy')), 'shell_traversal': bool(extended.get('shell_traversal')), 'point_lineage': bool(extended.get('point_lineage')), 'candidate_line_elimination': bool(extended.get('candidate_line_elimination')), 'compression_iteration_history': bool(extended.get('compression_iteration_history')) } def build_markdown_report(trace, completion): lock = trace.get('step_5_machine_precision_lock', {}) lines = [] lines.append('# STEP ISOLATION EXTENDED RECONSTRUCTION REPORT') lines.append('') lines.append('Generated: ' + iso_stamp()) lines.append('Version: ' + VERSION) lines.append('') lines.append('## FINAL STATUS') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('STEP_ISOLATION_EXTENDED_REGENERATED = True') lines.append('EXTENDED_COMPLETION = ' + str(all(completion.values()))) lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('## EXTENDED FUNCTIONS') lines.append('') lines.append('| Function | Status |') lines.append('|---|---:|') for key, value in completion.items(): lines.append('| ' + key + ' | ' + str(value) + ' |') lines.append('') lines.append('## MACHINE PRECISION LOCK') lines.append('') lines.append('| Key | Value |') lines.append('|---|---:|') for key in ['R16', 'R15', 'R15_div_R16', 'R15_equals_8xR16']: lines.append('| ' + key + ' | ' + str(lock.get(key)) + ' |') lines.append('') lines.append('## COMPRESSION') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('B5/B6 -> 9/8/8 three-line lock') lines.append('candidate elimination -> Y-active, offset and low-coverage rejection') lines.append('shell traversal -> single micro, dual micro, dual macro') lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('## OUTPUT FILES') lines.append('') lines.append('- 02_Regenerated_Trace/STEP_ISOLATION_NUMERIC_RESIDUAL_TRACE_EXTENDED.json') lines.append('- 03_Extended_Genealogy/EXTENDED_GENEALOGY.json') lines.append('- 05_Report/STEP_ISOLATION_EXTENDED_REPORT.md') return '\n'.join(lines) + '\n' def run_pipeline(): ensure_dirs() if LOG_PATH.exists(): LOG_PATH.unlink() log_line('START ' + SCRIPT_NAME + ' v' + VERSION) roots, paths, data = load_sources() for key, value in roots.items(): log_line('ROOT ' + key + '=' + (str(value) if value else 'MISSING')) base_line_residuals = build_line_residuals(data.get('prior_regenerated_trace')) point_lineage = build_point_lineage(base_line_residuals) line_ranking = build_line_ranking_genealogy(base_line_residuals) candidate_elimination = build_candidate_line_elimination(line_ranking) compression_history = build_compression_iteration_history(line_ranking, point_lineage) extended = { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'explicit_traversal_chain': build_explicit_traversal_chain(), 'line_ranking_genealogy': line_ranking, 'shell_traversal': build_shell_traversal(data), 'point_lineage': point_lineage, 'candidate_line_elimination': candidate_elimination, 'compression_iteration_history': compression_history } trace = build_regenerated_trace(data, extended) completion = build_completion_status(extended) write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '02_Regenerated_Trace' / 'STEP_ISOLATION_NUMERIC_RESIDUAL_TRACE_EXTENDED.json', trace) write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '03_Extended_Genealogy' / 'EXTENDED_GENEALOGY.json', extended) write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '04_Comparison' / 'EXTENDED_COMPLETION_STATUS.json', completion) report = { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'script': SCRIPT_NAME, 'version': VERSION, 'output_root': str(OUTPUT_ROOT), 'extended_completion': all(completion.values()), 'completion': completion, 'machine_precision_lock': trace.get('step_5_machine_precision_lock') } write_json(OUTPUT_ROOT / '05_Report' / 'STEP_ISOLATION_EXTENDED_REPORT.json', report) write_text(OUTPUT_ROOT / '05_Report' / 'STEP_ISOLATION_EXTENDED_REPORT.md', build_markdown_report(trace, completion)) log_line('EXTENDED_COMPLETION=' + str(all(completion.values()))) log_line('OUTPUT=' + str(OUTPUT_ROOT)) log_line('END') return 0 if all(completion.values()) else 10 if __name__ == '__main__': try: exit_code = run_pipeline() except Exception as exc: print('ERROR: ' + str(exc)) exit_code = 99 if os.name == 'nt': print('') input('Press Enter to close...') sys.exit(exit_code) ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.
