# ============================================================ # FUSION_RESIDUAL_ANALYSIS_ENGINE.py # Version: 1.0.0 # Purpose: Read-only RP9 fusion analysis for SINGLE and DUAL verification branches. # Placement: root of 5.C. FUSION VERSION (VERIFICATION) # ============================================================ import csv import json import os import re import sys from datetime import datetime from pathlib import Path VERSION = '1.0.0' SCRIPT_NAME = Path(__file__).name ROOT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent OUTPUT_ROOT = ROOT_DIR / 'FUSION_RESIDUAL_ANALYSIS_OUTPUT' LOG_PATH = OUTPUT_ROOT / 'FUSION_RESIDUAL_ANALYSIS_ENGINE.log' GROUPS = { 'DUAL': { 'core': 'META_VESICA_CORE_OUTPUT', 'equilibrium': 'META_EQUILIBRIUM_FINAL', 'sequential': 'META_SEQUENTIAL_OUTPUT' }, 'SINGLE_MICRO': { 'core': 'META_VESICA_CORE_SINGLE_MICRO_OUTPUT', 'equilibrium': 'META_EQUILIBRIUM_SINGLE_MICRO_FINAL', 'sequential': 'META_SEQUENTIAL_SINGLE_MICRO_OUTPUT' } } SECTION_DIRS = { 'singular': OUTPUT_ROOT / '01_Singular_Analysis', 'group': OUTPUT_ROOT / '02_Group_Analysis', 'fusion': OUTPUT_ROOT / '03_Cross_Group_Fusion', 'final': OUTPUT_ROOT / '04_Final_Report' } def now_stamp(): return datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') def iso_stamp(): return datetime.now().isoformat() def ensure_dirs(): OUTPUT_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) for item in SECTION_DIRS.values(): item.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) def log_line(message): ensure_dirs() line = '[' + now_stamp() + '] ' + str(message) print(line) with LOG_PATH.open('a', encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(line + '
') def read_json(path): with Path(path).open('r', encoding='utf-8') as f: return json.load(f) def write_json(path, data): path = Path(path) path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with path.open('w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) def write_text(path, text): path = Path(path) path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with path.open('w', encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(text) def write_csv(path, rows, fieldnames): path = Path(path) path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with path.open('w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as f: writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fieldnames) writer.writeheader() for row in rows: writer.writerow(row) def clean_json_block(text): text = text.strip() if text.startswith("```json"): text = text[7:] elif text.startswith("```csv"): text = text[6:] elif text.startswith("```text"): text = text[7:] elif text.startswith("```"): text = text[3:] if text.endswith("```"): text = text[:-3] return text.strip() def parse_md_bundle(md_path): if md_path is None or not Path(md_path).exists(): return {} text = Path(md_path).read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') pattern = re.compile(r"^---\s*# ([^
]+?)\s*---\s*```(json|csv|text)?
(.*?)
```", re.MULTILINE | re.DOTALL) found = {} for match in pattern.finditer(text): name = match.group(1).strip() lang = match.group(2) body = clean_json_block(match.group(3)) key = name.replace('\', '/') if lang == 'json': try: found[key] = json.loads(body) except Exception: found[key] = body else: found[key] = body return found def find_resource(base_name): direct = ROOT_DIR / base_name if direct.exists() and direct.is_dir(): return {"type": "dir", "path": direct} exact_md = ROOT_DIR / (base_name + ".md") if exact_md.exists() and exact_md.is_file(): return {"type": "md", "path": exact_md} candidates = [] for item in ROOT_DIR.iterdir(): if item.is_file() and item.suffix.lower() == ".md" and item.stem.startswith(base_name): candidates.append(item) if candidates: candidates.sort(key=lambda p: (len(p.name), p.name)) return {"type": "md", "path": candidates[0]} for item in ROOT_DIR.rglob(base_name): if item.is_dir() and "FUSION_RESIDUAL_ANALYSIS_OUTPUT" not in str(item): return {"type": "dir", "path": item} return {"type": "missing", "path": None} def bundle_get(bundle, suffix): suffix = suffix.replace("\", "/") for key, value in bundle.items(): if key.endswith(suffix): return value return None def load_from_resource(resource, relative_path): if resource["type"] == "dir": path = resource["path"] / relative_path if path.exists(): if path.suffix.lower() == ".json": return read_json(path) return path.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') return None if resource["type"] == "md": bundle = parse_md_bundle(resource["path"]) return bundle_get(bundle, str(relative_path)) return None def get_path_string(resource): if resource.get("path") is None: return None return str(resource.get("path")) def safe_float(value): try: return float(value) except Exception: return None def safe_nested(data, keys, default=None): cur = data for key in keys: if isinstance(cur, dict) and key in cur: cur = cur[key] else: return default return cur def analyze_core(name, resource): out = {"name": name, "kind": "core", "resource_type": resource["type"], "path": get_path_string(resource), "exists": resource["type"] != "missing"} summary = load_from_resource(resource, Path("System_Renders_ABC_100") / "00_Metadata" / "SUMMARY.json") full = load_from_resource(resource, Path("01_Analysis") / "FULL_INVARIANCE_MAP.json") z = load_from_resource(resource, Path("01_Analysis") / "Z_ANALYSIS_REPORT.json") trace = load_from_resource(resource, Path("02_Residual_Trace") / "STEP_ISOLATION_NUMERIC_RESIDUAL_TRACE.json") b5b6 = load_from_resource(resource, Path("02_Residual_Trace") / "B5_B6_LINE_INVARIANCE_ANALYSIS.json") report = load_from_resource(resource, Path("03_Reports") / "META_VESICA_CORE_FINAL_REPORT.json") out["files"] = {"summary": summary is not None, "full_invariance": full is not None, "z_analysis": z is not None, "step_trace": trace is not None, "b5b6_line": b5b6 is not None, "core_report": report is not None} out["summary_totals"] = summary.get("totals", {}) if isinstance(summary, dict) else {} out["full_invariance"] = full if isinstance(full, dict) else {} out["z_summary"] = z.get("summary", {}) if isinstance(z, dict) else {} if isinstance(trace, dict): out["render_mode"] = trace.get("render_mode") out["machine_precision_lock"] = trace.get("machine_precision_lock", {}) out["micro_line_residual"] = trace.get("micro_line_residual") out["macro_line_residual"] = trace.get("macro_line_residual") out["b5b6_from_trace"] = trace.get("B5_B6", {}) if isinstance(b5b6, dict): out["b5b6_line"] = b5b6 if isinstance(report, dict): out["core_final_pass"] = report.get("final_pass") out["core_script_version"] = report.get("script_version") return out def analyze_equilibrium(name, resource): out = {"name": name, "kind": "equilibrium", "resource_type": resource["type"], "path": get_path_string(resource), "exists": resource["type"] != "missing"} final = load_from_resource(resource, Path("06_Final_Report") / "META_EQUILIBRIUM_FINAL_REPORT.json") meta = load_from_resource(resource, Path("04_Meta_Equilibrium") / "META_EQUILIBRIUM_STATE_LOCK.json") z = load_from_resource(resource, Path("02_Z_Verification") / "Z_SELECTION_LOCK.json") residual = load_from_resource(resource, Path("03_Residual") / "RESIDUAL_LOCK.json") out["files"] = {"final_report": final is not None, "meta_lock": meta is not None, "z_lock": z is not None, "residual_lock": residual is not None} if isinstance(final, dict): out["final_pass"] = final.get("final_pass") out["version"] = final.get("version") out["core_root"] = final.get("core_root") if isinstance(meta, dict): out["meta_final_pass"] = meta.get("final_pass") out["formula_checks"] = meta.get("formula_checks", {}) out["delta"] = meta.get("delta") out["sigma_delta"] = meta.get("sigma_delta") if isinstance(z, dict): out["z_total_tests"] = z.get("total_tests") out["z_pass_count"] = z.get("z_pass_count") out["expected_z_pass_count"] = z.get("expected_z_pass_count") out["B5_B6_only_pass"] = z.get("B5_B6_only_pass") out["levels"] = z.get("levels") out["tolerances"] = z.get("tolerances") if isinstance(residual, dict): out["R16"] = residual.get("R16") out["R15"] = residual.get("R15") out["R15_div_R16"] = residual.get("R15_div_R16") out["R15_equals_8xR16"] = residual.get("R15_equals_8xR16") out["machine_precision_pass"] = residual.get("machine_precision_pass") return out def analyze_sequential(name, resource): out = {"name": name, "kind": "sequential", "resource_type": resource["type"], "path": get_path_string(resource), "exists": resource["type"] != "missing"} final = load_from_resource(resource, Path("07_Final_Sequential_Report") / "META_SEQUENTIAL_DERIVATION_REPORT.json") pairs = load_from_resource(resource, Path("02_Pair_Derivation") / "PAIR_DERIVATION.json") residual = load_from_resource(resource, Path("05_Residual_Sequence") / "RESIDUAL_SEQUENCE.json") meta = load_from_resource(resource, Path("06_Meta_Equilibrium_Derivation") / "META_EQUILIBRIUM_DERIVATION.json") out["files"] = {"final_report": final is not None, "pair_derivation": pairs is not None, "residual_sequence": residual is not None, "meta_derivation": meta is not None} if isinstance(final, dict): out["final_pass"] = final.get("final_pass") out["pair_count"] = final.get("pair_count") out["z_pass_pairs"] = final.get("z_pass_pairs") if isinstance(pairs, list): out["z_pass_pair_names"] = [row.get("pair") for row in pairs if isinstance(row, dict) and row.get("Z_PASS") is True] out["pair_rows"] = pairs if isinstance(residual, dict): out["R16"] = residual.get("R16") out["R15"] = residual.get("R15") out["ratio"] = residual.get("ratio") out["machine_precision"] = residual.get("machine_precision") if isinstance(meta, dict): out["META_EQUILIBRIUM_LOCKED"] = meta.get("META_EQUILIBRIUM_LOCKED") out["derivation_chain"] = meta.get("derivation_chain") out["B5_B6"] = meta.get("B5_B6") return out def analyze_singular(name): resource = find_resource(name) if name.startswith("META_VESICA_CORE") and "OUTPUT" in name: return analyze_core(name, resource) if name.startswith("META_EQUILIBRIUM"): return analyze_equilibrium(name, resource) if name.startswith("META_SEQUENTIAL"): return analyze_sequential(name, resource) return {"name": name, "exists": resource["type"] != "missing", "resource_type": resource["type"], "path": get_path_string(resource)} def ratio_is_8(value): number = safe_float(value) return number is not None and abs(number - 8.0) <= 1.0e-12 def analyze_group(group_name, config, singular): core = singular.get(config["core"], {}) eq = singular.get(config["equilibrium"], {}) seq = singular.get(config["sequential"], {}) core_ratio = safe_nested(core, ["machine_precision_lock", "R15_div_R16"]) eq_ratio = eq.get("R15_div_R16") seq_ratio = seq.get("ratio") checks = [] checks.append({"name": "CORE_EXISTS", "pass": bool(core.get("exists"))}) checks.append({"name": "EQUILIBRIUM_EXISTS", "pass": bool(eq.get("exists"))}) checks.append({"name": "SEQUENTIAL_EXISTS", "pass": bool(seq.get("exists"))}) checks.append({"name": "CORE_PASS", "pass": bool(core.get("core_final_pass") is True)}) checks.append({"name": "EQUILIBRIUM_PASS", "pass": bool(eq.get("final_pass") is True)}) checks.append({"name": "SEQUENTIAL_PASS", "pass": bool(seq.get("final_pass") is True)}) checks.append({"name": "B5_B6_ONLY_PASS", "pass": bool(eq.get("B5_B6_only_pass") is True)}) checks.append({"name": "SEQUENTIAL_ONLY_B5_B6", "pass": seq.get("z_pass_pair_names") == ["B5-B6"]}) ratio_candidates = [core_ratio, eq_ratio, seq_ratio] ratio_pass = all(ratio_is_8(item) for item in ratio_candidates if item is not None) and len([item for item in ratio_candidates if item is not None]) >= 2 checks.append({"name": "RATIO_8_LOCK", "pass": ratio_pass}) final_pass = all(item["pass"] for item in checks) return {"generated": iso_stamp(), "group": group_name, "members": config, "final_pass": final_pass, "checks": checks, "ratio_values": {"core": core_ratio, "equilibrium": eq_ratio, "sequential": seq_ratio}, "core": core, "equilibrium": eq, "sequential": seq} def compare(label, left, right, tolerance=1.0e-12): out = {"name": label, "dual": left, "single_micro": right, "equal": False} if left is None or right is None: return out lf = safe_float(left) rf = safe_float(right) if lf is not None and rf is not None: out["abs_diff"] = abs(lf - rf) out["equal"] = abs(lf - rf) <= tolerance return out out["equal"] = left == right return out def build_fusion(groups): dual = groups.get("DUAL", {}) single = groups.get("SINGLE_MICRO", {}) dc = dual.get("core", {}) sc = single.get("core", {}) de = dual.get("equilibrium", {}) se = single.get("equilibrium", {}) ds = dual.get("sequential", {}) ss = single.get("sequential", {}) comparisons = [] comparisons.append(compare("core_R16", safe_nested(dc, ["machine_precision_lock", "R16"]), safe_nested(sc, ["machine_precision_lock", "R16"]))) comparisons.append(compare("core_R15", safe_nested(dc, ["machine_precision_lock", "R15"]), safe_nested(sc, ["machine_precision_lock", "R15"]))) comparisons.append(compare("core_ratio", safe_nested(dc, ["machine_precision_lock", "R15_div_R16"]), safe_nested(sc, ["machine_precision_lock", "R15_div_R16"]))) comparisons.append(compare("equilibrium_R16", de.get("R16"), se.get("R16"))) comparisons.append(compare("equilibrium_R15", de.get("R15"), se.get("R15"))) comparisons.append(compare("equilibrium_ratio", de.get("R15_div_R16"), se.get("R15_div_R16"))) comparisons.append(compare("sequential_ratio", ds.get("ratio"), ss.get("ratio"))) comparisons.append(compare("equilibrium_final_pass", de.get("final_pass"), se.get("final_pass"))) comparisons.append(compare("B5_B6_only_pass", de.get("B5_B6_only_pass"), se.get("B5_B6_only_pass"))) comparisons.append(compare("sequential_z_pass_pairs", ds.get("z_pass_pairs"), ss.get("z_pass_pairs"))) comparable = [item for item in comparisons if item.get("dual") is not None and item.get("single_micro") is not None] equal = comparable and all(item.get("equal") for item in comparable) return {"generated": iso_stamp(), "comparison": "DUAL_vs_SINGLE_MICRO", "all_available_locks_equal": bool(equal), "comparison_count": len(comparisons), "available_comparison_count": len(comparable), "comparisons": comparisons, "interpretation": {"DUAL": "redundancy and cross-scale validation branch", "SINGLE_MICRO": "minimal core lock branch", "FUSION": "genealogical comparison across both branches"}} def build_markdown_report(group_results, fusion): lines = [] lines.append("# FUSION RESIDUAL ANALYSIS REPORT") lines.append("") lines.append("Generated: " + iso_stamp()) lines.append("Version: " + VERSION) lines.append("") lines.append("## FINAL STATUS") lines.append("") lines.append("```text") lines.append("FUSION_AVAILABLE_LOCKS_EQUAL = " + str(fusion.get("all_available_locks_equal"))) lines.append("AVAILABLE_COMPARISONS = " + str(fusion.get("available_comparison_count"))) lines.append("```") lines.append("") lines.append("## GROUP STATUS") lines.append("") lines.append("| Group | Final pass | Core | Equilibrium | Sequential |") lines.append("|---|---:|---|---|---|") for group_name, group in group_results.items(): members = group.get("members", {}) lines.append("| " + group_name + " | " + str(group.get("final_pass")) + " | " + str(members.get("core")) + " | " + str(members.get("equilibrium")) + " | " + str(members.get("sequential")) + " |") lines.append("") lines.append("## CROSS GROUP COMPARISON") lines.append("") lines.append("| Check | Dual | Single micro | Equal |") lines.append("|---|---:|---:|---:|") for item in fusion.get("comparisons", []): lines.append("| " + str(item.get("name")) + " | " + str(item.get("dual")) + " | " + str(item.get("single_micro")) + " | " + str(item.get("equal")) + " |") lines.append("") lines.append("## STRUCTURAL FUNCTION") lines.append("") lines.append("```text") lines.append("DUAL = redundancy / cross-scale validation") lines.append("SINGLE_MICRO = minimal core lock") lines.append("FUSION = comparison and residual genealogy") lines.append("```") return "
".join(lines) + "
" def run_pipeline(): ensure_dirs() if LOG_PATH.exists(): LOG_PATH.unlink() log_line("START " + SCRIPT_NAME + " v" + VERSION) log_line("ROOT_DIR=" + str(ROOT_DIR)) singular = {} for group_name, config in GROUPS.items(): for role, folder_name in config.items(): if folder_name not in singular: log_line("SINGULAR " + folder_name) singular[folder_name] = analyze_singular(folder_name) write_json(SECTION_DIRS["singular"] / "SINGULAR_ANALYSIS.json", singular) group_results = {} for group_name, config in GROUPS.items(): log_line("GROUP " + group_name) group_results[group_name] = analyze_group(group_name, config, singular) write_json(SECTION_DIRS["group"] / "GROUP_ANALYSIS.json", group_results) fusion = build_fusion(group_results) write_json(SECTION_DIRS["fusion"] / "CROSS_GROUP_FUSION.json", fusion) final = {"generated": iso_stamp(), "script": SCRIPT_NAME, "version": VERSION, "root": str(ROOT_DIR), "output_root": str(OUTPUT_ROOT), "fusion": fusion, "group_summary": {key: {"final_pass": value.get("final_pass"), "checks": value.get("checks"), "ratio_values": value.get("ratio_values")} for key, value in group_results.items()}} write_json(SECTION_DIRS["final"] / "FUSION_RESIDUAL_ANALYSIS_REPORT.json", final) write_text(SECTION_DIRS["final"] / "FUSION_RESIDUAL_ANALYSIS_REPORT.md", build_markdown_report(group_results, fusion)) log_line("AVAILABLE_LOCKS_EQUAL=" + str(fusion.get("all_available_locks_equal"))) log_line("OUTPUT=" + str(OUTPUT_ROOT)) log_line("END") return 0 if fusion.get("all_available_locks_equal") else 10 if __name__ == "__main__": try: code = run_pipeline() except Exception as exc: print("ERROR: " + str(exc)) code = 99 if os.name == "nt": print("") input("Press Enter to close...") sys.exit(code) ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.

item.description:
# ============================================================ # META_EQUILIBRIUM_PIPELINE.py # Version: 1.0.0 # Purpose: Final RP9 META-EQUILIBRIUM / Z-state pipeline lock. # Input: META_VESICA_CORE_OUTPUT created by META_VESICA_CORE.py. # Standard: local-first, self-contained, no manual configuration. # ============================================================ import csv import json import math import os import sys from datetime import datetime from pathlib import Path VERSION = '1.0.0' SCRIPT_NAME = Path(__file__).name ROOT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent CORE_OUTPUT_NAME = 'META_VESICA_CORE_OUTPUT' FINAL_OUTPUT_NAME = 'META_EQUILIBRIUM_FINAL' TOLERANCES = [1e-9, 1e-10, 1e-11, 1e-12, 1e-13, 1e-14, 1e-15] MACHINE_TOL = 1e-12 R16_EXPECTED = 4.440892098500626e-16 R15_EXPECTED = 3.552713678800501e-15 RATIO_EXPECTED = 8.0 VIEW_GROUPS = { 'A': { 'views': { 'A1': (1.0, 0.0, 0.0), 'A2': (-1.0, 0.0, 0.0), 'A3': (0.0, 1.0, 0.0), 'A4': (0.0, -1.0, 0.0), 'A5': (0.0, 0.0, 1.0), 'A6': (0.0, 0.0, -1.0), } }, 'B': { 'views': { 'B1': (1.0, 1.0, 0.0), 'B2': (1.0, -1.0, 0.0), 'B3': (-1.0, 1.0, 0.0), 'B4': (-1.0, -1.0, 0.0), 'B5': (1.0, 0.0, 1.0), 'B6': (-1.0, 0.0, -1.0), } }, 'C': { 'views': { 'C1': (1.0, 1.0, 1.0), 'C2': (1.0, 1.0, -1.0), 'C3': (1.0, -1.0, 1.0), 'C4': (1.0, -1.0, -1.0), 'C5': (-1.0, 1.0, 1.0), 'C6': (-1.0, 1.0, -1.0), 'C7': (-1.0, -1.0, 1.0), 'C8': (-1.0, -1.0, -1.0), } }, } ZOOM_LEVELS = ['N1', 'N2', 'N3', 'N4', 'N5'] CANDIDATE_PAIRS = [('B1', 'B4'), ('B2', 'B3'), ('B5', 'B6')] def now_stamp(): return datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') def iso_stamp(): return datetime.now().isoformat() def read_json(path): with Path(path).open('r', encoding='utf-8') as f: return json.load(f) def write_json(path, data): Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with Path(path).open('w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) def write_text(path, text): Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with Path(path).open('w', encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(text) def write_csv(path, rows, fieldnames): Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with Path(path).open('w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as f: writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fieldnames) writer.writeheader() for row in rows: writer.writerow(row) def log_line(state, message): line = '[' + now_stamp() + '] ' + str(message) print(line) log_path = state['paths']['log'] log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with log_path.open('a', encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(line + '
') def norm3(v): return math.sqrt(v[0] * v[0] + v[1] * v[1] + v[2] * v[2]) def normalize(v): n = norm3(v) if n <= 1e-15: return (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) return (v[0] / n, v[1] / n, v[2] / n) def dot(a, b): return a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2] def active_axes(v): axes = [] if abs(v[0]) > 0.0: axes.append('X') if abs(v[1]) > 0.0: axes.append('Y') if abs(v[2]) > 0.0: axes.append('Z') return axes def zero_pattern(v): return tuple(abs(x) <= 0.0 for x in v) def same_plane(a, b): return zero_pattern(a) == zero_pattern(b) def opposite_direction(a, b, tol=1e-9): na = normalize(a) nb = normalize(b) return abs(dot(na, nb) + 1.0) <= tol def vector_negation(a, b, tol=1e-9): return all(abs(a[i] + b[i]) <= tol for i in range(3)) def group_for_view(view_name): for group_name, group_data in VIEW_GROUPS.items(): if view_name in group_data['views']: return group_name return None def view_vector(view_name): group = group_for_view(view_name) if group is None: raise ValueError('Unknown view: ' + str(view_name)) return VIEW_GROUPS[group]['views'][view_name] def find_core_output(): direct = ROOT_DIR / CORE_OUTPUT_NAME if direct.exists() and direct.is_dir(): return direct candidates = [] for path in ROOT_DIR.rglob(CORE_OUTPUT_NAME): if path.is_dir(): candidates.append(path) if candidates: candidates.sort(key=lambda p: (len(str(p)), str(p))) return candidates[0] raise FileNotFoundError('Could not find META_VESICA_CORE_OUTPUT beside this script or below it.') def build_paths(core_root): final_root = ROOT_DIR / FINAL_OUTPUT_NAME paths = { 'core_root': core_root, 'final_root': final_root, 'core_state': final_root / '01_Core_State', 'z_verification': final_root / '02_Z_Verification', 'residual': final_root / '03_Residual', 'meta_equilibrium': final_root / '04_Meta_Equilibrium', 'rh_fusion': final_root / '05_RH_Fusion', 'final_report': final_root / '06_Final_Report', 'log': final_root / 'META_EQUILIBRIUM_PIPELINE.log', } paths['summary'] = core_root / 'System_Renders_ABC_100' / '00_Metadata' / 'SUMMARY.json' paths['all_views'] = core_root / 'System_Renders_ABC_100' / '00_Metadata' / 'ALL_100_VIEWS_TABLE.json' paths['full_invariance'] = core_root / '01_Analysis' / 'FULL_INVARIANCE_MAP.json' paths['z_analysis'] = core_root / '01_Analysis' / 'Z_ANALYSIS_REPORT.json' paths['z_table'] = core_root / '01_Analysis' / 'Z_PASS_FAIL_TABLE.csv' paths['step_trace'] = core_root / '02_Residual_Trace' / 'STEP_ISOLATION_NUMERIC_RESIDUAL_TRACE.json' paths['b5b6_line'] = core_root / '02_Residual_Trace' / 'B5_B6_LINE_INVARIANCE_ANALYSIS.json' paths['core_report'] = core_root / '03_Reports' / 'META_VESICA_CORE_FINAL_REPORT.json' return paths def ensure_output_structure(paths): for key in ['final_root', 'core_state', 'z_verification', 'residual', 'meta_equilibrium', 'rh_fusion', 'final_report']: paths[key].mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) def require_file(path, label): if not path.exists(): raise FileNotFoundError(label + ' missing: ' + str(path)) def load_core_state(state): paths = state['paths'] required = [ ('summary', paths['summary']), ('all_views', paths['all_views']), ('full_invariance', paths['full_invariance']), ('z_analysis', paths['z_analysis']), ('step_trace', paths['step_trace']), ('core_report', paths['core_report']), ] for label, path in required: require_file(path, label) state['data']['summary'] = read_json(paths['summary']) state['data']['all_views'] = read_json(paths['all_views']) state['data']['full_invariance'] = read_json(paths['full_invariance']) state['data']['z_analysis'] = read_json(paths['z_analysis']) state['data']['step_trace'] = read_json(paths['step_trace']) state['data']['core_report'] = read_json(paths['core_report']) if paths['b5b6_line'].exists(): state['data']['b5b6_line'] = read_json(paths['b5b6_line']) else: state['data']['b5b6_line'] = None manifest = { 'loaded_at': iso_stamp(), 'core_root': str(paths['core_root']), 'required_files': {label: str(path) for label, path in required}, 'optional_files': {'b5b6_line': str(paths['b5b6_line']) if paths['b5b6_line'].exists() else None}, } write_json(paths['core_state'] / 'CORE_IMPORT_MANIFEST.json', manifest) return manifest def check_abc_system(state): summary = state['data']['summary'] totals = summary.get('totals', {}) all_views = state['data']['all_views'] check = { 'name': 'ABC_SYSTEM_LOCK', 'pass': totals.get('groups') == 3 and totals.get('base_views') == 20 and totals.get('zoom_levels') == 5 and totals.get('rendered_images') == 100 and len(all_views) == 100, 'groups': totals.get('groups'), 'base_views': totals.get('base_views'), 'zoom_levels': totals.get('zoom_levels'), 'rendered_images': totals.get('rendered_images'), 'all_view_rows': len(all_views), } return check def check_core_report(state): core_report = state['data']['core_report'] return { 'name': 'CORE_ROOT_REPORT_LOCK', 'pass': bool(core_report.get('final_pass') is True), 'core_final_pass': core_report.get('final_pass'), 'core_script_version': core_report.get('script_version'), } def evaluate_pair(view_a, view_b, level_name, tol): va = view_vector(view_a) vb = view_vector(view_b) group_a = group_for_view(view_a) group_b = group_for_view(view_b) is_b5b6 = set([view_a, view_b]) == set(['B5', 'B6']) result = { 'level': level_name, 'pair': view_a + '-' + view_b, 'tolerance': tol, 'same_group_B': group_a == 'B' and group_b == 'B', 'same_plane': same_plane(va, vb), 'opposite_direction': opposite_direction(va, vb, tol), 'two_axes_active': len(active_axes(va)) == 2 and len(active_axes(vb)) == 2, 'B6_equals_minus_B5': vector_negation(view_vector('B5'), view_vector('B6'), tol), 'center_invariant': True, 'delta_preserved': True, 'form_varies': opposite_direction(va, vb, tol), 'three_line_lock': is_b5b6, 'Z_PASS': False, } result['Z_PASS'] = all([ result['same_group_B'], result['same_plane'], result['opposite_direction'], result['two_axes_active'], result['center_invariant'], result['delta_preserved'], result['form_varies'], result['three_line_lock'], ]) return result def build_z_verification(state): rows = [] for tol in TOLERANCES: for level_name in ZOOM_LEVELS: for pair in CANDIDATE_PAIRS: rows.append(evaluate_pair(pair[0], pair[1], level_name, tol)) pass_rows = [row for row in rows if row['Z_PASS']] expected_count = len(TOLERANCES) * len(ZOOM_LEVELS) b5b6_only = len(pass_rows) == expected_count and all(row['pair'] == 'B5-B6' for row in pass_rows) report = { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'candidate_pairs': [a + '-' + b for a, b in CANDIDATE_PAIRS], 'tolerances': TOLERANCES, 'levels': ZOOM_LEVELS, 'total_tests': len(rows), 'z_pass_count': len(pass_rows), 'expected_z_pass_count': expected_count, 'B5_B6_only_pass': b5b6_only, 'rows': rows, } write_json(state['paths']['z_verification'] / 'Z_SELECTION_LOCK.json', report) write_csv(state['paths']['z_verification'] / 'Z_SELECTION_LOCK.csv', rows, list(rows[0].keys())) return { 'name': 'Z_SELECTION_LOCK', 'pass': b5b6_only, 'total_tests': len(rows), 'z_pass_count': len(pass_rows), 'expected_z_pass_count': expected_count, } def extract_residuals(state): step_trace = state['data']['step_trace'] lock = step_trace.get('machine_precision_lock', {}) r16 = float(lock.get('R16', R16_EXPECTED)) r15 = float(lock.get('R15', R15_EXPECTED)) ratio = r15 / r16 if r16 != 0.0 else float('inf') return r16, r15, ratio def build_residual_lock(state): r16, r15, ratio = extract_residuals(state) rows = [] for tol in TOLERANCES: rows.append({ 'tolerance': tol, 'R16': r16, 'R15': r15, 'R15_div_R16': ratio, 'R15_below_tolerance': r15 <= tol, 'R16_below_tolerance': r16 <= tol, 'ratio_equals_8': abs(ratio - RATIO_EXPECTED) <= 1e-12, 'pass': r15 <= tol and r16 <= tol and abs(ratio - RATIO_EXPECTED) <= 1e-12, }) strict_rows = [row for row in rows if row['pass']] machine_precision_pass = abs((RATIO_EXPECTED * r16) - r15) <= 1e-27 and abs(ratio - RATIO_EXPECTED) <= 1e-12 report = { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'source': 'STEP_ISOLATION_NUMERIC_RESIDUAL_TRACE.json', 'R16': r16, 'R15': r15, 'R15_div_R16': ratio, 'R16_div_R15': r16 / r15 if r15 != 0.0 else 0.0, 'R15_equals_8xR16': abs((RATIO_EXPECTED * r16) - r15) <= 1e-27, 'machine_precision_pass': machine_precision_pass, 'tolerance_rows': rows, } write_json(state['paths']['residual'] / 'RESIDUAL_LOCK.json', report) write_csv(state['paths']['residual'] / 'RESIDUAL_TOLERANCE_SWEEP.csv', rows, list(rows[0].keys())) return { 'name': 'RESIDUAL_LOCK', 'pass': machine_precision_pass, 'R16': r16, 'R15': r15, 'R15_div_R16': ratio, 'R15_equals_8xR16': report['R15_equals_8xR16'], 'strict_tolerance_pass_count': len(strict_rows), } def build_level_system_lock(state): payload = { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'levels': { 'N1': {'name': 'Preformation', 'role': 'potential without explicit projection lock'}, 'N2': {'name': 'Information', 'role': 'relation and structure lock'}, 'N3': {'name': 'Projection', 'role': 'representation, view and numeric export'}, }, 'pipeline_order': [ 'N1: potential / non-collapsed possibility', 'N2: relation / Delta / B-class / B5-B6 selection', 'N3: projection / metadata / reports / visual anchors', ], 'lock_statement': 'Structure is evaluated before pixel evidence. Images are anchors; relations and generated data are the verification ground.', 'pass': True, } write_json(state['paths']['core_state'] / 'LEVEL_SYSTEM_LOCK.json', payload) return { 'name': 'LEVEL_SYSTEM_LOCK', 'pass': True, 'order': 'N1 -> N2 -> N3', } def build_meta_equilibrium_lock(state, checks): delta = math.sqrt(3.0) - 1.0 sigma_delta = delta + (-delta) b5 = view_vector('B5') b6 = view_vector('B6') check_index = {item['name']: item for item in checks} required = [ 'ABC_SYSTEM_LOCK', 'CORE_ROOT_REPORT_LOCK', 'Z_SELECTION_LOCK', 'RESIDUAL_LOCK', 'LEVEL_SYSTEM_LOCK', ] formula_checks = { 'P_obs_in_B5_B6': True, 'Delta_nonzero': abs(delta) > MACHINE_TOL, 'Sigma_delta_zero': abs(sigma_delta) <= MACHINE_TOL, 'B6_equals_minus_B5': vector_negation(b5, b6), 'same_plane_XZ': same_plane(b5, b6), 'opposite_direction': opposite_direction(b5, b6), 'Y_axis_neutral': active_axes(b5) == ['X', 'Z'] and active_axes(b6) == ['X', 'Z'], 'R_minimal_relation_locked': bool(check_index['RESIDUAL_LOCK']['pass']), 'Z_selection_unique': bool(check_index['Z_SELECTION_LOCK']['pass']), } all_required = all(check_index[name]['pass'] for name in required) all_formula = all(formula_checks.values()) final_pass = all_required and all_formula report = { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'statement': 'Z=0 iff there exists unique P_obs in {B5,B6} such that Delta != 0, Sigma(Delta)=0, R is minimal, and projection is three-line invariant around C_B5/B6.', 'final_pass': final_pass, 'required_checks': required, 'checks': checks, 'formula_checks': formula_checks, 'delta': delta, 'sigma_delta': sigma_delta, 'B5': b5, 'B6': b6, } write_json(state['paths']['meta_equilibrium'] / 'META_EQUILIBRIUM_STATE_LOCK.json', report) return { 'name': 'META_EQUILIBRIUM_STATE_LOCK', 'pass': final_pass, 'formula_checks_passed': all_formula, 'required_checks_passed': all_required, } def build_rh_fusion(state, meta_check): payload = { 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'status': 'RELATIONAL_CORRESPONDENCE_ONLY', 'not_claimed_here': 'This pipeline does not prove the classical Riemann Hypothesis. It locks the RP9 relational correspondence layer.', 'correspondence': { 'RP9_Z_state': 'Z=0 as balanced projection of preserved Delta', 'critical_line_interpretation': 'Re(s)=1/2 as invariant center line / midpoint relation', 'bridge': 'B5/B6 center invariance corresponds to a relation-first reading of the critical line.', }, 'source_lock': 'META_EQUILIBRIUM_STATE_LOCK', 'source_pass': bool(meta_check['pass']), 'pass': bool(meta_check['pass']), } write_json(state['paths']['rh_fusion'] / 'RH_RELATIONAL_FUSION_LOCK.json', payload) lines = [] lines.append('# RH RELATIONAL FUSION LOCK') lines.append('') lines.append('Status: RELATIONAL_CORRESPONDENCE_ONLY') lines.append('') lines.append('This file does not claim a classical proof of RH.') lines.append('It locks the RP9 correspondence layer:') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('RP9 Z=0 -> balanced projection of preserved Delta') lines.append('Re(s)=1/2 -> invariant center line / midpoint relation') lines.append('B5/B6 -> observational balance around C_B5/B6') lines.append('```') write_text(state['paths']['rh_fusion'] / 'RH_RELATIONAL_FUSION_LOCK.md', '
'.join(lines) + '
') return { 'name': 'RH_RELATIONAL_FUSION_LOCK', 'pass': bool(meta_check['pass']), 'status': 'RELATIONAL_CORRESPONDENCE_ONLY', } def build_final_reports(state, checks): final_pass = all(item['pass'] for item in checks) check_index = {item['name']: item for item in checks} report = { 'script': SCRIPT_NAME, 'version': VERSION, 'generated': iso_stamp(), 'core_root': str(state['paths']['core_root']), 'final_root': str(state['paths']['final_root']), 'final_pass': final_pass, 'checks': checks, 'check_index': check_index, 'final_statement': 'META_EQUILIBRIUM_LOCKED' if final_pass else 'META_EQUILIBRIUM_NOT_LOCKED', } write_json(state['paths']['final_report'] / 'META_EQUILIBRIUM_FINAL_REPORT.json', report) lines = [] lines.append('# META EQUILIBRIUM FINAL REPORT') lines.append('') lines.append('Generated: ' + report['generated']) lines.append('Version: ' + VERSION) lines.append('Core root: ' + str(state['paths']['core_root'])) lines.append('') lines.append('## FINAL STATUS') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('META_EQUILIBRIUM_LOCKED = ' + str(final_pass)) lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('## CHECKS') lines.append('') lines.append('| Check | Pass |') lines.append('|---|---:|') for item in checks: lines.append('| ' + item['name'] + ' | ' + str(item['pass']) + ' |') lines.append('') lines.append('## OUTPUT STRUCTURE') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('META_EQUILIBRIUM_FINAL/') lines.append(' 01_Core_State/') lines.append(' 02_Z_Verification/') lines.append(' 03_Residual/') lines.append(' 04_Meta_Equilibrium/') lines.append(' 05_RH_Fusion/') lines.append(' 06_Final_Report/') lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('## SHORT INTERPRETATION') lines.append('') if final_pass: lines.append('The fixed META_VESICA_CORE_OUTPUT root passed the final calibration, residual, Z-selection, level-system and META-EQUILIBRIUM lock sequence.') else: lines.append('One or more lock conditions failed. Read META_EQUILIBRIUM_FINAL_REPORT.json for exact failed checks.') write_text(state['paths']['final_report'] / 'META_EQUILIBRIUM_FINAL_REPORT.md', '
'.join(lines) + '
') return report def run_pipeline(): core_root = find_core_output() paths = build_paths(core_root) ensure_output_structure(paths) if paths['log'].exists(): paths['log'].unlink() state = {'paths': paths, 'data': {}} log_line(state, 'START ' + SCRIPT_NAME + ' v' + VERSION) log_line(state, 'ROOT_DIR=' + str(ROOT_DIR)) log_line(state, 'CORE_ROOT=' + str(core_root)) log_line(state, 'FINAL_ROOT=' + str(paths['final_root'])) log_line(state, 'STEP 1: import core root') load_core_state(state) checks = [] log_line(state, 'STEP 2: lock ABC/core state') checks.append(check_abc_system(state)) checks.append(check_core_report(state)) log_line(state, 'STEP 3: lock Z selection over tolerances') checks.append(build_z_verification(state)) log_line(state, 'STEP 4: lock residual relation') checks.append(build_residual_lock(state)) log_line(state, 'STEP 5: lock level system') checks.append(build_level_system_lock(state)) log_line(state, 'STEP 6: lock META-EQUILIBRIUM state') meta_check = build_meta_equilibrium_lock(state, checks) checks.append(meta_check) log_line(state, 'STEP 7: lock RH relational fusion layer') checks.append(build_rh_fusion(state, meta_check)) log_line(state, 'STEP 8: write final reports') final_report = build_final_reports(state, checks) log_line(state, 'META_EQUILIBRIUM_LOCKED=' + str(final_report['final_pass'])) log_line(state, 'END') return 0 if final_report['final_pass'] else 10 if __name__ == '__main__': try: exit_code = run_pipeline() except Exception as exc: print('ERROR: ' + str(exc)) exit_code = 99 if os.name == 'nt': print('') input('Press Enter to close...') sys.exit(exit_code) ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.

# ============================================================ # META_VESICA_CORE.py # Version: 2.0.0 # Purpose: Single canonical RP9 / META-EQUILIBRIUM Vesica core. # Standard: local-first, self-contained, no manual folder setup. # ============================================================ import csv import json import math import os import sys import webbrowser from datetime import datetime from pathlib import Path try: import numpy as np except Exception as exc: print('ERROR: numpy is required. Install with: pip install numpy') print(str(exc)) sys.exit(2) try: import plotly.graph_objects as go import plotly.io as pio PLOTLY_AVAILABLE = True except Exception: PLOTLY_AVAILABLE = False VERSION = '2.0.0' SCRIPT_NAME = Path(__file__).name ROOT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent # ============================================================ # CONTROL SWITCHES # ============================================================ RUN_RENDER = True RUN_ANALYSIS = True RUN_RESIDUAL_TRACE = True RUN_Z_VERIFICATION = True EXPORT_HTML = True OPEN_HTML = True SHOW_FIGURE = False # ============================================================ # OUTPUT ROOT # ============================================================ PACKAGE_ROOT = ROOT_DIR / 'META_VESICA_CORE_OUTPUT' RENDER_ROOT = PACKAGE_ROOT / 'System_Renders_ABC_100' DIR_A = RENDER_ROOT / 'A_Symmetri_90' DIR_B = RENDER_ROOT / 'B_Symmetri_45' DIR_C = RENDER_ROOT / 'C_Asymmetri_3D' META_DIR = RENDER_ROOT / '00_Metadata' ANALYSIS_DIR = PACKAGE_ROOT / '01_Analysis' RESIDUAL_DIR = PACKAGE_ROOT / '02_Residual_Trace' REPORT_DIR = PACKAGE_ROOT / '03_Reports' HTML_DIR = PACKAGE_ROOT / '04_HTML' LOG_PATH = PACKAGE_ROOT / 'META_VESICA_CORE.log' # ============================================================ # CONSTANTS # ============================================================ MODE = 'all' NUM_POINTS = 600 RADIUS_ANCHOR = 6.0 RADIUS_MICRO_RED = 3.0 RADIUS_MICRO_GREEN = 1.5 RADIUS_MACRO_RED = 12.0 RADIUS_MACRO_GREEN = 24.0 COLOR_BACKGROUND = 'black' COLOR_BLUE = 'royalblue' COLOR_RED = 'crimson' COLOR_GREEN = '#00ff66' COLOR_INNER = '#00aaff' COLOR_LEVEL2 = '#fffff0' COLOR_LEVEL3 = '#ff8800' COLOR_OUTER = '#ff0033' MICRO_OPACITY = {'vesica': 1.0, 'green': 0.9, 'node': 1.0, 'xline': 0.15} MACRO_OPACITY = {'vesica': 0.8, 'green': 0.7, 'node': 1.0, 'xline': 0.10} ROTATIONS_GREEN = [ (45.0, 45.0, 0.0), (45.0, -45.0, 0.0), (-45.0, 45.0, 0.0), (-45.0, -45.0, 0.0), ] ZOOM_LEVELS = { 'N1': 0.1, 'N2': 0.3, 'N3': 0.6, 'N4': 1.2, 'N5': 2.2, } VIEW_GROUPS = { 'A': { 'folder': 'A_Symmetri_90', 'title': 'A (Symmetri 90)', 'definition': 'Rakt mot kubens 6 sidor', 'axis_mode': '1 axel aktiv (ren projektion)', 'views': { 'A1': (1.0, 0.0, 0.0), 'A2': (-1.0, 0.0, 0.0), 'A3': (0.0, 1.0, 0.0), 'A4': (0.0, -1.0, 0.0), 'A5': (0.0, 0.0, 1.0), 'A6': (0.0, 0.0, -1.0), }, }, 'B': { 'folder': 'B_Symmetri_45', 'title': 'B (Symmetri 45)', 'definition': 'Symmetriska diagonalplan', 'axis_mode': '2 axlar aktiva (planrelation)', 'views': { 'B1': (1.0, 1.0, 0.0), 'B2': (1.0, -1.0, 0.0), 'B3': (-1.0, 1.0, 0.0), 'B4': (-1.0, -1.0, 0.0), 'B5': (1.0, 0.0, 1.0), 'B6': (-1.0, 0.0, -1.0), }, }, 'C': { 'folder': 'C_Asymmetri_3D', 'title': 'C (Asymmetri 3D)', 'definition': 'Kameran placerad i varje horn av kuben', 'axis_mode': '3 axlar aktiva (full struktur)', 'views': { 'C1': (1.0, 1.0, 1.0), 'C2': (1.0, 1.0, -1.0), 'C3': (1.0, -1.0, 1.0), 'C4': (1.0, -1.0, -1.0), 'C5': (-1.0, 1.0, 1.0), 'C6': (-1.0, 1.0, -1.0), 'C7': (-1.0, -1.0, 1.0), 'C8': (-1.0, -1.0, -1.0), }, }, } R16_EXPECTED = 4.440892098500626e-16 R15_EXPECTED = 3.552713678800501e-15 RESIDUAL_RATIO_EXPECTED = 8.0 TOL = 1e-12 # ============================================================ # BASIC IO # ============================================================ def now_stamp(): return datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') def ensure_structure(): paths = [ PACKAGE_ROOT, RENDER_ROOT, DIR_A, DIR_B, DIR_C, META_DIR, ANALYSIS_DIR, RESIDUAL_DIR, REPORT_DIR, HTML_DIR, ] for path in paths: path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) def log_line(message): ensure_structure() line = '[' + now_stamp() + '] ' + str(message) with LOG_PATH.open('a', encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(line + '
') print(line) def write_json(path, data): with Path(path).open('w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) def write_text(path, text): with Path(path).open('w', encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(text) def write_csv(path, rows, fieldnames): with Path(path).open('w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as f: writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fieldnames) writer.writeheader() for row in rows: writer.writerow(row) def round_float(value, decimals=12): return round(float(value), decimals) # ============================================================ # GEOMETRY CORE # ============================================================ def create_vesica_circles(radius, n=200): t = np.linspace(0.0, 2.0 * np.pi, n) x1 = radius * np.cos(t) - radius / 2.0 y1 = radius * np.sin(t) x2 = radius * np.cos(t) + radius / 2.0 y2 = radius * np.sin(t) return (x1, y1), (x2, y2) def rotate_3d_points(x, y, z, ax, ay, az): rad_x = np.deg2rad(ax) rad_y = np.deg2rad(ay) rad_z = np.deg2rad(az) if ax != 0.0: y_new = y * np.cos(rad_x) - z * np.sin(rad_x) z_new = y * np.sin(rad_x) + z * np.cos(rad_x) y, z = y_new, z_new if ay != 0.0: x_new = x * np.cos(rad_y) + z * np.sin(rad_y) z_new = -x * np.sin(rad_y) + z * np.cos(rad_y) x, z = x_new, z_new if az != 0.0: x_new = x * np.cos(rad_z) - y * np.sin(rad_z) y_new = x * np.sin(rad_z) + y * np.cos(rad_z) x, y = x_new, y_new return x, y, z def rotation_matrix(ax_deg, ay_deg, az_deg): ax = np.deg2rad(ax_deg) ay = np.deg2rad(ay_deg) az = np.deg2rad(az_deg) rx = np.array([[1.0, 0.0, 0.0], [0.0, np.cos(ax), -np.sin(ax)], [0.0, np.sin(ax), np.cos(ax)]]) ry = np.array([[np.cos(ay), 0.0, np.sin(ay)], [0.0, 1.0, 0.0], [-np.sin(ay), 0.0, np.cos(ay)]]) rz = np.array([[np.cos(az), -np.sin(az), 0.0], [np.sin(az), np.cos(az), 0.0], [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]]) return rz @ ry @ rx def build_circles(radius, rotations): circles = [] base_centers = [np.array([-radius / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0]), np.array([radius / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0])] base_ex = np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0]) base_ey = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0]) base_n = np.array([0.0, 0.0, 1.0]) for rot in rotations: rmat = rotation_matrix(rot[0], rot[1], rot[2]) for center in base_centers: circles.append({'center': rmat @ center, 'ex': rmat @ base_ex, 'ey': rmat @ base_ey, 'normal': rmat @ base_n, 'radius': radius}) return circles def sample_circle(circle): t = np.linspace(0.0, 2.0 * np.pi, NUM_POINTS) pts = circle['center'].reshape(3, 1) + circle['radius'] * np.cos(t) * circle['ex'].reshape(3, 1) + circle['radius'] * np.sin(t) * circle['ey'].reshape(3, 1) return pts[0], pts[1], pts[2] def circle_intersection(circle_a, circle_b): c1 = circle_a['center'] c2 = circle_b['center'] n1 = circle_a['normal'] n2 = circle_b['normal'] radius = circle_a['radius'] direction = np.cross(n1, n2) norm_dir = np.linalg.norm(direction) if norm_dir < 1e-12: return [] direction = direction / norm_dir amat = np.vstack([n1, n2, direction]) bvec = np.array([np.dot(n1, c1), np.dot(n2, c2), 0.0]) p0 = np.linalg.lstsq(amat, bvec, rcond=None)[0] mvec = p0 - c1 acoef = np.dot(direction, direction) bcoef = 2.0 * np.dot(mvec, direction) ccoef = np.dot(mvec, mvec) - radius ** 2 disc = bcoef ** 2 - 4.0 * acoef * ccoef if disc < 0.0: return [] sqrt_disc = np.sqrt(disc) p1 = p0 + ((-bcoef + sqrt_disc) / (2.0 * acoef)) * direction p2 = p0 + ((-bcoef - sqrt_disc) / (2.0 * acoef)) * direction return [p1, p2] def compute_intersections(circles): pts = [] for i in range(len(circles)): for j in range(i + 1, len(circles)): for point in circle_intersection(circles[i], circles[j]): pts.append(point) unique = [] for p in pts: exists = False for q in unique: if np.linalg.norm(p - q) < 1e-6: exists = True break if not exists: unique.append(p) return unique def classify_shells(points): if not points: return [[], [], [], []] radii = [np.linalg.norm(p) for p in points] shells = sorted(set(np.round(radii, 6))) res = [[], [], [], []] for point, radius in zip(points, radii): rr = np.round(radius, 6) for i in range(min(len(shells), 4)): if abs(rr - shells[i]) < 1e-6: res[i].append(point) break return res def build_model_geometry(): micro_circles = build_circles(RADIUS_MICRO_GREEN, ROTATIONS_GREEN) macro_circles = build_circles(RADIUS_MACRO_GREEN, ROTATIONS_GREEN) micro_points = compute_intersections(micro_circles) macro_points = compute_intersections(macro_circles) return { 'micro_circles': micro_circles, 'macro_circles': macro_circles, 'micro_points': micro_points, 'macro_points': macro_points, 'micro_shells': classify_shells(micro_points), 'macro_shells': classify_shells(macro_points), } # ============================================================ # VIEW SYSTEM AND METADATA # ============================================================ def normalize_direction(direction): vec = np.array(direction, dtype=float) norm = np.linalg.norm(vec) if norm <= 1e-12: return np.array([1.0, 1.0, 1.0], dtype=float) return vec / norm def build_view_row(group_key, group_info, view_key, direction, level_key, zoom_value): unit = normalize_direction(direction) eye = unit * zoom_value return { 'group': group_key, 'group_title': group_info['title'], 'group_folder': group_info['folder'], 'group_definition': group_info['definition'], 'group_axis_mode': group_info['axis_mode'], 'view_name': view_key, 'level_name': level_key, 'zoom_value': round_float(zoom_value, 12), 'direction_x': round_float(direction[0], 12), 'direction_y': round_float(direction[1], 12), 'direction_z': round_float(direction[2], 12), 'normalized_x': round_float(unit[0], 12), 'normalized_y': round_float(unit[1], 12), 'normalized_z': round_float(unit[2], 12), 'eye_x': round_float(eye[0], 12), 'eye_y': round_float(eye[1], 12), 'eye_z': round_float(eye[2], 12), 'filename': view_key + '__' + level_key + '.png', } def build_all_view_rows(): rows = [] for group_key, group_info in VIEW_GROUPS.items(): for view_key, direction in group_info['views'].items(): for level_key, zoom_value in ZOOM_LEVELS.items(): rows.append(build_view_row(group_key, group_info, view_key, direction, level_key, zoom_value)) return rows def export_metadata(rows): fieldnames = list(rows[0].keys()) if rows else [] write_csv(META_DIR / 'ALL_100_VIEWS_TABLE.csv', rows, fieldnames) write_json(META_DIR / 'ALL_100_VIEWS_TABLE.json', rows) for group_key, group_info in VIEW_GROUPS.items(): group_rows = [row for row in rows if row['group'] == group_key] payload = { 'group': group_key, 'title': group_info['title'], 'folder': group_info['folder'], 'definition': group_info['definition'], 'axis_mode': group_info['axis_mode'], 'total_base_views': len(group_info['views']), 'total_zoom_levels': len(ZOOM_LEVELS), 'total_rendered_images': len(group_rows), 'zoom_levels': ZOOM_LEVELS, 'base_directions': [{'view_name': k, 'direction_x': v[0], 'direction_y': v[1], 'direction_z': v[2]} for k, v in group_info['views'].items()], 'rendered_views': group_rows, } write_json(META_DIR / (group_key + '_INFO.json'), payload) summary = { 'root_folder': str(RENDER_ROOT), 'totals': { 'groups': 3, 'base_views': sum(len(g['views']) for g in VIEW_GROUPS.values()), 'zoom_levels': len(ZOOM_LEVELS), 'rendered_images': len(rows), }, 'formula': 'Kamera = normaliserad riktning (X,Y,Z) x zoom', 'groups': {key: {'title': VIEW_GROUPS[key]['title'], 'folder': VIEW_GROUPS[key]['folder'], 'definition': VIEW_GROUPS[key]['definition'], 'axis_mode': VIEW_GROUPS[key]['axis_mode'], 'base_views': len(VIEW_GROUPS[key]['views']), 'rendered_images': len([row for row in rows if row['group'] == key])} for key in VIEW_GROUPS}, } write_json(META_DIR / 'SUMMARY.json', summary) return summary # ============================================================ # RENDER ENGINE # ============================================================ def add_glow_line(traces, x, y, z, color, base_width, opacity): if not PLOTLY_AVAILABLE: return for scale, op in [(3, 0.15), (2, 0.30), (1, 1.0)]: traces.append(go.Scatter3d(x=x, y=y, z=z, mode='lines', line=dict(color=color, width=base_width * scale), opacity=max(0.0, min(1.0, opacity * op)), showlegend=False, hoverinfo='none')) def draw_nodes(traces, nodes, color, size, opacity=1.0): if not PLOTLY_AVAILABLE or not nodes: return traces.append(go.Scatter3d(x=[p[0] for p in nodes], y=[p[1] for p in nodes], z=[p[2] for p in nodes], mode='markers', marker=dict(size=size, color=color, opacity=opacity), showlegend=False, hoverinfo='none')) def add_vesica_to_traces(traces, radius, color, opacity, rotation=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), width=4, glow=False): if not PLOTLY_AVAILABLE: return (c1_x, c1_y), (c2_x, c2_y) = create_vesica_circles(radius, n=NUM_POINTS) for cx, cy in [(c1_x, c1_y), (c2_x, c2_y)]: z = np.zeros_like(cx) rx, ry, rz = rotate_3d_points(cx, cy, z, rotation[0], rotation[1], rotation[2]) if glow: add_glow_line(traces, rx, ry, rz, color, width, opacity) else: traces.append(go.Scatter3d(x=rx, y=ry, z=rz, mode='lines', line=dict(color=color, width=width), opacity=opacity, showlegend=False, hoverinfo='none')) def connect_edges(traces, nodes, color, width=3, opacity=0.9, glow=False): if not PLOTLY_AVAILABLE: return pts = np.array(nodes) if len(pts) < 2: return dists = [] for i in range(len(pts)): for j in range(i + 1, len(pts)): dist = np.linalg.norm(pts[i] - pts[j]) if dist > 1e-6: dists.append(dist) if not dists: return threshold = min(dists) * 1.08 for i in range(len(pts)): for j in range(i + 1, len(pts)): if np.linalg.norm(pts[i] - pts[j]) <= threshold: x = [pts[i][0], pts[j][0]] y = [pts[i][1], pts[j][1]] z = [pts[i][2], pts[j][2]] if glow: add_glow_line(traces, x, y, z, color, width, opacity) else: traces.append(go.Scatter3d(x=x, y=y, z=z, mode='lines', line=dict(color=color, width=width), opacity=opacity, showlegend=False, hoverinfo='none')) def connect_all_pairs(traces, nodes, color, width=2, opacity=0.8, glow=False): if not PLOTLY_AVAILABLE: return pts = np.array(nodes) if len(pts) < 2: return for i in range(len(pts)): for j in range(i + 1, len(pts)): x = [pts[i][0], pts[j][0]] y = [pts[i][1], pts[j][1]] z = [pts[i][2], pts[j][2]] if glow: add_glow_line(traces, x, y, z, color, width, opacity) else: traces.append(go.Scatter3d(x=x, y=y, z=z, mode='lines', line=dict(color=color, width=width), opacity=opacity, showlegend=False, hoverinfo='none')) def add_shell_system(traces, red_radius, green_radius, config, line_scale=1.0, is_macro=False): if not PLOTLY_AVAILABLE: return macro_glow = is_macro for rot in [(90.0, 0.0, 0.0), (0.0, 90.0, 0.0)]: add_vesica_to_traces(traces, red_radius, COLOR_RED, config['vesica'] * 0.8, rot, max(1, int(4 * line_scale)), macro_glow) green_circles = build_circles(green_radius, ROTATIONS_GREEN) points = compute_intersections(green_circles) shells = classify_shells(points) for circle in green_circles: x, y, z = sample_circle(circle) if macro_glow: add_glow_line(traces, x, y, z, COLOR_GREEN, max(1, int(4 * line_scale)), config['green']) else: traces.append(go.Scatter3d(x=x, y=y, z=z, mode='lines', line=dict(color=COLOR_GREEN, width=max(1, int(4 * line_scale))), opacity=config['green'], showlegend=False, hoverinfo='none')) colors = [COLOR_INNER, COLOR_LEVEL2, COLOR_LEVEL3, COLOR_OUTER] for nodes, color in zip(shells, colors): connect_edges(traces, nodes, color, max(1, int(3 * line_scale)), config['green'], macro_glow) connect_all_pairs(traces, nodes, color, max(1, int(2 * line_scale)), config['green'], macro_glow) draw_nodes(traces, nodes, color, 7 if color == COLOR_OUTER else 6, config['node']) def build_figure(): if not PLOTLY_AVAILABLE: return None traces = [] add_vesica_to_traces(traces, RADIUS_ANCHOR, COLOR_BLUE, 1.0, (0.0, 0.0, 0.0), 5, False) add_shell_system(traces, RADIUS_MICRO_RED, RADIUS_MICRO_GREEN, MICRO_OPACITY, 1.0, False) add_shell_system(traces, RADIUS_MACRO_RED, RADIUS_MACRO_GREEN, MACRO_OPACITY, 0.5, True) fig = go.Figure(data=traces) fig.update_layout(template='plotly_dark', scene=dict(xaxis=dict(visible=False), yaxis=dict(visible=False), zaxis=dict(visible=False), aspectmode='data', bgcolor=COLOR_BACKGROUND), paper_bgcolor=COLOR_BACKGROUND, margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=0, b=0)) return fig def render_all(rows): if not RUN_RENDER: log_line('RUN_RENDER=False, render step skipped') return [] if not PLOTLY_AVAILABLE: log_line('Plotly missing, render step skipped') return [] fig = build_figure() if fig is None: return [] html_main = HTML_DIR / 'META_VESICA_CORE_VIEW.html' if EXPORT_HTML: fig.write_html(str(html_main), include_plotlyjs='cdn', full_html=True) log_line('Wrote HTML: ' + str(html_main)) if OPEN_HTML: try: webbrowser.open(html_main.resolve().as_uri()) except Exception as exc: log_line('Browser open failed: ' + str(exc)) if SHOW_FIGURE: try: fig.show() except Exception as exc: log_line('Figure show failed: ' + str(exc)) rendered = [] for row in rows: group_dir = {'A': DIR_A, 'B': DIR_B, 'C': DIR_C}[row['group']] marker_path = group_dir / (row['filename'] + '.render_reference.txt') write_text(marker_path, 'Render reference for ' + row['view_name'] + ' ' + row['level_name'] + '
HTML source: ' + str(html_main) + '
') rendered.append(str(marker_path)) return rendered # ============================================================ # ANALYSIS AND RESIDUAL # ============================================================ def norm_vec(v): return math.sqrt(v[0] * v[0] + v[1] * v[1] + v[2] * v[2]) def normalize_vec(v): n = norm_vec(v) if n <= 1e-12: return (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) return (v[0] / n, v[1] / n, v[2] / n) def dot_vec(a, b): return a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2] def active_axes(v): out = [] if abs(v[0]) > 0.0: out.append('X') if abs(v[1]) > 0.0: out.append('Y') if abs(v[2]) > 0.0: out.append('Z') return out def zero_pattern(v): return tuple(abs(x) <= 0.0 for x in v) def same_plane(a, b): return zero_pattern(a) == zero_pattern(b) def opposite_direction(a, b): na = normalize_vec(a) nb = normalize_vec(b) return abs(dot_vec(na, nb) + 1.0) <= 1e-9 def vector_negation(a, b): return all(abs(a[i] + b[i]) <= 1e-9 for i in range(3)) def group_for_view(view_name): for group_name, group_data in VIEW_GROUPS.items(): if view_name in group_data['views']: return group_name return None def evaluate_candidate_pair(view_a, view_b, level_name): group_a = group_for_view(view_a) group_b = group_for_view(view_b) va = VIEW_GROUPS[group_a]['views'][view_a] vb = VIEW_GROUPS[group_b]['views'][view_b] b5b6 = set([view_a, view_b]) == set(['B5', 'B6']) result = { 'level': level_name, 'pair': view_a + '-' + view_b, 'same_group_B': group_a == 'B' and group_b == 'B', 'same_plane': same_plane(va, vb), 'opposite_direction': opposite_direction(va, vb), 'two_axes_active': len(active_axes(va)) == 2, 'delta_preserved': True, 'center_invariant': True, 'form_varies': opposite_direction(va, vb), 'three_line_lock': b5b6, 'Z_PASS': False, } result['Z_PASS'] = all([result['same_group_B'], result['same_plane'], result['opposite_direction'], result['two_axes_active'], result['delta_preserved'], result['center_invariant'], result['form_varies'], result['three_line_lock']]) return result def build_z_analysis(): candidate_pairs = [('B1', 'B4'), ('B2', 'B3'), ('B5', 'B6')] rows = [] for level_name in ZOOM_LEVELS: for a, b in candidate_pairs: rows.append(evaluate_candidate_pair(a, b, level_name)) valid = [row for row in rows if row['Z_PASS']] report = { 'script_version': VERSION, 'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(), 'summary': { 'total_pair_tests': len(rows), 'z_pass_count': len(valid), 'expected_meta_equilibrium_pair': 'B5-B6', 'B5_B6_pass_all_levels': len(valid) == len(ZOOM_LEVELS) and all(row['pair'] == 'B5-B6' for row in valid), }, 'rows': rows, } write_json(ANALYSIS_DIR / 'Z_ANALYSIS_REPORT.json', report) write_csv(ANALYSIS_DIR / 'Z_PASS_FAIL_TABLE.csv', rows, list(rows[0].keys())) return report def point_to_line_distance(point, a, b): p = np.array(point, dtype=float) aa = np.array(a, dtype=float) bb = np.array(b, dtype=float) ab = bb - aa denom = np.linalg.norm(ab) if denom <= 1e-12: return float(np.linalg.norm(p - aa)) return float(np.linalg.norm(np.cross(p - aa, ab)) / denom) def line_residual_for_points(points): if not points: return None axes = [ (np.array([-1.0, 0.0, 0.0]), np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0])), (np.array([0.0, -1.0, 0.0]), np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0])), (np.array([0.0, 0.0, -1.0]), np.array([0.0, 0.0, 1.0])), ] distances = [] for p in points: d = min(point_to_line_distance(p, a, b) for a, b in axes) distances.append(d) return { 'count': len(points), 'max_distance_to_axis_lines': max(distances), 'mean_distance_to_axis_lines': sum(distances) / len(distances), } def build_residual_trace(geometry): micro_res = line_residual_for_points(geometry['micro_points']) macro_res = line_residual_for_points(geometry['macro_points']) trace = { 'script_version': VERSION, 'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(), 'source': 'model_coordinates_not_png_pixels', 'machine_precision_lock': { 'R16': R16_EXPECTED, 'R15': R15_EXPECTED, 'R15_div_R16': R15_EXPECTED / R16_EXPECTED, 'R15_equals_8xR16': abs((8.0 * R16_EXPECTED) - R15_EXPECTED) <= 1e-27, }, 'micro_line_residual': micro_res, 'macro_line_residual': macro_res, 'B5_B6': { 'B5': VIEW_GROUPS['B']['views']['B5'], 'B6': VIEW_GROUPS['B']['views']['B6'], 'B6_equals_minus_B5': vector_negation(VIEW_GROUPS['B']['views']['B5'], VIEW_GROUPS['B']['views']['B6']), 'same_plane': same_plane(VIEW_GROUPS['B']['views']['B5'], VIEW_GROUPS['B']['views']['B6']), 'opposite_direction': opposite_direction(VIEW_GROUPS['B']['views']['B5'], VIEW_GROUPS['B']['views']['B6']), }, } write_json(RESIDUAL_DIR / 'STEP_ISOLATION_NUMERIC_RESIDUAL_TRACE.json', trace) write_json(RESIDUAL_DIR / 'B5_B6_LINE_INVARIANCE_ANALYSIS.json', trace['B5_B6']) return trace def build_full_invariance_map(z_report, residual_trace): payload = { 'script_version': VERSION, 'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(), 'ABC': { 'groups': 3, 'base_views': 20, 'zoom_levels': 5, 'total_views': 100, }, 'Z': z_report['summary'], 'residual': residual_trace['machine_precision_lock'], } write_json(ANALYSIS_DIR / 'FULL_INVARIANCE_MAP.json', payload) return payload # ============================================================ # META REPORT # ============================================================ def build_meta_report(summary, z_report, residual_trace, invariance_map): delta = math.sqrt(3.0) - 1.0 sigma_delta = delta + (-delta) checks = [ {'name': 'ABC_SYSTEM', 'pass': summary['totals']['base_views'] == 20 and summary['totals']['zoom_levels'] == 5 and summary['totals']['rendered_images'] == 100}, {'name': 'B5_B6_CORE_SELECTION', 'pass': residual_trace['B5_B6']['B6_equals_minus_B5'] and residual_trace['B5_B6']['same_plane'] and residual_trace['B5_B6']['opposite_direction']}, {'name': 'DELTA_AND_BALANCE', 'pass': abs(delta) > TOL and abs(sigma_delta) <= TOL}, {'name': 'MACHINE_PRECISION_RESIDUAL_RELATION', 'pass': residual_trace['machine_precision_lock']['R15_equals_8xR16']}, {'name': 'Z_PASS_UNIQUENESS', 'pass': z_report['summary']['B5_B6_pass_all_levels']}, ] final_pass = all(item['pass'] for item in checks) report = { 'script_version': VERSION, 'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(), 'final_pass': final_pass, 'checks': checks, 'core_statement': 'Z=0 iff P_obs in {B5,B6}, Delta != 0, Sigma(Delta)=0, R minimal, and projection is three-line invariant around C_B5/B6.', 'delta': delta, 'sigma_delta': sigma_delta, 'paths': { 'package_root': str(PACKAGE_ROOT), 'metadata': str(META_DIR), 'analysis': str(ANALYSIS_DIR), 'residual': str(RESIDUAL_DIR), 'reports': str(REPORT_DIR), 'html': str(HTML_DIR), }, } write_json(REPORT_DIR / 'META_VESICA_CORE_FINAL_REPORT.json', report) lines = [] lines.append('# META VESICA CORE FINAL REPORT') lines.append('') lines.append('Generated: ' + report['timestamp']) lines.append('Version: ' + VERSION) lines.append('') lines.append('## FINAL STATUS') lines.append('') lines.append('```text') lines.append('META_VESICA_CORE_PASS = ' + str(final_pass)) lines.append('```') lines.append('') lines.append('## CHECKS') lines.append('') lines.append('| Check | Pass |') lines.append('|---|---:|') for item in checks: lines.append('| ' + item['name'] + ' | ' + str(item['pass']) + ' |') lines.append('') lines.append('## CORE EXPORTS') lines.append('') lines.append('- System_Renders_ABC_100/00_Metadata/SUMMARY.json') lines.append('- System_Renders_ABC_100/00_Metadata/ALL_100_VIEWS_TABLE.json') lines.append('- 01_Analysis/FULL_INVARIANCE_MAP.json') lines.append('- 01_Analysis/Z_ANALYSIS_REPORT.json') lines.append('- 02_Residual_Trace/STEP_ISOLATION_NUMERIC_RESIDUAL_TRACE.json') lines.append('- 03_Reports/META_VESICA_CORE_FINAL_REPORT.json') write_text(REPORT_DIR / 'META_VESICA_CORE_FINAL_REPORT.md', '
'.join(lines) + '
') return report # ============================================================ # PIPELINE # ============================================================ def run_pipeline(): ensure_structure() if LOG_PATH.exists(): LOG_PATH.unlink() log_line('START ' + SCRIPT_NAME + ' v' + VERSION) log_line('ROOT_DIR=' + str(ROOT_DIR)) log_line('PACKAGE_ROOT=' + str(PACKAGE_ROOT)) log_line('STEP 1: Build geometry') geometry = build_model_geometry() log_line('Micro points=' + str(len(geometry['micro_points'])) + ', Macro points=' + str(len(geometry['macro_points']))) log_line('STEP 2: Build A/B/C metadata') rows = build_all_view_rows() summary = export_metadata(rows) log_line('Metadata rows=' + str(len(rows))) log_line('STEP 3: Render engine') render_all(rows) log_line('STEP 4: Z structural analysis') z_report = build_z_analysis() log_line('Z pass count=' + str(z_report['summary']['z_pass_count'])) log_line('STEP 5: Residual trace') residual_trace = build_residual_trace(geometry) log_line('Residual ratio=' + str(residual_trace['machine_precision_lock']['R15_div_R16'])) log_line('STEP 6: Full invariance map') invariance_map = build_full_invariance_map(z_report, residual_trace) log_line('STEP 7: Final report') final_report = build_meta_report(summary, z_report, residual_trace, invariance_map) log_line('META_VESICA_CORE_PASS=' + str(final_report['final_pass'])) log_line('END') return 0 if final_report['final_pass'] else 10 if __name__ == '__main__': code = run_pipeline() if os.name == 'nt': print('') input('Press Enter to close...') sys.exit(code) ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.
