item.description: RP9_CORE4_B5B6_OPERATOR_LOCK_VALIDATOR.py Version: 1.0.0 Syfte: Isolerad verifieringskod för frågan: "Uppstår B5/B6-läget som en nödvändig konsekvens av den genererade Core4/H-D-R-strukturen, eller är B5/B6 endast ett valt observationsperspektiv?" Standard: - Lokal först. - Självstående. - Ingen extern indata krävs. - Inga tidigare slutsatser importeras som bevis. - Skriver JSON, CSV, LOGG och Markdown. - Varje test anger: * vad som testas * hur det testas * varför det testas * resultat from __future__ import annotations import csv import json import math import sys from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict from datetime import datetime from pathlib import Path from typing import Dict, Iterable, List, Tuple try: import numpy as np except Exception as exc: print("ERROR: numpy krävs. Installera med: pip install numpy") print(str(exc)) sys.exit(2) # ============================================================ # GLOBALA INSTÄLLNINGAR # ============================================================ SCRIPT_VERSION = "1.0.0" SCRIPT_NAME = Path(__file__).name try: ROOT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent except NameError: ROOT_DIR = Path.cwd() OUTPUT_ROOT = ROOT_DIR / "RP9_CORE4_B5B6_OPERATOR_LOCK_VALIDATION_OUTPUT" JSON_DIR = OUTPUT_ROOT / "01_JSON" CSV_DIR = OUTPUT_ROOT / "02_CSV" REPORT_DIR = OUTPUT_ROOT / "03_REPORT" LOG_PATH = OUTPUT_ROOT / "RP9_CORE4_B5B6_OPERATOR_LOCK_VALIDATOR.log" EPS = 1.0e-9 MACHINE_TOL = 1.0e-12 # Samma Core4-konstanter som den befintliga Core4-koden använder. RADIUS = 1.5 NUM_POINTS = 600 ROTATIONS = [ (45.0, 45.0, 0.0), (45.0, -45.0, 0.0), (-45.0, 45.0, 0.0), (-45.0, -45.0, 0.0), ] # Standardiserat ABC-observationsrum. # Koden söker igenom hela rummet, inte bara B5/B6. VIEW_GROUPS: Dict[str, Dict[str, Tuple[float, float, float]]] = { "A": { "A1": (1.0, 0.0, 0.0), "A2": (-1.0, 0.0, 0.0), "A3": (0.0, 1.0, 0.0), "A4": (0.0, -1.0, 0.0), "A5": (0.0, 0.0, 1.0), "A6": (0.0, 0.0, -1.0), }, "B": { "B1": (1.0, 1.0, 0.0), "B2": (1.0, -1.0, 0.0), "B3": (-1.0, 1.0, 0.0), "B4": (-1.0, -1.0, 0.0), "B5": (1.0, 0.0, 1.0), "B6": (-1.0, 0.0, -1.0), }, "C": { "C1": (1.0, 1.0, 1.0), "C2": (1.0, 1.0, -1.0), "C3": (1.0, -1.0, 1.0), "C4": (1.0, -1.0, -1.0), "C5": (-1.0, 1.0, 1.0), "C6": (-1.0, 1.0, -1.0), "C7": (-1.0, -1.0, 1.0), "C8": (-1.0, -1.0, -1.0), }, } AXIS_LABELS = ["X", "Y", "Z"] # ============================================================ # IO # ============================================================ def iso_stamp() -> str: return datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds") def ensure_dirs() -> None: for path in [OUTPUT_ROOT, JSON_DIR, CSV_DIR, REPORT_DIR]: path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) def log_line(message: str) -> None: ensure_dirs() line = f"[{iso_stamp()}] {message}" print(line) with LOG_PATH.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(line + "\n") def write_json(path: Path, payload: object) -> None: path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(payload, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) def write_text(path: Path, text: str) -> None: path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(text) def write_csv(path: Path, rows: List[dict]) -> None: path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) if not rows: path.write_text("", encoding="utf-8") return fieldnames = list(rows[0].keys()) with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f: writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fieldnames) writer.writeheader() writer.writerows(rows) # ============================================================ # GEOMETRI: CORE4-GENERERING # ============================================================ def rotation_matrix(ax_deg: float, ay_deg: float, az_deg: float) -> np.ndarray: ax = np.deg2rad(ax_deg) ay = np.deg2rad(ay_deg) az = np.deg2rad(az_deg) rx = np.array([ [1.0, 0.0, 0.0], [0.0, np.cos(ax), -np.sin(ax)], [0.0, np.sin(ax), np.cos(ax)], ]) ry = np.array([ [np.cos(ay), 0.0, np.sin(ay)], [0.0, 1.0, 0.0], [-np.sin(ay), 0.0, np.cos(ay)], ]) rz = np.array([ [np.cos(az), -np.sin(az), 0.0], [np.sin(az), np.cos(az), 0.0], [0.0, 0.0, 1.0], ]) return rz @ ry @ rx def build_circles(radius: float, rotations: List[Tuple[float, float, float]]) -> List[dict]: circles: List[dict] = [] base_centers = [ np.array([-radius / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0]), np.array([radius / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0]), ] base_ex = np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0]) base_ey = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0]) base_n = np.array([0.0, 0.0, 1.0]) for rot in rotations: rmat = rotation_matrix(*rot) for center in base_centers: circles.append({ "center": rmat @ center, "ex": rmat @ base_ex, "ey": rmat @ base_ey, "normal": rmat @ base_n, "radius": radius, "rotation": rot, }) return circles def circle_intersection(circle_a: dict, circle_b: dict) -> List[np.ndarray]: c1 = circle_a["center"] c2 = circle_b["center"] n1 = circle_a["normal"] n2 = circle_b["normal"] radius = circle_a["radius"] direction = np.cross(n1, n2) norm_dir = np.linalg.norm(direction) if norm_dir < 1e-12: return [] direction = direction / norm_dir amat = np.vstack([n1, n2, direction]) bvec = np.array([np.dot(n1, c1), np.dot(n2, c2), 0.0]) p0 = np.linalg.lstsq(amat, bvec, rcond=None)[0] mvec = p0 - c1 acoef = np.dot(direction, direction) bcoef = 2.0 * np.dot(mvec, direction) ccoef = np.dot(mvec, mvec) - radius ** 2 disc = bcoef ** 2 - 4.0 * acoef * ccoef if disc < -1e-12: return [] disc = max(0.0, disc) sqrt_disc = math.sqrt(disc) p1 = p0 + ((-bcoef + sqrt_disc) / (2.0 * acoef)) * direction p2 = p0 + ((-bcoef - sqrt_disc) / (2.0 * acoef)) * direction return [p1, p2] def unique_points(points: Iterable[np.ndarray], tol: float = 1e-6) -> List[np.ndarray]: unique: List[np.ndarray] = [] for point in points: if not any(float(np.linalg.norm(point - previous)) <= tol for previous in unique): unique.append(point) return unique def compute_intersections(circles: List[dict]) -> List[np.ndarray]: points: List[np.ndarray] = [] for i in range(len(circles)): for j in range(i + 1, len(circles)): points.extend(circle_intersection(circles[i], circles[j])) return unique_points(points) def classify_shells(points: List[np.ndarray]) -> List[dict]: if not points: return [] radii = [float(np.linalg.norm(p)) for p in points] rounded = sorted(set(round(r, 6) for r in radii)) shells: List[dict] = [] for radius in rounded: shell_points = [ p for p, r in zip(points, radii) if abs(round(r, 6) - radius) <= 1e-6 ] shells.append({ "radius": radius, "point_count": len(shell_points), }) return shells def core4_geometry() -> dict: circles = build_circles(RADIUS, ROTATIONS) points = compute_intersections(circles) point_array = np.array(points) centroid = point_array.mean(axis=0) min_xyz = point_array.min(axis=0) max_xyz = point_array.max(axis=0) span_xyz = max_xyz - min_xyz std_xyz = point_array.std(axis=0) # Härled dominerande Core4-plan från genererad punktstruktur. # Detta används för att undvika att hårdkoda XZ som slutsats. # De två största axelspannen definierar Core4:s primära differensplan. ranked_axes = sorted( list(zip(AXIS_LABELS, span_xyz.tolist(), std_xyz.tolist())), key=lambda item: (item[1], item[2]), reverse=True, ) dominant_axes = sorted([ranked_axes[0][0], ranked_axes[1][0]]) suppressed_axis = [axis for axis in AXIS_LABELS if axis not in dominant_axes][0] return { "circle_count": len(circles), "relation_count": len(circles) // 2, "intersection_count": len(points), "shells": classify_shells(points), "centroid": centroid.tolist(), "min_xyz": min_xyz.tolist(), "max_xyz": max_xyz.tolist(), "span_xyz": dict(zip(AXIS_LABELS, span_xyz.tolist())), "std_xyz": dict(zip(AXIS_LABELS, std_xyz.tolist())), "dominant_axes": dominant_axes, "suppressed_axis": suppressed_axis, "points": [p.tolist() for p in points], } # ============================================================ # KANDIDATGENERERING OCH TEST # ============================================================ def flatten_views() -> Dict[str, Tuple[float, float, float]]: out: Dict[str, Tuple[float, float, float]] = {} for group in VIEW_GROUPS.values(): out.update(group) return out def group_for_view(view_name: str) -> str: for group_name, group in VIEW_GROUPS.items(): if view_name in group: return group_name raise ValueError(f"Okänd vy: {view_name}") def vec(v: Tuple[float, float, float]) -> np.ndarray: return np.array(v, dtype=float) def norm(v: np.ndarray) -> float: return float(np.linalg.norm(v)) def normalize(v: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray: n = norm(v) if n <= EPS: return np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.0]) return v / n def active_axes(v: np.ndarray) -> List[str]: axes: List[str] = [] for label, value in zip(AXIS_LABELS, v.tolist()): if abs(value) > EPS: axes.append(label) return axes def is_inverse_pair(a: np.ndarray, b: np.ndarray) -> bool: return bool(norm(a + b) <= EPS) def same_plane(a: np.ndarray, b: np.ndarray) -> bool: # Samma nollmönster = samma funktionella plan. return tuple(abs(x) <= EPS for x in a) == tuple(abs(x) <= EPS for x in b) def opposite_direction(a: np.ndarray, b: np.ndarray) -> bool: return bool(abs(float(np.dot(normalize(a), normalize(b))) + 1.0) <= EPS) @dataclass class CandidateResult: pair: str group_left: str group_right: str v_left: List[float] v_right: List[float] inverse_pair: bool same_plane: bool opposite_direction: bool center_invariant: bool delta_nonzero: bool left_active_axes: List[str] right_active_axes: List[str] two_axes_active: bool no_suppressed_axis_active: bool matches_core4_dominant_axes: bool three_line_lock_candidate: bool z_pass: bool fail_reasons: List[str] def evaluate_candidate_pair( left_name: str, right_name: str, left_vec: Tuple[float, float, float], right_vec: Tuple[float, float, float], core_dominant_axes: List[str], core_suppressed_axis: str, ) -> CandidateResult: a = vec(left_vec) b = vec(right_vec) left_axes = active_axes(a) right_axes = active_axes(b) inverse = is_inverse_pair(a, b) same = same_plane(a, b) opposite = opposite_direction(a, b) center = bool(norm((a + b) / 2.0) <= EPS) delta = bool(norm(a) > EPS and norm(b) > EPS) two_axes = len(left_axes) == 2 and len(right_axes) == 2 no_suppressed = core_suppressed_axis not in left_axes and core_suppressed_axis not in right_axes matches_core_axes = sorted(left_axes) == sorted(core_dominant_axes) and sorted(right_axes) == sorted(core_dominant_axes) # Three-line-lock som testbar kandidat: # 1. invers relation # 2. centruminvarians # 3. två aktiva axlar # 4. samma dominanta Core4-plan # 5. den undertryckta Core4-axeln är neutral three_line_lock_candidate = bool( inverse and same and opposite and center and delta and two_axes and no_suppressed and matches_core_axes ) fail_reasons = [] checks = { "inverse_pair": inverse, "same_plane": same, "opposite_direction": opposite, "center_invariant": center, "delta_nonzero": delta, "two_axes_active": two_axes, "no_suppressed_axis_active": no_suppressed, "matches_core4_dominant_axes": matches_core_axes, "three_line_lock_candidate": three_line_lock_candidate, } for key, passed in checks.items(): if not passed: fail_reasons.append(key) return CandidateResult( pair=f"{left_name}-{right_name}", group_left=group_for_view(left_name), group_right=group_for_view(right_name), v_left=list(left_vec), v_right=list(right_vec), inverse_pair=inverse, same_plane=same, opposite_direction=opposite, center_invariant=center, delta_nonzero=delta, left_active_axes=left_axes, right_active_axes=right_axes, two_axes_active=two_axes, no_suppressed_axis_active=no_suppressed, matches_core4_dominant_axes=matches_core_axes, three_line_lock_candidate=three_line_lock_candidate, z_pass=three_line_lock_candidate, fail_reasons=fail_reasons, ) def generate_all_inverse_candidates() -> List[Tuple[str, str]]: views = flatten_views() names = list(views.keys()) pairs: List[Tuple[str, str]] = [] for i in range(len(names)): for j in range(i + 1, len(names)): if is_inverse_pair(vec(views[names[i]]), vec(views[names[j]])): pairs.append((names[i], names[j])) return pairs def run_candidate_scan(core: dict) -> List[CandidateResult]: views = flatten_views() candidates = generate_all_inverse_candidates() rows: List[CandidateResult] = [] for left, right in candidates: rows.append( evaluate_candidate_pair( left, right, views[left], views[right], core["dominant_axes"], core["suppressed_axis"], ) ) return rows # ============================================================ # SEXPUNKTS-PROTOKOLL # ============================================================ def build_protocol(core: dict, candidates: List[CandidateResult]) -> dict: passing = [c for c in candidates if c.z_pass] passing_pairs = [c.pair for c in passing] b5b6_unique = passing_pairs == ["B5-B6"] # Falsifieringslogik: # Om någon annan kandidat än B5-B6 passerar, är hypotesen falsifierad. alternatives = [c.pair for c in candidates if c.z_pass and c.pair != "B5-B6"] if b5b6_unique: final_classification = "OPERATOR_CONSTRAINED_UNIQUE_LOCK" final_answer = ( "B5/B6 uppstår som unik låskandidat inom den genererade Core4-strukturen " "och det deklarerade ABC-observationsrummet. Det är därmed inte endast ett " "godtyckligt valt observationsperspektiv under dessa testvillkor." ) else: final_classification = "NOT_OPERATOR_CONSTRAINED_UNIQUE_LOCK" final_answer = ( "B5/B6 kunde inte verifieras som unik låskandidat. Antingen passerar ingen " "kandidat, eller så finns alternativa kandidater." ) boundary = ( "Testet verifierar unikhet inom den genererade Core4/H-D-R-strukturen och " "det definierade ABC-kandidatrummet. Det gör inte ett starkare påstående om " "observerfri geometri utanför detta formellt deklarerade kandidatrum." ) protocol = { "metadata": { "script": SCRIPT_NAME, "version": SCRIPT_VERSION, "generated": iso_stamp(), }, "hypothesis": { "question": ( "Är B5/B6 ett nödvändigt låsläge som följer av den genererade Core4/H-D-R-" "strukturen, eller endast ett valt observationsperspektiv?" ), "testable_form": ( "Om Core4 genereras utan att B5/B6 importeras som slutsats, och hela ABC-" "kandidatrummet därefter söks igenom, skall endast B5-B6 uppfylla samtliga " "låsvillkor: invers relation, centruminvarians, Δ != 0, två aktiva axlar, " "neutral undertryckt Core4-axel och matchning mot Core4:s härledda dominanta plan." ), }, "generated_structure": { "what": "Den genererade Core4-strukturen, inte tidigare slutsatsdata.", "how": ( "Koden bygger åtta cirklar från fyra rotationsrelationer, beräknar deras " "intersektionspunkter och härleder Core4:s dominanta axelplan från punktfältets spann." ), "why": ( "För att testet skall börja i genererad struktur och inte i en importerad B5/B6-slutsats." ), "result": { "circle_count": core["circle_count"], "relation_count": core["relation_count"], "intersection_count": core["intersection_count"], "dominant_axes": core["dominant_axes"], "suppressed_axis": core["suppressed_axis"], "span_xyz": core["span_xyz"], "std_xyz": core["std_xyz"], "shells": core["shells"], }, }, "candidate_identification": { "what": "Samtliga inversa kandidater i ABC-rummet.", "how": "Koden söker alla par där v_left + v_right = 0 inom tolerans.", "why": "För att undvika att B5/B6 väljs manuellt innan testet.", "candidate_count": len(candidates), "candidate_pairs": [c.pair for c in candidates], }, "necessity_test": { "what": "Om B5/B6 är enda kandidat som uppfyller Core4-låsvillkoren.", "how": ( "Varje kandidat testas mot invers relation, centruminvarians, Δ != 0, " "två aktiva axlar, neutral undertryckt Core4-axel och matchning mot Core4:s " "härledda dominanta axlar." ), "why": ( "Om endast B5/B6 passerar efter att Core4-planen härletts från strukturen, " "är B5/B6 inte enbart ett valt läge inom detta kandidatrum." ), "passing_pairs": passing_pairs, "b5b6_unique": b5b6_unique, }, "falsification": { "what": "Sökning efter alternativa låskandidater.", "how": "Alla inversa ABC-par testas med samma villkor.", "why": "Hypotesen faller om någon annan kandidat uppfyller samma låsvillkor.", "alternative_passing_pairs": alternatives, "falsified": len(alternatives) > 0 or not b5b6_unique, }, "final_result": { "classification": final_classification, "answer": final_answer, "boundary": boundary, "final_pass": b5b6_unique, }, } return protocol # ============================================================ # RAPPORT # ============================================================ def candidate_rows_for_csv(candidates: List[CandidateResult]) -> List[dict]: rows = [] for c in candidates: d = asdict(c) d["v_left"] = json.dumps(d["v_left"]) d["v_right"] = json.dumps(d["v_right"]) d["left_active_axes"] = ",".join(d["left_active_axes"]) d["right_active_axes"] = ",".join(d["right_active_axes"]) d["fail_reasons"] = ",".join(d["fail_reasons"]) rows.append(d) return rows def build_markdown_report(protocol: dict, candidates: List[CandidateResult]) -> str: result = protocol["final_result"] generated = protocol["generated_structure"]["result"] passing = protocol["necessity_test"]["passing_pairs"] lines = [] lines.append("# RP9 CORE4 → B5/B6 OPERATOR LOCK VALIDATION") lines.append("") lines.append(f"Generated: {protocol['metadata']['generated']}") lines.append(f"Version: {SCRIPT_VERSION}") lines.append("") lines.append("## FINAL STATUS") lines.append("") lines.append("```text") lines.append(f"FINAL_PASS = {result['final_pass']}") lines.append(f"CLASSIFICATION = {result['classification']}") lines.append("```") lines.append("") lines.append("## FINAL ANSWER") lines.append("") lines.append(result["answer"]) lines.append("") lines.append("## BOUNDARY") lines.append("") lines.append(result["boundary"]) lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("") lines.append("## 1. Deklarerad hypotes") lines.append("") lines.append("### Vad testas?") lines.append("") lines.append(protocol["hypothesis"]["question"]) lines.append("") lines.append("### Testbar form") lines.append("") lines.append(protocol["hypothesis"]["testable_form"]) lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("") lines.append("## 2. Genererad struktur") lines.append("") lines.append("### Vad testas?") lines.append("") lines.append(protocol["generated_structure"]["what"]) lines.append("") lines.append("### Hur testas det?") lines.append("") lines.append(protocol["generated_structure"]["how"]) lines.append("") lines.append("### Varför testas det?") lines.append("") lines.append(protocol["generated_structure"]["why"]) lines.append("") lines.append("### Resultat") lines.append("") lines.append("```json") lines.append(json.dumps(generated, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)) lines.append("```") lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("") lines.append("## 3. Kandidatidentifiering") lines.append("") lines.append("### Vad testas?") lines.append("") lines.append(protocol["candidate_identification"]["what"]) lines.append("") lines.append("### Hur testas det?") lines.append("") lines.append(protocol["candidate_identification"]["how"]) lines.append("") lines.append("### Varför testas det?") lines.append("") lines.append(protocol["candidate_identification"]["why"]) lines.append("") lines.append("### Resultat") lines.append("") lines.append("```text") lines.append(f"KANDIDATER = {protocol['candidate_identification']['candidate_count']}") lines.append("KANDIDATPAR = " + ", ".join(protocol["candidate_identification"]["candidate_pairs"])) lines.append("```") lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("") lines.append("## 4. Nödvändighetstest") lines.append("") lines.append("### Vad testas?") lines.append("") lines.append(protocol["necessity_test"]["what"]) lines.append("") lines.append("### Hur testas det?") lines.append("") lines.append(protocol["necessity_test"]["how"]) lines.append("") lines.append("### Varför testas det?") lines.append("") lines.append(protocol["necessity_test"]["why"]) lines.append("") lines.append("### Resultat") lines.append("") lines.append("```text") lines.append("PASSING_PAIRS = " + (", ".join(passing) if passing else "NONE")) lines.append(f"B5B6_UNIQUE = {protocol['necessity_test']['b5b6_unique']}") lines.append("```") lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("") lines.append("## 5. Falsifiering") lines.append("") lines.append("### Vad testas?") lines.append("") lines.append(protocol["falsification"]["what"]) lines.append("") lines.append("### Hur testas det?") lines.append("") lines.append(protocol["falsification"]["how"]) lines.append("") lines.append("### Varför testas det?") lines.append("") lines.append(protocol["falsification"]["why"]) lines.append("") lines.append("### Resultat") lines.append("") lines.append("```text") lines.append("ALTERNATIVE_PASSING_PAIRS = " + (", ".join(protocol["falsification"]["alternative_passing_pairs"]) if protocol["falsification"]["alternative_passing_pairs"] else "NONE")) lines.append(f"FALSIFIED = {protocol['falsification']['falsified']}") lines.append("```") lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("") lines.append("## 6. Kandidattabell") lines.append("") lines.append("| Pair | Z_PASS | Active axes | Fail reasons |") lines.append("|---|---:|---|---|") for c in candidates: axes = "/".join(c.left_active_axes) fail = ", ".join(c.fail_reasons) if c.fail_reasons else "-" lines.append(f"| {c.pair} | {c.z_pass} | {axes} | {fail} |") lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("") lines.append("## Slutsats") lines.append("") lines.append(result["answer"]) lines.append("") return "\n".join(lines) + "\n" # ============================================================ # MAIN # ============================================================ def run() -> int: ensure_dirs() if LOG_PATH.exists(): LOG_PATH.unlink() log_line(f"START {SCRIPT_NAME} v{SCRIPT_VERSION}") log_line(f"OUTPUT_ROOT={OUTPUT_ROOT}") log_line("STEP 1/6: Deklarera hypotes") log_line("STEP 2/6: Generera Core4-struktur") core = core4_geometry() log_line( "Core4 generated: " f"circles={core['circle_count']}, " f"relations={core['relation_count']}, " f"intersections={core['intersection_count']}, " f"dominant_axes={core['dominant_axes']}, " f"suppressed_axis={core['suppressed_axis']}" ) log_line("STEP 3/6: Identifiera samtliga inversa kandidater") candidates = run_candidate_scan(core) log_line(f"Candidate count={len(candidates)}") log_line("STEP 4/6: Verifiera B5/B6-nödvändighet") log_line("STEP 5/6: Falsifiera genom alternativsökning") protocol = build_protocol(core, candidates) log_line( f"FINAL_PASS={protocol['final_result']['final_pass']} " f"CLASSIFICATION={protocol['final_result']['classification']}" ) log_line("STEP 6/6: Skriv JSON, CSV och Markdown") write_json(JSON_DIR / "CORE4_GEOMETRY.json", core) write_json(JSON_DIR / "CANDIDATE_RESULTS.json", [asdict(c) for c in candidates]) write_json(JSON_DIR / "FINAL_VALIDATION_REPORT.json", protocol) write_csv(CSV_DIR / "CANDIDATE_RESULTS.csv", candidate_rows_for_csv(candidates)) write_text(REPORT_DIR / "RP9_CORE4_B5B6_OPERATOR_LOCK_VALIDATION_REPORT.md", build_markdown_report(protocol, candidates)) log_line("END") return 0 if protocol["final_result"]["final_pass"] else 10 if __name__ == "__main__": try: sys.exit(run()) except Exception as exc: print(f"ERROR: {exc}") sys.exit(99) ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.

item.title: RP9. CORE4. (M-P-V). PYTHON
item.description:
RP9_CORE4_MANIFEST_POSITION_VALIDATOR.py Version: 1.0.0 Syfte: Besvarar den faktiska frågan: När Vesica Piscis ligger rakt fram i XY-planet och H-D-R-sekvensen genererar Core4, vilken observationsposition / orienteringslinje manifesteras av operatorn själv? Sammanfaller den operatoriskt härledda Core4-positionen med B5-N6 / B6-N6, eller krävs ett efterföljande observationsval? Princip: Koden börjar inte med B5/B6. Koden härleder först positionen från startläget: Vesica Piscis frontläge = XY-plan relationell längd = X frontal observationsnormal = Z H-D-R halva-vridning mellan 0° och 90° = 45° i XZ-relationen Först efter att den positionen är härledd jämförs den med ABC/B5/B6. Output: - JSON-rapport - CSV med axel-/positionsjämförelser - Markdownrapport - Logg Exit code: 0 = testet kunde besvara frågan och positionen matchar B5/B6-linjen 10 = testet kunde besvara frågan men positionen matchar inte B5/B6-linjen 20 = testet är definitionsmässigt otillräckligt from __future__ import annotations import ast import csv import hashlib import json import math import sys import zipfile from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass from datetime import datetime from pathlib import Path from typing import Dict, Iterable, List, Optional, Tuple try: import numpy as np except Exception as exc: print("ERROR: numpy krävs för denna validator.") print(str(exc)) sys.exit(20) SCRIPT_NAME = Path(__file__).name SCRIPT_VERSION = "1.0.0" ROOT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent if "__file__" in globals() else Path.cwd() OUT_DIR = ROOT_DIR / "RP9_CORE4_MANIFEST_POSITION_VALIDATION_OUTPUT" JSON_DIR = OUT_DIR / "01_JSON" CSV_DIR = OUT_DIR / "02_CSV" REPORT_DIR = OUT_DIR / "03_REPORT" LOG_PATH = OUT_DIR / "RP9_CORE4_MANIFEST_POSITION_VALIDATOR.log" ZIP_PATH = ROOT_DIR / "RP9_CORE4_MANIFEST_POSITION_VALIDATION_PACKAGE.zip" EPS = 1.0e-12 ANGLE_TOL_DEG = 1.0e-9 REFERENCE_FILES = [ "Vesica_Render_HTML_Only_AB_Categorized.py", "RP9_B5_B6_Locked_Viewer_generator.py", "RP9_B5_B6_Image_Comparator.html", ] FALLBACK_ROTATIONS_GREEN = [ (45.0, 45.0, 0.0), (45.0, -45.0, 0.0), (-45.0, 45.0, 0.0), (-45.0, -45.0, 0.0), ] FALLBACK_VIEW_GROUPS = { "A": { "views": { "A1": (1.0, 0.0, 0.0), "A2": (-1.0, 0.0, 0.0), "A3": (0.0, 1.0, 0.0), "A4": (0.0, -1.0, 0.0), "A5": (0.0, 0.0, 1.0), "A6": (0.0, 0.0, -1.0), } }, "B": { "views": { "B1": (1.0, 1.0, 0.0), "B2": (1.0, -1.0, 0.0), "B3": (-1.0, 1.0, 0.0), "B4": (-1.0, -1.0, 0.0), "B5": (1.0, 0.0, 1.0), "B6": (-1.0, 0.0, -1.0), } }, "C": { "views": { "C1": (1.0, 1.0, 1.0), "C2": (1.0, 1.0, -1.0), "C3": (1.0, -1.0, 1.0), "C4": (1.0, -1.0, -1.0), "C5": (-1.0, 1.0, 1.0), "C6": (-1.0, 1.0, -1.0), "C7": (-1.0, -1.0, 1.0), "C8": (-1.0, -1.0, -1.0), } }, } @dataclass class ReferenceFileRecord: filename: str exists: bool sha256: Optional[str] size_bytes: Optional[int] @dataclass class OrientationComparison: candidate_name: str vector: List[float] signed_dot: float abs_dot: float angle_deg_directed: float angle_deg_line: float is_same_directed_position: bool is_same_axis_line: bool @dataclass class Core4AxisRecord: rotation_deg: Tuple[float, float, float] axis_role: str vector: List[float] signed_dot_to_manifest: float angle_deg_to_manifest_line: float is_manifest_axis: bool # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Grundläggande IO # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- def ensure_dirs() -> None: for path in [OUT_DIR, JSON_DIR, CSV_DIR, REPORT_DIR]: path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) def now() -> str: return datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds") def log(message: str) -> None: ensure_dirs() line = f"[{now()}] {message}" print(line) with LOG_PATH.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle: handle.write(line + "
") def write_text(path: Path, text: str) -> None: path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8") def write_json(path: Path, payload: object) -> None: path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as handle: json.dump(payload, handle, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) def write_csv(path: Path, rows: List[dict]) -> None: path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) if not rows: path.write_text("", encoding="utf-8") return with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle: writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=list(rows[0].keys())) writer.writeheader() writer.writerows(rows) # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Referensfilsläsning # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str: h = hashlib.sha256() with path.open("rb") as handle: for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""): h.update(chunk) return h.hexdigest() def collect_reference_files() -> List[ReferenceFileRecord]: records: List[ReferenceFileRecord] = [] for name in REFERENCE_FILES: path = ROOT_DIR / name if path.exists(): records.append(ReferenceFileRecord(name, True, sha256_file(path), path.stat().st_size)) else: records.append(ReferenceFileRecord(name, False, None, None)) return records def parse_assignment_from_python(path: Path, name: str): if not path.exists(): return None try: tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) except Exception: return None for node in tree.body: if isinstance(node, ast.Assign): for target in node.targets: if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == name: try: return ast.literal_eval(node.value) except Exception: return None return None def load_rotations_and_views() -> Tuple[List[Tuple[float, float, float]], Dict[str, dict], Dict[str, str]]: source = ROOT_DIR / "Vesica_Render_HTML_Only_AB_Categorized.py" rotations = parse_assignment_from_python(source, "ROTATIONS_GREEN") view_groups = parse_assignment_from_python(source, "VIEW_GROUPS") info = { "rotations_source": "fallback", "view_groups_source": "fallback", } if rotations is not None: rotations = [tuple(float(x) for x in rot) for rot in rotations] info["rotations_source"] = str(source.name) else: rotations = FALLBACK_ROTATIONS_GREEN if view_groups is not None: info["view_groups_source"] = str(source.name) else: view_groups = FALLBACK_VIEW_GROUPS return rotations, view_groups, info # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Vektorgeometri # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- def normalize(v: Iterable[float]) -> np.ndarray: arr = np.asarray(list(v), dtype=float) n = float(np.linalg.norm(arr)) if n <= EPS: raise ValueError(f"Kan inte normalisera nollvektor: {arr}") return arr / n def angle_deg_directed(a: Iterable[float], b: Iterable[float]) -> float: ua = normalize(a) ub = normalize(b) dot = float(np.dot(ua, ub)) dot = max(-1.0, min(1.0, dot)) return float(math.degrees(math.acos(dot))) def angle_deg_line(a: Iterable[float], b: Iterable[float]) -> float: ua = normalize(a) ub = normalize(b) dot = abs(float(np.dot(ua, ub))) dot = max(-1.0, min(1.0, dot)) return float(math.degrees(math.acos(dot))) def same_directed(a: Iterable[float], b: Iterable[float]) -> bool: return angle_deg_directed(a, b) <= ANGLE_TOL_DEG def same_line(a: Iterable[float], b: Iterable[float]) -> bool: return angle_deg_line(a, b) <= ANGLE_TOL_DEG def rotation_matrix(ax_deg: float, ay_deg: float, az_deg: float) -> np.ndarray: ax, ay, az = np.deg2rad([ax_deg, ay_deg, az_deg]) rx = np.array([ [1.0, 0.0, 0.0], [0.0, np.cos(ax), -np.sin(ax)], [0.0, np.sin(ax), np.cos(ax)], ]) ry = np.array([ [np.cos(ay), 0.0, np.sin(ay)], [0.0, 1.0, 0.0], [-np.sin(ay), 0.0, np.cos(ay)], ]) rz = np.array([ [np.cos(az), -np.sin(az), 0.0], [np.sin(az), np.cos(az), 0.0], [0.0, 0.0, 1.0], ]) return rz @ ry @ rx def round_vec(v: Iterable[float], decimals: int = 12) -> List[float]: arr = np.asarray(list(v), dtype=float) arr[np.abs(arr) < 10 ** (-(decimals + 1))] = 0.0 return [round(float(x), decimals) for x in arr] # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Den faktiska orienteringshärledningen # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- def derive_manifest_position_from_vp() -> Dict[str, object]: """ Detta är huvudtestet. Startdefinition: Vesica Piscis frontläge ligger i XY. X = relationell längd / centrumrelation. Y = höjd i VP-planet. Z = frontal observationsnormal. H-D-R-frågan som testas: Den första 3D-aktiveringen inför 90° mellan frontnormalen Z och den relationella horisontalen X. Den andra H-D-R-aktiveringen från VP ger halva vinkeln mellan 0° och 90°. Halvvinkeln är 45° och riktningen blir normaliserad X + Z. Det ger en riktad position utan att B5/B6 används som input. """ x_relation = normalize([1.0, 0.0, 0.0]) y_height = normalize([0.0, 1.0, 0.0]) z_front = normalize([0.0, 0.0, 1.0]) # Operatorisk halvvinkel i XZ-relationen: manifest = normalize(x_relation + z_front) # Kontroll: vinklarna mot X och Z skall båda vara 45°. angle_to_x = angle_deg_directed(manifest, x_relation) angle_to_z = angle_deg_directed(manifest, z_front) y_component_zero = abs(float(np.dot(manifest, y_height))) <= EPS return { "x_relation_axis": round_vec(x_relation), "y_height_axis": round_vec(y_height), "z_front_normal": round_vec(z_front), "manifest_position_vector": round_vec(manifest), "angle_to_x_relation_deg": angle_to_x, "angle_to_z_front_deg": angle_to_z, "y_component_zero": y_component_zero, "half_angle_lock_45_45": abs(angle_to_x - 45.0) <= ANGLE_TOL_DEG and abs(angle_to_z - 45.0) <= ANGLE_TOL_DEG, } def flatten_abc_views(view_groups: Dict[str, dict]) -> Dict[str, Tuple[float, float, float]]: views: Dict[str, Tuple[float, float, float]] = {} for group_key, group_info in view_groups.items(): for name, vec in group_info.get("views", {}).items(): views[name] = tuple(float(x) for x in vec) return views def compare_manifest_to_views(manifest_vec: Iterable[float], views: Dict[str, Tuple[float, float, float]]) -> List[OrientationComparison]: manifest = normalize(manifest_vec) rows: List[OrientationComparison] = [] for name, vec in views.items(): v = normalize(vec) signed = float(np.dot(manifest, v)) rows.append(OrientationComparison( candidate_name=name, vector=round_vec(v), signed_dot=signed, abs_dot=abs(signed), angle_deg_directed=angle_deg_directed(manifest, v), angle_deg_line=angle_deg_line(manifest, v), is_same_directed_position=same_directed(manifest, v), is_same_axis_line=same_line(manifest, v), )) rows.sort(key=lambda r: (r.angle_deg_line, r.angle_deg_directed, r.candidate_name)) return rows def extract_core4_axes(rotations: List[Tuple[float, float, float]], manifest_vec: Iterable[float]) -> List[Core4AxisRecord]: base_axes = { "relation_axis_X_center_pair": np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=float), "height_axis_Y_circle_plane": np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0], dtype=float), "normal_axis_Z_circle_plane": np.array([0.0, 0.0, 1.0], dtype=float), } manifest = normalize(manifest_vec) records: List[Core4AxisRecord] = [] for rot in rotations: mat = rotation_matrix(*rot) for role, base in base_axes.items(): vec = normalize(mat @ base) records.append(Core4AxisRecord( rotation_deg=tuple(float(x) for x in rot), axis_role=role, vector=round_vec(vec), signed_dot_to_manifest=float(np.dot(vec, manifest)), angle_deg_to_manifest_line=angle_deg_line(vec, manifest), is_manifest_axis=same_line(vec, manifest), )) return records def classify( derivation: Dict[str, object], comparisons: List[OrientationComparison], core4_axes: List[Core4AxisRecord], ) -> Dict[str, object]: same_directed = [r.candidate_name for r in comparisons if r.is_same_directed_position] same_line_names = [r.candidate_name for r in comparisons if r.is_same_axis_line] core4_manifest_axes = [r for r in core4_axes if r.is_manifest_axis] b5_directed = "B5" in same_directed b6_directed = "B6" in same_directed b5b6_line = "B5" in same_line_names and "B6" in same_line_names manifest_in_core4 = len(core4_manifest_axes) > 0 half_angle_lock = bool(derivation["half_angle_lock_45_45"]) y_zero = bool(derivation["y_component_zero"]) if b5_directed and b5b6_line and manifest_in_core4 and half_angle_lock and y_zero: classification = "CORE4_MANIFEST_POSITION_IS_B5_WITH_B6_AS_INVERSE_LINE" answer = ( "Core4:s manifesterade utgångsposition är B5-linjen: normaliserad riktning (1, 0, 1). " "B6 är samma observationslinje i inverterad riktning (-1, 0, -1). " "Positionen är därmed operatoriskt genererad från H-D-R-halvvinkeln mellan X och Z, inte vald i efterhand." ) final_pass = True exit_code = 0 elif b5b6_line and manifest_in_core4 and half_angle_lock and y_zero: classification = "CORE4_MANIFEST_POSITION_IS_B5B6_LINE_DIRECTION_UNRESOLVED" answer = ( "Core4:s manifesterade utgångslinje sammanfaller med B5/B6-axeln, " "men riktningen B5 kontra B6 är inte låst av de givna definitionsvillkoren." ) final_pass = True exit_code = 0 elif half_angle_lock and y_zero and manifest_in_core4: classification = "CORE4_MANIFEST_POSITION_GENERATED_BUT_NOT_B5B6" answer = ( "Core4 genererar en 45°-position i XZ-fältet, men den matchar inte B5/B6 enligt ABC-definitionerna." ) final_pass = False exit_code = 10 else: classification = "INSUFFICIENT_DEFINITION_OR_FAILED_DERIVATION" answer = ( "Validatorn kan inte låsa frågan eftersom halvvinkeln, Y=0-villkoret eller Core4-matchningen fallerade." ) final_pass = False exit_code = 20 nearest = comparisons[0] if comparisons else None return { "final_pass": final_pass, "exit_code": exit_code, "classification": classification, "answer": answer, "directed_position_matches": same_directed, "axis_line_matches": same_line_names, "nearest_abc_view": nearest.candidate_name if nearest else None, "nearest_abc_line_angle_deg": nearest.angle_deg_line if nearest else None, "manifest_position_in_core4_axes": manifest_in_core4, "core4_manifest_axis_count": len(core4_manifest_axes), "half_angle_lock_45_45": half_angle_lock, "y_component_zero": y_zero, "b5_directed_match": b5_directed, "b6_directed_match": b6_directed, "b5b6_axis_line_match": b5b6_line, } def build_report(payload: Dict[str, object]) -> str: c = payload["conclusion"] d = payload["operator_derivation"] lines: List[str] = [] lines.append("# RP9 — CORE4 MANIFEST POSITION VALIDATION") lines.append("") lines.append(f"Generated: {payload['metadata']['generated']}") lines.append(f"Script: {payload['metadata']['script']}") lines.append(f"Version: {payload['metadata']['version']}") lines.append("") lines.append("## FINAL STATUS") lines.append("") lines.append("```text") lines.append(f"FINAL_PASS = {c['final_pass']}") lines.append(f"CLASSIFICATION = {c['classification']}") lines.append(f"ANSWER = {c['answer']}") lines.append("```") lines.append("") lines.append("## TESTFRÅGA") lines.append("") lines.append("```text") lines.append("När Vesica Piscis definieras som XY-frontläge och H-D-R-operatorn genererar Core4,") lines.append("vilken position manifesteras av Core4-strukturen själv?") lines.append("") lines.append("Sammanfaller denna position med B5-N6/B6-N6, eller krävs ett senare observationsval?") lines.append("```") lines.append("") lines.append("## VAD SOM TESTAS") lines.append("") lines.append("Testet undersöker den härledda utgångspositionen, inte B5/B6:s unikhet bland redan definierade vyer.") lines.append("") lines.append("## HUR DET TESTAS") lines.append("") lines.append("1. Starta med Vesica Piscis i XY-plan rakt framifrån.") lines.append("2. Definiera X som relationell längd och Z som frontal observationsnormal.") lines.append("3. Härled H-D-R-halvvinkeln mellan 0° och 90° i XZ-fältet utan att använda B5/B6 som input.") lines.append("4. Läs ut den genererade positionen.") lines.append("5. Kontrollera att positionen finns i Core4:s egna rotations-/relationsfält.") lines.append("6. Jämför därefter med ABC-definitionerna, inklusive B5 och B6.") lines.append("") lines.append("## OPERATORISK HÄRLEDNING") lines.append("") lines.append("```text") lines.append(f"X relation axis = {d['x_relation_axis']}") lines.append(f"Z front normal = {d['z_front_normal']}") lines.append(f"Manifest position = normalize(X + Z) = {d['manifest_position_vector']}") lines.append(f"Angle to X = {d['angle_to_x_relation_deg']:.12f}°") lines.append(f"Angle to Z = {d['angle_to_z_front_deg']:.12f}°") lines.append(f"Y component zero = {d['y_component_zero']}") lines.append(f"45/45 half-angle lock= {d['half_angle_lock_45_45']}") lines.append("```") lines.append("") lines.append("## JÄMFÖRELSE MOT B5/B6") lines.append("") lines.append("```text") lines.append(f"Directed position matches = {c['directed_position_matches']}") lines.append(f"Axis line matches = {c['axis_line_matches']}") lines.append(f"Nearest ABC view = {c['nearest_abc_view']}") lines.append(f"Nearest ABC line angle = {c['nearest_abc_line_angle_deg']}") lines.append(f"Core4 contains manifest axis = {c['manifest_position_in_core4_axes']}") lines.append("```") lines.append("") lines.append("## SLUTSATS") lines.append("") lines.append(c["answer"]) lines.append("") lines.append("## PRECISIONSANMÄRKNING") lines.append("") lines.append("B5 och B6 är motsatta riktningar på samma observationslinje. Med RP9:s vanliga +X/+Z-konvention blir den riktade positionen B5. B6 är samma linje sedd från inverterad riktning.") lines.append("") lines.append("## OUTPUT") lines.append("") lines.append("- 01_JSON/CORE4_MANIFEST_POSITION_VALIDATION.json") lines.append("- 02_CSV/ABC_POSITION_COMPARISON.csv") lines.append("- 02_CSV/CORE4_AXIS_COMPARISON.csv") lines.append("- 03_REPORT/CORE4_MANIFEST_POSITION_VALIDATION.md") lines.append("") return "
".join(lines) + "
" def zip_outputs() -> None: if ZIP_PATH.exists(): ZIP_PATH.unlink() files = [Path(__file__).resolve()] if OUT_DIR.exists(): files.extend([p for p in OUT_DIR.rglob("*") if p.is_file()]) with zipfile.ZipFile(ZIP_PATH, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf: for p in files: zf.write(p, arcname=p.relative_to(ROOT_DIR)) def run() -> int: ensure_dirs() if LOG_PATH.exists(): LOG_PATH.unlink() log("START CORE4 MANIFEST POSITION VALIDATOR") rotations, view_groups, source_info = load_rotations_and_views() references = collect_reference_files() derivation = derive_manifest_position_from_vp() manifest = derivation["manifest_position_vector"] abc_views = flatten_abc_views(view_groups) comparisons = compare_manifest_to_views(manifest, abc_views) core4_axes = extract_core4_axes(rotations, manifest) conclusion = classify(derivation, comparisons, core4_axes) payload = { "metadata": { "generated": now(), "script": SCRIPT_NAME, "version": SCRIPT_VERSION, "validator_type": "manifest_position_derivation_not_candidate_uniqueness", "angle_tolerance_deg": ANGLE_TOL_DEG, "source_info": source_info, }, "hypothesis": { "question": "Är Core4 positionerad enligt B5-N6/B6-N6 från början, eller är positionen vald efter etablering?", "H1_operator_generated": "Core4:s manifesterade utgångsposition härleds från H-D-R-halvvinkeln och sammanfaller med B5/B6-linjen.", "H0_selected_after_establishment": "Core4 etableras utan B5/B6-position; B5/B6 måste väljas efteråt som observationsposition.", }, "reference_files": [asdict(r) for r in references], "operator_derivation": derivation, "abc_position_comparison": [asdict(r) for r in comparisons], "core4_axis_comparison": [asdict(r) for r in core4_axes], "conclusion": conclusion, } write_json(JSON_DIR / "CORE4_MANIFEST_POSITION_VALIDATION.json", payload) write_csv(CSV_DIR / "ABC_POSITION_COMPARISON.csv", [asdict(r) for r in comparisons]) write_csv(CSV_DIR / "CORE4_AXIS_COMPARISON.csv", [asdict(r) for r in core4_axes]) write_text(REPORT_DIR / "CORE4_MANIFEST_POSITION_VALIDATION.md", build_report(payload)) log(f"FINAL_PASS={conclusion['final_pass']}") log(f"CLASSIFICATION={conclusion['classification']}") log(f"DIRECTED_POSITION_MATCHES={conclusion['directed_position_matches']}") log(f"AXIS_LINE_MATCHES={conclusion['axis_line_matches']}") log(f"ANSWER={conclusion['answer']}") zip_outputs() log(f"ZIP={ZIP_PATH}") log("END") return int(conclusion["exit_code"]) if __name__ == "__main__": sys.exit(run()) ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.

item.title: RP9. CORE4. (O-E-I-A). PYTHON
item.description:
RP9_CORE4_ORIENTATION_EXTRACTION_IMPLEMENTATION_AUDITOR.py Version: 1.0.0 Purpose ------- Audits the remaining implementation question in RP9_CORE4_OPERATOR_STATE_DERIVATION_VALIDATOR.py: How is the Core4 orientation extracted? This script does not attempt to re-declare RP9. It audits whether the previous validator's orientation extraction is functionally independent of ABC/B5/B6 naming and whether the extracted operator-state vector can be reproduced by an independent minimal implementation before any ABC comparison is loaded. Exit codes ---------- 0 = extraction implementation is locked: no forbidden pre-ABC dependency, independent reproduction matches. 10 = extraction implementation is not locked: dependency or reproduction failure. 20 = audit could not run due to missing/invalid inputs. """ from __future__ import annotations import ast import csv import hashlib import importlib.util import json import math import sys import zipfile from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass from datetime import datetime from pathlib import Path from typing import Dict, Iterable, List, Optional, Set, Tuple try: import numpy as np except Exception as exc: print("ERROR: numpy is required") print(str(exc)) sys.exit(20) SCRIPT_NAME = Path(__file__).name SCRIPT_VERSION = "1.0.0" ROOT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent if "__file__" in globals() else Path.cwd() TARGET_VALIDATOR = ROOT_DIR / "RP9_CORE4_OPERATOR_STATE_DERIVATION_VALIDATOR.py" OUT_DIR = ROOT_DIR / "RP9_CORE4_ORIENTATION_EXTRACTION_IMPLEMENTATION_AUDIT_OUTPUT" JSON_DIR = OUT_DIR / "01_JSON" CSV_DIR = OUT_DIR / "02_CSV" REPORT_DIR = OUT_DIR / "03_REPORT" AUDIT_DIR = OUT_DIR / "04_AUDIT" LOG_PATH = OUT_DIR / "RP9_CORE4_ORIENTATION_EXTRACTION_IMPLEMENTATION_AUDITOR.log" ZIP_PATH = ROOT_DIR / "RP9_CORE4_ORIENTATION_EXTRACTION_IMPLEMENTATION_AUDIT_PACKAGE.zip" EPS = 1.0e-10 ANGLE_TOL_DEG = 1.0e-7 FORBIDDEN_PRE_ABC_NAMES = { "ABC", "B5", "B6", "FALLBACK_ABC_VIEWS", "load_abc_views", "compare_to_abc", "abc_views", "abc_rows", "ABCComparison", "classify_final" } PRE_ABC_FUNCTIONS = [ "build_core4_circles", "extract_center_pair_axes", "derive_operator_state", ] @dataclass class StaticFunctionAudit: function_name: str exists: bool referenced_names: List[str] forbidden_references: List[str] pass_status: bool @dataclass class RuntimeAudit: name: str pass_status: bool result: str details: Dict[str, object] @dataclass class IndependentCandidate: rotation_deg: Tuple[float, float, float] raw_vector: List[float] canonical_vector: List[float] angle_to_x_deg: float angle_to_z_deg: float y_abs: float passes_rule: bool reason: str # IO ----------------------------------------------------------------------- def ensure_dirs() -> None: for p in [OUT_DIR, JSON_DIR, CSV_DIR, REPORT_DIR, AUDIT_DIR]: p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) def now() -> str: return datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds") def log(message: str) -> None: ensure_dirs() line = f"[{now()}] {message}" print(line) with LOG_PATH.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as h: h.write(line + "
") def json_safe(obj): if isinstance(obj, dict): return {str(k): json_safe(v) for k, v in obj.items()} if isinstance(obj, list): return [json_safe(v) for v in obj] if isinstance(obj, tuple): return [json_safe(v) for v in obj] if isinstance(obj, Path): return str(obj) if isinstance(obj, np.ndarray): return json_safe(obj.tolist()) if isinstance(obj, np.generic): return obj.item() if hasattr(obj, "__dataclass_fields__"): return json_safe(asdict(obj)) return obj def write_json(path: Path, payload: object) -> None: path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) path.write_text(json.dumps(json_safe(payload), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8") def write_text(path: Path, text: str) -> None: path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8") def write_csv(path: Path, rows: List[dict]) -> None: path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) if not rows: path.write_text("", encoding="utf-8") return with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as h: w = csv.DictWriter(h, fieldnames=list(rows[0].keys())) w.writeheader() w.writerows(rows) def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str: h = hashlib.sha256() with path.open("rb") as f: for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b""): h.update(chunk) return h.hexdigest() # Static audit -------------------------------------------------------------- class NameCollector(ast.NodeVisitor): def __init__(self) -> None: self.names: Set[str] = set() self.attrs: Set[str] = set() def visit_Name(self, node: ast.Name) -> None: self.names.add(node.id) self.generic_visit(node) def visit_Attribute(self, node: ast.Attribute) -> None: self.attrs.add(node.attr) self.generic_visit(node) def parse_target_tree() -> ast.Module: if not TARGET_VALIDATOR.exists(): raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing target validator: {TARGET_VALIDATOR}") return ast.parse(TARGET_VALIDATOR.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) def find_function(tree: ast.Module, name: str) -> Optional[ast.FunctionDef]: for node in tree.body: if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == name: return node return None def audit_static_dependencies(tree: ast.Module) -> List[StaticFunctionAudit]: audits: List[StaticFunctionAudit] = [] for fn_name in PRE_ABC_FUNCTIONS: node = find_function(tree, fn_name) if node is None: audits.append(StaticFunctionAudit(fn_name, False, [], ["FUNCTION_MISSING"], False)) continue collector = NameCollector() collector.visit(node) refs = sorted(collector.names | collector.attrs) forbidden = sorted([x for x in refs if x in FORBIDDEN_PRE_ABC_NAMES or "B5" in x or "B6" in x or "ABC" in x]) audits.append(StaticFunctionAudit(fn_name, True, refs, forbidden, len(forbidden) == 0)) return audits # Independent minimal reproduction ----------------------------------------- def normalize(v: Iterable[float]) -> np.ndarray: arr = np.asarray(list(v), dtype=float) n = float(np.linalg.norm(arr)) if n <= EPS: raise ValueError("zero-vector") return arr / n def round_vec(v: Iterable[float], decimals: int = 12) -> List[float]: arr = np.asarray(list(v), dtype=float) arr[np.abs(arr) < 10 ** (-(decimals + 1))] = 0.0 return [round(float(x), decimals) for x in arr] def angle_directed(a: Iterable[float], b: Iterable[float]) -> float: ua, ub = normalize(a), normalize(b) dot = max(-1.0, min(1.0, float(np.dot(ua, ub)))) return float(math.degrees(math.acos(dot))) def rotation_matrix(ax_deg: float, ay_deg: float, az_deg: float) -> np.ndarray: ax, ay, az = np.deg2rad([ax_deg, ay_deg, az_deg]) rx = np.array([[1.0,0.0,0.0],[0.0,np.cos(ax),-np.sin(ax)],[0.0,np.sin(ax),np.cos(ax)]]) ry = np.array([[np.cos(ay),0.0,np.sin(ay)],[0.0,1.0,0.0],[-np.sin(ay),0.0,np.cos(ay)]]) rz = np.array([[np.cos(az),-np.sin(az),0.0],[np.sin(az),np.cos(az),0.0],[0.0,0.0,1.0]]) return rz @ ry @ rx def canonicalize(v: Iterable[float]) -> np.ndarray: arr = normalize(v) if arr[0] < -EPS or (abs(arr[0]) <= EPS and arr[2] < -EPS): arr = -arr return arr def independent_extract(rotations: List[Tuple[float,float,float]], radius: float) -> Tuple[Optional[np.ndarray], List[IndependentCandidate], Dict[str, object]]: x = np.array([1.0,0.0,0.0]) z = np.array([0.0,0.0,1.0]) base_left = np.array([-radius/2.0,0.0,0.0]) base_right = np.array([radius/2.0,0.0,0.0]) candidates: List[IndependentCandidate] = [] pass_lines: Set[Tuple[float,float,float]] = set() for rot in rotations: mat = rotation_matrix(*rot) left = mat @ base_left right = mat @ base_right raw = normalize(right - left) canon = canonicalize(raw) ax = angle_directed(canon, x) az = angle_directed(canon, z) y_abs = abs(float(canon[1])) passes = (y_abs <= EPS and canon[0] > 0 and canon[2] > 0 and abs(ax-45.0) <= ANGLE_TOL_DEG and abs(az-45.0) <= ANGLE_TOL_DEG) reason = "passes independent XZ-half-angle / Y-neutral extraction rule" if passes else "does not satisfy independent extraction rule" if passes: pass_lines.add(tuple(round_vec(canon, 9))) candidates.append(IndependentCandidate(tuple(float(v) for v in rot), round_vec(raw), round_vec(canon), ax, az, y_abs, passes, reason)) if len(pass_lines) == 1: v = normalize(list(pass_lines)[0]) return v, candidates, {"status":"UNIQUE_INDEPENDENT_EXTRACTION", "unique_line_count":1, "passing_candidate_count":sum(c.passes_rule for c in candidates), "derived_vector":round_vec(v)} if len(pass_lines) == 0: return None, candidates, {"status":"NO_INDEPENDENT_EXTRACTION", "unique_line_count":0, "passing_candidate_count":0, "derived_vector":None} return None, candidates, {"status":"MULTIPLE_INDEPENDENT_EXTRACTIONS", "unique_line_count":len(pass_lines), "passing_candidate_count":sum(c.passes_rule for c in candidates), "derived_vectors":[list(x) for x in sorted(pass_lines)]} # Runtime import ------------------------------------------------------------ def import_target_module(): spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("target_core4_validator", TARGET_VALIDATOR) if spec is None or spec.loader is None: raise ImportError("Cannot create spec for target validator") module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec) sys.modules["target_core4_validator"] = module spec.loader.exec_module(module) # type: ignore[attr-defined] return module def compare_vectors(a: Optional[np.ndarray], b: Optional[np.ndarray]) -> Tuple[bool, Optional[float]]: if a is None or b is None: return False, None ang = angle_directed(a, b) return ang <= ANGLE_TOL_DEG, ang # Main audit ---------------------------------------------------------------- def build_report(payload: Dict[str, object]) -> str: c = payload["conclusion"] lines = [] lines.append("# RP9 — CORE4 ORIENTATION EXTRACTION IMPLEMENTATION AUDIT") lines.append("") lines.append(f"Generated: {payload['metadata']['generated']}") lines.append(f"Script: {payload['metadata']['script']}") lines.append(f"Target: {payload['metadata']['target_validator']}") lines.append("") lines.append("## FINAL STATUS") lines.append("") lines.append("```text") lines.append(f"FINAL_PASS = {c['final_pass']}") lines.append(f"IMPLEMENTATION_LOCK_STATUS = {c['implementation_lock_status']}") lines.append(f"CLASSIFICATION = {c['classification']}") lines.append(f"STATEMENT = {c['final_statement']}") lines.append("```") lines.append("") lines.append("## TESTFRÅGA") lines.append("") lines.append("```text") lines.append("Är orienteringsextraktionen i RP9_CORE4_OPERATOR_STATE_DERIVATION_VALIDATOR.py") lines.append("fri från B5/B6/ABC-beroende före slutjämförelsen, och kan den reproduceras") lines.append("av en oberoende minimal extraktion ur Core4-centerparens geometri?") lines.append("```") lines.append("") lines.append("## VAD SOM TESTADES") lines.append("") lines.append("1. Statisk källkodsgranskning av pre-ABC-funktionerna.") lines.append("2. Runtime-körning av målvalidatorns egen extraktion fram till operator-state-vektorn.") lines.append("3. Oberoende minimal reproduktion av samma extraktion utan import av målvalidatorns extraktionsfunktioner.") lines.append("4. Jämförelse mellan målvalidatorns vektor och den oberoende vektorn.") lines.append("5. Taint-test: ändrade ABC/B5/B6-referenser får inte ändra den pre-ABC-härledda vektorn.") lines.append("") lines.append("## RESULTAT") lines.append("") lines.append("```text") lines.append(f"target_vector = {payload['runtime']['target_operator_vector']}") lines.append(f"independent_vector = {payload['runtime']['independent_operator_vector']}") lines.append(f"vector_match = {payload['runtime']['target_independent_vector_match']}") lines.append(f"vector_angle_difference_deg = {payload['runtime']['target_independent_angle_difference_deg']}") lines.append(f"taint_vector_stable = {payload['runtime']['taint_vector_stable']}") lines.append("```") lines.append("") lines.append("## STATISK FUNKTIONSGRANSKNING") lines.append("") lines.append("| Funktion | Finns | Förbjudna pre-ABC-referenser | Status |") lines.append("|---|---:|---|---:|") for row in payload["static_function_audit"]: lines.append(f"| {row['function_name']} | `{row['exists']}` | `{row['forbidden_references']}` | `{row['pass_status']}` |") lines.append("") lines.append("## SLUTSATS") lines.append("") lines.append(c["final_statement"]) lines.append("") lines.append("## OUTPUT") lines.append("") lines.append("- 01_JSON/CORE4_ORIENTATION_EXTRACTION_IMPLEMENTATION_AUDIT.json") lines.append("- 02_CSV/STATIC_FUNCTION_AUDIT.csv") lines.append("- 02_CSV/INDEPENDENT_EXTRACTION_CANDIDATES.csv") lines.append("- 03_REPORT/CORE4_ORIENTATION_EXTRACTION_IMPLEMENTATION_AUDIT.md") lines.append("- 04_AUDIT/CORE4_ORIENTATION_EXTRACTION_IMPLEMENTATION_AUDIT_HASHES.json") lines.append("") return "
".join(lines) + "
" def zip_outputs() -> None: if ZIP_PATH.exists(): ZIP_PATH.unlink() files = [Path(__file__).resolve()] if OUT_DIR.exists(): files.extend([p for p in OUT_DIR.rglob("*") if p.is_file()]) with zipfile.ZipFile(ZIP_PATH, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf: for p in files: zf.write(p, arcname=p.relative_to(ROOT_DIR)) def run() -> int: ensure_dirs() if LOG_PATH.exists(): LOG_PATH.unlink() log("START CORE4 ORIENTATION EXTRACTION IMPLEMENTATION AUDIT") if not TARGET_VALIDATOR.exists(): log("TARGET_VALIDATOR missing") return 20 tree = parse_target_tree() static_audits = audit_static_dependencies(tree) static_pass = all(a.pass_status and a.exists for a in static_audits) target = import_target_module() rotations, rotation_info = target.load_rotations() circles = target.build_core4_circles(rotations) target_candidates = target.extract_center_pair_axes(circles) target_derived, target_state = target.derive_operator_state(target_candidates) independent_derived, independent_candidates, independent_state = independent_extract(rotations, float(target.RADIUS)) vector_match, angle_diff = compare_vectors(target_derived, independent_derived) # Taint test: mutate ABC definitions after extraction. This must not alter pre-ABC vector. original_fallback = getattr(target, "FALLBACK_ABC_VIEWS", None) taint_result = "not_applicable" taint_stable = False try: target.FALLBACK_ABC_VIEWS = {"B5": (-1.0, 0.0, -1.0), "B6": (1.0, 0.0, 1.0), "X_FAKE": (0.0, 1.0, 0.0)} taint_circles = target.build_core4_circles(rotations) taint_candidates = target.extract_center_pair_axes(taint_circles) taint_derived, taint_state = target.derive_operator_state(taint_candidates) taint_stable, taint_angle = compare_vectors(target_derived, taint_derived) taint_result = f"stable={taint_stable}; angle_diff={taint_angle}; state={taint_state.get('status') if isinstance(taint_state, dict) else taint_state}" finally: if original_fallback is not None: target.FALLBACK_ABC_VIEWS = original_fallback source_text = TARGET_VALIDATOR.read_text(encoding="utf-8") source_hash = sha256_file(TARGET_VALIDATOR) final_pass = bool(static_pass and target_derived is not None and independent_derived is not None and vector_match and taint_stable) classification = "ORIENTATION_EXTRACTION_IMPLEMENTATION_LOCKED" if final_pass else "ORIENTATION_EXTRACTION_IMPLEMENTATION_NOT_LOCKED" if final_pass: statement = ( "Orienteringsextraktionen är låst på implementeringsnivå: pre-ABC-funktionerna innehåller inga " "B5/B6/ABC-referenser, målvalidatorns operator-state-vektor reproduceras av en oberoende minimal " "Core4-centerpar-extraktion, och en muterad ABC/B5/B6-referens ändrar inte den pre-ABC-härledda vektorn." ) exit_code = 0 else: statement = ( "Orienteringsextraktionen är inte slutligt låst: minst en kontroll misslyckades. Granska statisk audit, " "oberoende reproduktion eller taint-test innan frågan används deklarativt." ) exit_code = 10 payload = { "metadata": { "generated": now(), "script": SCRIPT_NAME, "version": SCRIPT_VERSION, "target_validator": TARGET_VALIDATOR.name, "target_sha256": source_hash, "rotation_info": rotation_info, "angle_tolerance_deg": ANGLE_TOL_DEG, }, "question": "Granska den återstående implementationsdelen som avgör hur Core4-orienteringen extraheras.", "static_function_audit": [asdict(a) for a in static_audits], "runtime": { "target_operator_state": json_safe(target_state), "target_operator_vector": round_vec(target_derived) if target_derived is not None else None, "independent_operator_state": independent_state, "independent_operator_vector": round_vec(independent_derived) if independent_derived is not None else None, "target_independent_vector_match": vector_match, "target_independent_angle_difference_deg": angle_diff, "taint_vector_stable": taint_stable, "taint_result": taint_result, }, "independent_extraction_candidates": [asdict(c) for c in independent_candidates], "conclusion": { "final_pass": final_pass, "implementation_lock_status": "LOCKED" if final_pass else "NOT_LOCKED", "classification": classification, "final_statement": statement, "exit_code": exit_code, }, "audit_boundary": { "what_this_audit_can_lock": "The implementation path used to extract Core4 orientation before ABC/B5/B6 comparison.", "what_this_audit_does_not_retest": "The global uniqueness of B5/B6 among all RP9 observations; that belongs to the separate candidate-elimination validators.", }, } write_json(JSON_DIR / "CORE4_ORIENTATION_EXTRACTION_IMPLEMENTATION_AUDIT.json", payload) write_csv(CSV_DIR / "STATIC_FUNCTION_AUDIT.csv", [asdict(a) for a in static_audits]) write_csv(CSV_DIR / "INDEPENDENT_EXTRACTION_CANDIDATES.csv", [asdict(c) for c in independent_candidates]) write_text(REPORT_DIR / "CORE4_ORIENTATION_EXTRACTION_IMPLEMENTATION_AUDIT.md", build_report(payload)) audit_hashes = { "generated": now(), "script": SCRIPT_NAME, "version": SCRIPT_VERSION, "target_validator": TARGET_VALIDATOR.name, "files": {}, } for p in [ Path(__file__).resolve(), TARGET_VALIDATOR, JSON_DIR / "CORE4_ORIENTATION_EXTRACTION_IMPLEMENTATION_AUDIT.json", CSV_DIR / "STATIC_FUNCTION_AUDIT.csv", CSV_DIR / "INDEPENDENT_EXTRACTION_CANDIDATES.csv", REPORT_DIR / "CORE4_ORIENTATION_EXTRACTION_IMPLEMENTATION_AUDIT.md", LOG_PATH, ]: if p.exists(): audit_hashes["files"][p.name] = {"path": str(p), "sha256": sha256_file(p), "size_bytes": p.stat().st_size} write_json(AUDIT_DIR / "CORE4_ORIENTATION_EXTRACTION_IMPLEMENTATION_AUDIT_HASHES.json", audit_hashes) zip_outputs() log(f"FINAL_PASS={final_pass}") log(f"IMPLEMENTATION_LOCK_STATUS={'LOCKED' if final_pass else 'NOT_LOCKED'}") log(f"CLASSIFICATION={classification}") log(f"STATEMENT={statement}") log(f"ZIP={ZIP_PATH}") log("END") return exit_code if __name__ == "__main__": sys.exit(run()) ⚖️ — License & Copyright Licensed under RP9-LA-2026 Copyright © 2026 Anton Wallin See LICENSE for full terms.
